role.title: Manufacturing Quality Director
role.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.”  As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way.  We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.  

 The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities:  we come together ,  we always look for a better way , and  we create possibilities . 

 Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

 Interested in joining us on our journey? 

The Manufacturing Quality Director provides strategic leadership and oversight of manufacturing quality performance, ensuring operational excellence, product reliability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. This position is responsible for developing and executing quality strategies, driving improvements in internal and external quality metrics, and reducing the overall cost of quality.
As a key member of the plant leadership team, the Manufacturing Quality Director partners with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering, Product Management, Supplier Quality, Technology, Distribution, and Service to establish quality objectives, resolve complex quality issues, and ensure alignment with business priorities.
The Director is accountable for manufacturing quality performance, execution of the quality operating plan, continuous improvement initiatives, and leadership and development of the Quality organization.
This role supports plant operations in LaFayette, GA. 
 Position 
Manufacturing Quality Director 
 Location 
USA, LaFayette, GA 
 
 How You'll Create Possibilities 
 Quality Strategy and Operational Leadership 
 Develop and execute manufacturing quality strategies aligned with plant and business objectives.
 Provide leadership and direction for quality performance across manufacturing operations.
  
 Establish measurable quality objectives, performance targets, and improvement plans to support operational excellence.
 Partner with plant leadership and cross-functional teams to integrate quality requirements into manufacturing processes and business decisions.
 Drive accountability for quality performance through effective communication, performance reviews, and corrective action plans.
 Promote a culture of quality ownership, continuous improvement, and proactive problem-solving throughout the organization.
  
 Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement 
  
 Own and drive improvement of key internal and external quality metrics, including First Pass Yield (FPY), Cost of Quality (COQ), Service Call Rate (SCR), scrap, Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), and product damage.
 Analyze quality performance data to identify trends, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement.
 Lead the development and execution of corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans to address quality concerns and prevent recurrence.
 Ensure timely containment, root cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions for End-of-Line Audit (EOLA) findings and other manufacturing quality issues.
 Drive year-over-year improvements in quality performance, process capability, and manufacturing efficiency.
 Champion Lean principles, structured problem-solving, error-proofing (poka-yoke), and proactive quality tools to reduce defects and improve process reliability.
  
 Cost of Quality and Financial Accountability 
 Own the development and execution of the manufacturing Cost of Quality operating plan.
 Identify and prioritize opportunities to reduce scrap, rework, warranty exposure, product damage, and other quality-related costs.
 Establish improvement initiatives targeting the highest contributors to quality losses.
 Partner with Operations, Finance, Engineering, and other stakeholders to evaluate financial impacts and deliver sustainable cost reductions.
 Monitor performance against quality cost targets and implement corrective actions to address unfavorable trends.
 Drive resolution of quality-related concessions attributable to manufacturing operations and implement strategies to prevent recurrence.
  
 Quality Management Systems and Process Control 
 Ensure manufacturing operations comply with established Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, applicable ISO standards, and internal quality procedures.
 Provide oversight of the Manufacturing Change Process (MCP), ensuring changes are appropriately evaluated, documented, approved, communicated, and implemented.
 Partner with the Change Implementation Board (CIB) and cross-functional stakeholders to maintain effective change control and documentation compliance.
 Identify critical manufacturing processes requiring control plans and ensure appropriate controls are established, documented, and maintained.
 Ensure manufacturing quality standards, procedures, and control plans remain current and are consistently followed.
 Support continuous improvement of quality systems, process controls, and manufacturing standards to minimize operational risk.
  
 Cross-Functional Quality and Customer Support 
  
 Collaborate with Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering, Field Quality, Distribution, and Service to resolve quality issues impacting manufacturing operations and customers.
 Partner with Supplier Quality to address supplier-related defects, assess proposed supplier changes, and ensure appropriate change control and production readiness.
 Work with Field Quality and Service organizations to identify emerging product concerns, evaluate field performance, and implement effective manufacturing countermeasures.
 Ensure appropriate quality controls are established for product rework, reprogramming, and corrective actions performed at supplier facilities, distribution centers, or other locations.
 Support resolution of Technical Assistance Group (TAG) concerns and other field service issues attributable to manufacturing processes.
 Collaborate with Engineering to recommend improvements to product testing requirements and manufacturing controls based on field performance and customer usage.
 Leverage technical expertise across the organization to accelerate problem resolution and achieve quality objectives.
  
 People Leadership and Organizational Development 
 Lead, develop, and manage the Manufacturing Quality organization, including Quality Leaders, Quality Engineers, technical specialists, and other supporting personnel.
 Establish clear performance expectations, responsibilities, and development objectives aligned with departmental and business priorities.
 Provide coaching, mentoring, and performance feedback to strengthen technical capabilities, leadership effectiveness, and accountability.
 Ensure appropriate staffing, resource allocation, and prioritization of quality initiatives to meet operational requirements.
 Build a high-performing quality organization focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable results.
 Promote employee engagement, knowledge sharing, and the development of future quality leaders.
  
 Performance Monitoring and Business Reporting 
 Establish and maintain effective daily, weekly, and monthly quality performance reviews.
 Monitor key performance indicators, identify unfavorable trends, and ensure timely escalation and resolution of significant quality concerns.
 Communicate quality performance, improvement initiatives, risks, and corrective action progress to plant and business leadership.
 Translate complex quality data into actionable business insights and improvement priorities.
 Ensure quality initiatives are executed within established timelines, budgets, and performance expectations.
  
 Leadership Expectations 
  
 Demonstrate ownership and accountability for manufacturing quality performance.
 Influence decisions and drive results across multiple functions and organizational levels.
 Balance immediate operational quality requirements with long-term strategic improvement objectives.
 Exercise sound judgment in evaluating quality risks, business impacts, and resource priorities.
 Foster collaboration, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.
 Develop organizational capability through effective leadership, talent development, and succession planning.
 
 
 What You'll Bring to Our Team 
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; equivalent combination of education and relevant technical experience may be considered.
 Experience in Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Design Engineering, Reliability, Product Service, or a related technical function.
 Demonstrated experience with root cause analysis and structured problem-solving methodologies.
 Ability to analyze technical and quality data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple functions and organizational levels.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and technical investigations simultaneously.
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.
 Knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plans, CAPA, SPC, and other quality systems and tools.
 Experience supporting New Product Introduction and product reliability initiatives.
   
 
 
 Our Culture 
 Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities. 

 This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices. 

 By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy. 
 
 
 
 GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization. 
 
 
 GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 
 
 GE Appliances participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S 
 
 
 If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or to apply, please send an e-mail to ask.recruiting@geappliances.com

role.title: Quality Assurance Bureau Director
role.description:
**Introduction**
----------------

 

It is the mission of the Wisconsin Department of Justice (DOJ) to protect the public and ensure that justice is done. To continue to meet this mission, the principles of equity, inclusion, and employee well-being have become a foundation for all work performed at DOJ, on behalf of Wisconsinites.

The Division of Forensic Sciences, Quality Assurance Bureau is recruiting for a **Forensic Sciences Director** to serve as the Quality Assurance Bureau Director.

The Division of Forensic Sciences (DFS) is comprised of three crime laboratories that are located in Madison, Milwaukee, and Wausau. DFS performs testing and analysis in the following forensic science disciplines: seized drugs, toxicology, trace examination, DNA analysis, DNA databank, firearms and toolmarks, latent print and footwear, forensic imaging, AFIS ten-print examinations, and crime scene response. DFS employs approximately 180 management, forensic scientist and technicians. The laboratories have gone through a rigorous accreditation process and maintains a high level of quality assurance and control.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

 

This position may be headquartered at one of the three crime laboratory locations:

* Milwaukee Crime Laboratory, located at 9400 West Doyne Ave in Wauwatosa, WI.
* Madison Crime Laboratory, located at 4626 University Ave., Madison, WI
* Wausau Crime Laboratory, located at 7100 Stewart Avenue in Wausau, WI.

This position is responsible for the formulation, determination, and implementation of management policy as it relates to the Division of Forensic Sciences’ Quality Assurance Program. This position reports directly to the Administrator of the Division of Forensic Sciences and is a key policy advisor to the Deputy Division Administrator and all Lab Directors within the Division.

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to: formulation of and implementation of rules, policies and procedures; management of the Wisconsin State Crime Laboratories’ accreditation process and preparation; and implementation of industry required division audits and training. This position addresses complex division quality issues such as non-conformances and proficiency testing and has fiscal responsibilities related to training, accreditation, proficiency testing and instrumentation.

For more information, please review the position description.

**Salary Information**
----------------------

 

The Forensic Science Director classification is in pay schedule 81 and range 01. The starting salary for this position will be between $58.00 - $61.08/hr. ($120,640 - $127,046 annually), depending upon experience and qualifications. Pay for former and current state employees will be in accordance with the State of Wisconsin Compensation Plan. A 2-year career executive trial period is required. probation may be required.

The State of Wisconsin offers amazing benefits, such as:

* Generous paid time off, including at least 3 1/2 weeks of vacation/personal time, and nine paid holidays.
 + Sick time that rolls over each year with no cap and may be used to pay for healthcare premiums in retirement.
 - Affordable health insurance, dental, vision, life, and more.
 * A top-notch retirement program and optional tax advantaged 457 retirement savings plan.
 * A Well Wisconsin program, offering wellness tools and rewards to employees and spouses.

To learn more about DOJ’s total compensation package, please visit our Total Rewards Calculator!

**Job Details**
---------------

 

The Department of Justice does not sponsor work visas at the time of hire or anytime during employment. All persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and complete the required Employment Eligibility Form I-9.

An extensive background check, including fingerprints, will be completed on applicants prior to selection.

**Qualifications**
------------------

 

**Please clearly and thoroughly address the following in your resume and/or letter of qualifications.**

**Minimally qualified applicants must have training, education or experience in all of the following:**

* Experience working with and adhering to ISO/IEC 17025 and ANAB or A2LA accreditation requirements for forensic laboratories.
* Experience supervising and managing staff, such as planning and coordination workflow, evaluating performance, making hiring recommendations.
* Developing, implementing, monitoring, and/or improving laboratory quality assurance programs, policies, and procedures.
* Experience (to include previous) working cases in a forensic discipline (e.g., DNA, toxicology, firearms, etc.) thus providing insight into the operational challenges and day-to-day demands of laboratory work.

**Well-qualified applicants will have met all of the minimally qualified criterion** **and** **a combination of the following:**

* Managing a forensic science laboratory or unit, such as supervising, managing, and developing staff, developing operating budgets, resource allocation, and reviewing fiscal statements.
* Conducting, managing, or responding to accreditation assessments or external audits.
* Leading organizational change and collaborating across multiple laboratories or work units.

In addition to the above listed qualifications and to provide oversight support to DNA Quality-wide programs that follow FBI Quality standards for DNA personnel, it is preferred that the incumbent have the following:

* Bachelor’s degree in biology, chemistry or forensic science-related area and shall have successfully completed 12 semester or equivalent credit hours from the following subject areas: biochemistry, genetics, molecular biology, and statistics or population genetics.

**How To Apply**
----------------

 

The steps to apply online are quick and easy! Your application materials, including your resume and letter of qualifications, are used during our evaluation process to determine your eligibility for further consideration. It is critically important that your application materials clearly describe your experience related to the stated job qualifications. Please review our helpful tips for developing your resume and letter of qualifications and what should be included. Be advised that there will be no opportunity to change your application materials once you have clicked “Submit.”

Permanent classified state employees who are eligible for consideration (transfer or voluntary demotion) should complete the application process as described above by the stated deadline.

The WI Department of Justice is committed to providing opportunities to all applicants from all backgrounds. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

The State of Wisconsin offers a special program for qualified veterans with a 30% or greater service-connected disability. If you are a qualified veteran, please visit the Veterans Employment page for application instructions to be considered for the Veterans Non-Competitive Appointment program.

Submitted materials will be evaluated by a panel of job experts and the most qualified applicants will be invited to participate in the next step of the selection process. We appreciate the time and effort it takes to apply for positions. If any questions arise, please contact the DOJ Recruiter email at dojrecruiter@wisdoj.gov.

For general wisc.jobs user information and technical assistance, please see the wisc.jobs Frequently Asked Questions page.

**Deadline to Apply**
---------------------

 

The deadline to apply for this job announcement is **November 30****th****, 2026, at 11:59 PM.**

role.title: Executive Director, Corporate Quality
role.description:
**About This Role:**

 

The Head of Corporate Quality is responsible for creating and managing the Global Biogen Quality Management System (QMS). The main areas of focus include Quality Systems, internal and external audits for cGMP compliance (including external vendors and CMOs), IT Quality, Technical Product Complaints, and Central Knowledge Management (including documentation).

 
 

This role is central to Quality and PO&T, managing risk, compliance performance, staying compliant with regulatory changes, and seeking opportunities to gain efficiency and effectiveness in the administration of PO&T’s cGMP systems. Additionally, the role is accountable for preparing semi-annual executive-level updates on the state of Biogen’s QMS and informing Executive Management of potential business risks due to a changing regulatory environment or systemic issues within the company. This role also serves as the principal liaison with the R&D Clinical Compliance organization and provides guidance for ICH conformance. Oversight includes biologic products, ASOs, small molecule products, gene therapy, devices, digital, and combination products.

 
 

*This role is hybrid- RTP or hybrid- Cambridge based.*

 

**Travel requirements** : 25% – 50% depending on location. More travel required if not located in RTP.

 
 

**What You’ll Do:**

* Implement integrated quality systems, policies, and standards applicable to all Biogen U.S. and international manufacturing sites and PO&T locations, including Baar, Cambridge, Netherlands, Solothurn, and RTP.
* Develop and maintain a risk assessment process for evaluating and monitoring all cGXP systems.
* Ensure regulatory inspection responses are assessed holistically.
* Establish clear goals and effective metrics that provide insight into industry benchmarks and applicable trends regarding cGMP compliance.
* Oversee external monitoring of regulatory updates (domestic and international) and incorporate changes into Biogen’s QMS as needed.

* Internal and external GxP and ISO audit programs, including risk management and audit program oversight.
* Ensure Biogen’s internal manufacturing sites, Quality Systems, and vendors operate in a state of cGMP compliance, with any risks appropriately communicated and escalated.

**IT QA Department:**

We are a team of organic chemists and chemical engineers engaged in the design of innovative processes which supply new medicines to patients. role.title: Ready Mix Plant Manager - Marshalltown, IA
role.description:
**Summary**

Manatt’s Plant Managers make and enforce decisions aligned to safely doing everything we do better than anyone else. A Manatt’s Plant Manager is accountable for the safety of everyone at the facility, striving every day to enable all Manatt’s employees to achieve their goals and responsibilities, while ensuring they feel valued. Manatt’s Plant Managers act as the standard bearer for Manatt’s values, mission, purpose, and vision. A Manatt’s Plant Manager is accountable for the people stationed at the plant—building and serving their team; the customer experience of everyone served by the plant—meeting the quality and service expectations of our customers to the smallest details and ensuring Manatt’s Ready Mix is the first choice for our customers and potential customers; and the performance and operation of the plant, including its condition and cleanliness. A Manatt’s Plant Manager is always accountable for everything and everyone at his/her plant.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Ensures all team members and equipment meet company efficiency and excellence standards, including labor cost/cy and cy/hour metrics.
* Ensures proper servicing and maintenance for all equipment, including plant, trucks and loader(s), through coordination with shop and plant maintenance personnel and operations to uphold Manatt’s standards.
* Ensures plant operation and equipment is in compliance with state and local regulations, including maintenance of current MDS, lock out/tag out books and environmental books and collaborates with Environmental Specialist.
* Ensures quality of every batch of ready mixed concrete produced, coordinates with and supports Quality Control team members as necessary.
* Coordinates with the collections staff to ensure proper credit policies are followed; responsible for collections of overdue payments from customers.
* Ensures adequate and appropriate inventory for PPE, safety supplies, fuel, construction materials inventory, and resale products (including completing and reporting monthly inventories in a timely manner).
* Supports all team members carrying out their duties safely, including visiting questionable jobs sites and helping determine if loads can be delivered safely.
* Positively represents and promotes Manatt’s at jobsites and elsewhere, to customers, potential customers, and potential team members.
* Takes customer orders and coordinates with customers and Truck Coordinators to ensure optimal scheduling.
* Organizes projects, gives clear direction and monitors truck flow on all projects.
* Batches ready mix concrete.
* Operates ready mix truck and loader, as needed.
* Listens and coordinates with team members and available resources to ensure every team member can be their best self, analyzes and resolves work obstacles and assists in solving problems.
* Initiates or suggests plans to build and motivate team members to be great on purpose while setting and achieving work goals.
* Recommends measures to improve production methods, equipment performance, and quality of product, and suggest changes in working conditions and use of equipment to improve safety or increase efficiencies.
* Approves employee timecards and requested time off with a goal of sustained work life integration for all team members.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Valid Class A or B CDL with airbrakes endorsement is preferred.
* Current IDOT (Iowa Department of Transportation) Physical is required.
* Current IDOT AGG Tech, PCC 1 and PCC 2 Certifications.
* Current ACI certification is preferred.

**About Us**

Founded in 1947 and headquartered in Brooklyn, Iowa, Manatt’s is a leader in Iowa's heavy highway construction and materials industry. We specialize in asphalt, concrete, and chipseal coating, with additional expertise in recycle crushing, stabilization, milling, grinding, subdrain installation, and more.

At Manatt’s, we have the experts, equipment, resources, and top-quality materials needed to safely and efficiently complete any project. Our integrated approach and unwavering commitment to building exceptional relationships allow us to deliver uncompromising quality and construction services. Our mission is to continually set and reset the standard by which all other construction material companies are measured. We don’t just build infrastructure; we build legacies through higher standards of work and a dedication to excellence in everything we do.

role.title: Director Operations
role.description:
**About Justrite Safety Group**

At **Justrite Safety Group**, we're more than just a collection of industrial safety companies; we're a dynamic organization dedicated to protecting people, property, and the planet. Our ever-growing portfolio of companies collaborates to deliver advanced industrial safety solutions that set the standard for excellence.

As our business continues to grow, we continue to look for top talent to join our team as we lead the charge in revolutionizing industrial safety, ensuring that every worker returns home safe, every workplace remains secure, and our environment thrives for generations to come. With Justrite Safety Group, safety isn't just a priority—it's our passion.

Temporary, off-site, and transportation-based worksites present unique safety and compliance challenges that our **Jobsite Motion Safety** division addresses with a robust range of portable, durable, and self-contained products. Our jobsite solutions include ground protection, spill containment, wheel chocks, hazardous materials storage, hazard signage, emergency response kits, and safety training resources. By tackling various aspects of jobsite safety, we empower organizations to strengthen their safety protocols, improve operational efficiency, and foster a culture of safety across all locations.

**The Contribution You'll bring to this Role:**

The **Director of Operations** will provide overall leadership and direction for the Broomfield, CO and Titusville, PA sites, ensuring excellence in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and culture. This position will oversee all functions within the facility—including manufacturing, engineering, quality, maintenance, planning, warehouse operations, and EHS—while partnering closely with HR, finance, and corporate leadership to align site performance with business objectives.

This role will drive a customer-focused, LEAN-based culture, fostering continuous improvement, operational discipline, and employee engagement throughout the organization.

In this role, you will report directly to the Chief Operating Officer, setting the stage for your career to soar! This role is your gateway to opportunities for advancement, with the potential to grow within the organization in 3-5 years as you make meaningful contributions to our organizational goals.

**About the Team:**

As a member of our **Operations** team, you will be dedicated to driving efficiency and excellence across all aspects of our business. With a focus on streamlined processes and innovative solutions, they ensure that our operations run smoothly and effectively. Comprised of skilled professionals who are leaders in their field, the team is committed to optimizing performance and delivering high-quality results. Their expertise is key to maintaining our competitive edge and supporting the growth and success of our company.

**What You'll Do at Justrite:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Lead all site operations, ensuring performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity meet or exceed expectations.

* Oversee and develop direct reports including Production, Maintenance, Engineering, Planning, Warehouse, and Quality leaders.

* Establish both short- and long-term operational strategies aligned with corporate objectives and sales forecasts.

* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and use data-driven decision-making to improve efficiency, throughput, and service levels.

**Continuous Improvement & LEAN Transformation**

* Champion LEAN manufacturing principles and culture across all departments.

* Drive standardization, waste elimination, and process improvement through engagement at every level.

* Lead kaizen events and ensure visual management and accountability systems are in place.

**Safety, Health, and Environment**

* Foster a proactive, safety-first culture ensuring compliance with all OSHA, EPA, and local environmental regulations.

* Lead site EHS initiatives to promote a safe, clean, and sustainable work environment.

**People & Culture**

* Build and develop a high-performing leadership team, ensuring succession planning and career development opportunities.

* Promote open communication, teamwork, and accountability.

* Partner with HR to support employee engagement, retention, and organizational development.

**Financial & Strategic Accountability**

* Prepare and manage annual operating and capital budgets, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.

* Drive cost reduction and productivity initiatives while maintaining quality and service standards.

* Participate in strategic planning and contribute to broader business initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for corporate and business unit leaders on all site-related activities.

* Collaborate with supply chain, quality, finance, HR, and engineering teams to ensure alignment on priorities and resource allocation.

* Represent the site in business reviews and support corporate-level projects and new product launches.

**Your Skills and Expertise:**

To ensure your success from day one in this role, Justrite requires the following qualifications at a minimum:

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing operations, preferably with exposure to Reaction Injection Molding (RIM), Rigid and Integral Skin Foam, and open cast molding.
* Proven track record of LEAN leadership and cultural transformation in a manufacturing setting.
* Strong understanding of cost systems, production planning, quality management, maintenance, and safety programs.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, foster collaboration, and develop future leaders.

*Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:*

* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams); ERP system experience preferred.

**Compensation:**

The position offers a competitive base salary ranging from $160,000 to $200,000.

Actual base salaries will vary and may be above or below the recommended pay range based on factors such as but not limited to location, relevant experience and performance. Additionally, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan to enhance their overall total compensation package when Justrite Safety Group and their business units achieve annual business and financial targets.

 
Compensation: 140,000 to 165,000

At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

role.title: Senior Plant Manager - Peach Tree City, GA
role.description:
**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**

The Senior Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of our CertainTeed Roofing manufacturing facility in Peachtree City. Reporting to the Senior Director of Regional Operations, this role provides overall leadership for safety, quality, production, cost, delivery, people development, and sustainability performance.

You will set the vision and culture for the site, align daily operations with business strategy, and lead continuous improvement and long term plant performance. Success in this role requires sound judgment, strong business and people leadership, and the ability to balance workforce engagement, customer expectations, regulatory compliance, and community responsibility.

 **IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?**

**What you will do:**

* Lead all aspects of plant operations, including safety, production, maintenance, quality, logistics, engineering, and environmental performance.
* Build and sustain a strong safety culture where health and safety are integrated into daily decisions and operations.
* Deliver plant performance goals across safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, and profitability.
* Own the plant operating budget, forecasting, cost management, and long range planning.
* Drive continuous improvement through Lean Manufacturing, reliability, process optimization, problem solving, and operational excellence.
* Lead change initiatives and translate business strategy into actionable plant priorities and measurable results.
* Build and develop a high performing leadership team through coaching, feedback, succession planning, and employee development.
* Partner cross functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, R&D, Product Management, and other key stakeholders to support customer and business needs.
* Provide leadership for major capital projects and other strategic plant initiatives.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, required.
* 10+ years of progressive production or operations management experience.
* 5 to 7 years of experience at the Production Manager or Plant Superintendent level preferred.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or Operations Management preferred.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, supply chain, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, WCM, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Knowledge of quality management systems, equipment reliability, process optimization, OSHA requirements, and safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem solving, and change management skills.
* Ability to travel domestically approximately 20% of the time.

 
**A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US**

Through the responsible development of innovative and sustainable building products, CertainTeed, headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, has helped shape the building products industry for more than 110 years. Founded in 1904 as General Roofing Manufacturing Company, the company’s slogan, “Quality Made Certain, Satisfaction Guaranteed,” inspired the name CertainTeed. Today, CertainTeed is a leading North American brand of exterior and interior building products, including roofing, siding, trim, insulation, drywall, and ceilings. CertainTeed is a subsidiary of Saint-Gobain, one of the world’s largest and oldest building products companies.

Applicants for roles based in Washington state or remote roles that would be worked from Washington state are encouraged to direct any concerns regarding the state’s Pay Transparency laws to the SGNA HR Compliance team at SGNA\_HR\_Compliance@saint-gobain.com.

 **BENEFITS IN JOINING US**

Saint-Gobain aims to deliver a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports employees’ wellbeing and helps improve daily life for employees and their families. Be Well. Be You brings together inclusive programs and meaningful resources that support physical, emotional, financial, and social wellbeing. We are the leading provider of worldwide smart end-to-end supply chain & logistics, enabling the flow of trade across the globe. Our comprehensive range of products and services covers every link of the integrated supply chain – from maritime and inland terminals to marine services and industrial parks as well as technology-driven customer solutions.

* Ensure that customer expectations are met and/or exceeded within the confines of company guidelines
* Quarterly presentations to customer senior management relative to our scorecard and initiatives
* Participate in customer invited meetings e.g. 9:30 am to support Customer strategic objectives
* Communicate with the customer and demonstrate initiatives supporting continuous improvement
* Meet company objectives with respect to Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Morale and Environment
* Quarterly presentations to senior management of DP World re Plant objectives and initiatives
* Establish 5 year / contract life business plan, annual budgets and ensure targets are met
* Local initiatives to ensure plant progression in all regards

ADOPT CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT WITHIN THE WORKPLACE

* Plan and execute the concepts of lean manufacturing
* Ensure the plant plans and executes productivity tasks on an annual and ongoing basis
* Prioritize activities associated with the elimination of waste in all aspects of our operations

ORGANIZATIONAL STRENGTHENING

* Continue to build a stronger salaried team capable of leading the hourly workforce into the demands of the future
* Improve employee relations and morale through participation of personnel from the shop floor and instill behavioral discipline
* Improve communication throughout the organization and at all levels

NEW BUSINESS

* Work with the business development and account management group to identify business opportunities within the capabilities of the plant and local area
* Ensure the plant participates in all activities surrounding potential business and future profitability
* Ensure the plant is always in a state that maximizes its appeal to outsiders and potential customs

BE A CORPORATE CITIZEN, CREATE AN EXTERNAL IMAGE

* Ensure that DP World is a positive force within the community and considered to be a good employer
* Increase the exposure of DP World in a positive light to maximize our opportunity for future growth
* Work with other suppliers and industry focus groups in the local community to learn from their experiences and adapt accordingly

QUALITY & ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS

* Participate as an active member of the management team in supporting ISO 14001 and ensuring that their direct reports abide by these processes and operating work instructions
* Drive, Attend and participate in both ISO TS 16949 and ISO 14001 management review

**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS**

* A college or university degree related to manufacturing is preferred and /or MBA
* At least seven years of progressively responsible operational leadership experience in logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, or comparable environments, including at least three years managing managers or site leadership teams. Comparable relevant experience may be considered.

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.

We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.

***WE MAKE TRADE FLOW***

***TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE.***

role.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Control (PP&C)
role.description:
**About Hirsh Precision**
-------------------------

Hirsh Precision is a leader in U.S. manufacturing, bringing productivity and product innovation to medical, aerospace, industrial, and scientific markets through software, advanced manufacturing techniques, and modern production systems. Our reputation for integrity, quality, service, and excellence is powered by a passionate, engaged team and a culture focused on work that improves people’s lives.

**Role Snapshot**
-----------------

As the Senior Manager, Production Planning & Control (PP&C), you will orchestrate end-to-end planning operations that keep our factory synchronized—from MRP and buy planning to inventory control, warehousing, and logistics. You’ll shape the planning strategy, lead a high-performing team, and ensure schedules, materials, and capacity align to deliver on time, every time.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own and execute MRP activities, including buy planning, material master data stewardship, warehousing, and logistics coordination.
* Partner closely with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Finance to align planning strategies to business goals.
* Lead continuous improvement to increase affordability while safeguarding performance and quality.
* Build, mentor, and develop a top-performing team through training, coaching, performance assessments, and recognition.
* Create and manage production schedules to optimize capacity utilization and meet on-time delivery commitments.
* Monitor shop orders, production priorities, and work center schedules, adjusting proactively as conditions change.
* Collaborate with Operations, Purchasing, and Sales Operations to anticipate and resolve material, labor, and equipment constraints.
* Act as the primary escalation point for all scheduling-related issues.
* Advance scheduling processes, tools, reporting, and overall efficiency via continuous improvement.
* Maintain pristine scheduling data integrity within BPCS and generate KPI dashboards, performance reports, and metrics.
* Provide senior-level insights and reporting to executive stakeholders.

### **A week in the role might look like**

* Kick off with an S&OP alignment touchpoint; validate demand signals and capacity models.
* Review MRP outputs; firm planned orders and buy plans; resolve exceptions with Purchasing.
* Walk the floor with Operations to assess bottlenecks; rebalance work center loads and update priorities.
* Host a cross-functional huddle with Engineering and Quality to mitigate risks on critical programs.
* Publish schedule health KPIs from BPCS and brief leaders on variances and corrective actions.
* Coach a planner on data-governance best practices; recognize wins in a team standup.

### **Basic qualifications**

#### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM)

#### **Experience**

* 8–12 years of progressive experience in manufacturing planning, supply chain, or operations management
* At least 3 years leading multi-disciplined teams

#### **Technical proficiency**

* Hands-on with mid- and upper-tier ERP systems
* Strong analytical capability, KPI dashboard development, and data-governance expertise

#### **Leadership competencies**

* Clear, influential communicator with stakeholder management strength
* Demonstrated talent development and mentorship capability

#### **Other core skills**

* Data-driven problem solving
* Change management expertise
* Continuous-improvement mindset

#### **Desired skills**

* Strategic execution—able to think long-term while delivering hands-on results
* Mentorship & team building—coaching, developing high-performing teams, and succession planning
* Business acumen—translate data into actionable insights that drive cost savings and operational excellence
* Collaboration—excel in matrix environments; foster cross-functional partnerships and knowledge sharing
* Innovation mindset—champion new tools, processes, and best practices that elevate PP&C performance

### **Tools you’ll use**

* ERP & MRP Systems
* ERP Software (including BPCS for scheduling data integrity and reporting)

role.title: Manager / Senior Manager, Technical Operations
role.description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with **neffy®**, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you're motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

 

The Manager / Sr. Manager, Technical Operations will play a key role in executing Technical Operations programs that support the continued development and commercial supply of neffy™. The successful candidate will combine strong technical judgment, project management, and external partner leadership in a highly collaborative environment.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and CMOs, this role provides technical and operational leadership across the ARS outsourced manufacturing network. Responsibilities include leading Technical Operations projects, supporting formulation and process development, technology transfer, GMP manufacturing activities, and resolution of technical and operational issues. The position ensures project scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, and budgets remain aligned while proactively identifying and escalating risks to support compliant, reliable, and on-time product supply.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage cross-functional Technical Operations projects and day-to-day technical and operational interactions with assigned external partners, including scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, budgets, risks, key milestones, project meetings, action tracking, scopes of work, proposals, change orders, and CMO/vendor performance metrics and KPIs (e.g., service, quality, delivery, capacity, and right-first-time).
* Serve as a Technical Operations point of contact for assigned external manufacturing partners and work closely with CMOs and internal stakeholders to ensure execution against agreed project plans and supply requirements.
* Provide technical oversight of formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process characterization, process validation/PPQ, and continued process verification activities, as applicable.
* Plan and support clinical and commercial manufacturing campaigns in coordination with CMOs, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, and other internal functions; provide on-site/person-in-plant support for key manufacturing activities as needed.
* Review manufacturing and process documentation, including master and executed batch records, protocols, reports, process performance data, vendor change controls, investigations, and annual/product reviews, for technical accuracy and process performance.
* Lead or support technical assessment and resolution of manufacturing deviations, out-of-specification or atypical results, and other process issues; contribute to root-cause analysis and appropriate corrective and preventive actions in partnership with Quality Assurance.
* Assess proposed manufacturing and process changes for technical impact and support cross-functional evaluation of quality, supply, and regulatory implications.
* Monitor and trend manufacturing and process performance data to identify emerging risks, process drift, and opportunities for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Support vendor selection, onboarding, and qualification activities in collaboration with Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other stakeholders.
* Communicate project status, technical risks, manufacturing issues, and recommend actions clearly to Technical Operations leadership and cross-functional stakeholders; escalate significant issues to appropriate decision-makers.
* Support preparation and review of CMC information for regulatory submissions and responses to health authority questions, as required.
* Support Technical Operations process improvement, business continuity, capacity planning, and other strategic operational initiatives as assigned.
* Support commercial supply operations managed within Technical Operations, including coordination with third-party logistics (3PL) providers, distribution partners, and external manufacturing/packaging partners to maintain reliable product supply.
* Support product serialization activities, including EPCIS data exchange and operational compliance with applicable Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) requirements, working with packaging, distribution, Quality Assurance, and other partners as appropriate.
* Support clinical supply activities, including coordination with Clinical Operations and external vendors for clinical packaging, labeling, distribution, inventory/expiry management, and Interactive Response Technology/Interactive Web Response System (IRT/IWRS) activities, as applicable.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Strong working knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), pharmaceutical manufacturing operations, and applicable quality systems and regulatory expectations.
* Demonstrated technical understanding of formulation, manufacturing processes, scale-up, technology transfer, process validation, and process performance sufficient to critically evaluate CMO data and recommendations, work effectively in cross-functional technical teams, and hold external partners accountable to commitments.
* Strong project and vendor management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, deliverables, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate complex manufacturing or process issues, develop recommendations, and communicate the rationale for action.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively across functions and organizational levels, including senior management and external partners.
* Well-organized, detail-oriented, and able to identify and escalate risks while maintaining focus on execution and business priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project/reporting tools; experience with project management, continuous improvement, or operational excellence methodologies is a plus.
* Working knowledge of commercial and clinical supply operations relevant to Technical Operations, including 3PL interfaces, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA requirements, and clinical IRT/IWRS processes; direct experience in one or more of these areas is preferred.
* Must be able to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 20% to support external manufacturing partners and key project activities.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, chemical engineering, engineering, or a related scientific/technical discipline; an advanced degree is a plus. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience in Technical Operations, manufacturing, process/formulation development, CMC, supply chain, or a related function.
* Experience working with external CMOs/CDMOs and supporting GMP clinical and/or commercial manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Experience with drug-device combination products, nasal/inhalation products, sterile manufacturing, commercial product launch, or PPQ is preferred.
* Experience reviewing manufacturing batch records and process documentation and supporting technical investigations, change controls, and regulatory CMC activities is preferred.
* Experience supporting commercial distribution/3PL operations, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and/or clinical supply and IRT/IWRS activities is preferred.

At ARS, we are proud to offer a highly competitive compensation & benefits package.

The full-time salary range for this posted position is $140,000 to $175,000and may be eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus. Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

*This position is also eligible for Equity, 401k matching, and our excellent benefits package including 100% employer paid Medical, Dental & Vision for employees. View the full package here:* *ARS Careers Page*

*ARS Pharmaceuticals believes in Equal Opportunity for all and is committed to ensuring all individuals, including individuals with disabilities, have an opportunity to apply for those positions that they are interested in and qualify for without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. ARS Pharmaceuticals is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals so that an individual can perform their job-related duties. If you are interested in applying for an employment opportunity and require special assistance or an accommodation to apply due to a disability, please contact us at careers@ars-pharma.com*

*The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.*

role.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

CITIDIRECT® is Citibank’s award winning next-generation, web based banking platform for Transaction Banking & Cash Management Services. The application provides one-click access to global transaction capabilities using an intuitive and user-centric workflow. CitiDirect supports multiple transaction types across multiple geographies, subsidiaries, and currencies.

The candidate will drive the test strategy of CitiDirect and/other upstream or downstream applications and will be accountable for management of complex/critical/large professional disciplinary areas across Payments, Liquidity and Trade Domains. Leads and directs a team of professionals. Requires a comprehensive understanding of multiple areas within a function and how they interact in order to achieve the objectives of the function. Applies in-depth understanding of the business impact of technical contributions. Strong commercial awareness is a necessity. Generally accountable for delivery of a full range of services to one or more businesses/ geographic regions. Excellent communication skills required in order to negotiate internally, often at a senior level. Some external communication may be necessary. Accountable for the end results of an area. Exercises control over resources, policy formulation and planning. Primarily affects a sub-function. Involved in short- to medium-term planning of actions and resources for own area. Full management responsibility of a team or multiple teams, including management of people, budget and planning, to include performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary actions and terminations and budget approval.
 
 
**Responsibilities:**

* Leads initiatives related to User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process and product rollout into production. Testing specialists who work with technology project managers, UAT professionals and users to design and implement appropriate scripts/plans for an application testing strategy/approach.

* Manages multiple testing teams or a testing functional area (depending on size of business).

* Resolves complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact.

* Collaborates with other testing areas, development teams, IT project managers, business partners and external vendors suppliers.

* Develops testing standards and ensures compliance.

* Creates detailed plans for managing cross testing team dependencies.

* Exhibits in-depth understanding of concepts and procedures within own area and basic knowledge of these elements in other areas.

* Requires in-depth understanding of how IT testing integrates within overall technology and has commercial awareness.

* Evaluates subordinates' performance and makes decisions on pay increases, promotions, terminations, etc.

* Uses evaluative judgment in complicated or novel situations; uses multiple sources of information.

* Impacts IT testing through planning, finances budget, end results and setting policies.

* Requires developed communication skills to negotiate with others at a senior level; may communicate with external parties.

* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience in a testing environment, including senior level people management experience.

* Deep understanding of Systems Development Life Cycle processes and end to end testing methodologies.

* Hands-on experience with test management tools such as Quality Center and related testing platforms.

* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to negotiate and influence at a senior level.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work through complex and unfamiliar testing situations.

* A track record of leading teams to deliver high quality results under tight deadlines.
 

 

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

* Experience designing test automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright or Selenium.

* Working knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman, Rest Assured or SoapUI.

* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI or Jenkins.

* Programming skills in Java, Python or JavaScript, combined with background in payments technology, cloud platforms and Agile or Scrum delivery, and a track record of moving manual QA functions to automated testing.

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

Seeking a career-defining opportunity where your leadership, strategic vision, and client expertise are recognized and rewarded? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you.

Kaufman Rossin is seeking a **Director of Operations** to lead firm-wide initiatives, strengthen operational practices, and turn strategy into execution. * Drive change management through communication, training, and adoption planning, recognizing how people and culture influence success.

* Ensure compliance with professional standards, regulatory requirements, and internal quality programs while identifying and addressing operational risks.
* Oversee team hiring, staffing, training, performance discussions, and career development, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Manage budgets, forecasts, and the financial performance of operational initiatives, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and profitability.
* Partner with the COO and firm leadership on strategic and growth initiatives that enhance the client and colleague experience.

 
**Requirements**

**How You'll Contribute**

* 7+ years of related operations, project, or program management experience.

* 10+ years of supervisory leadership experience, ideally managing project managers, business analysts, or similar teams.

* A hands-on leadership style, strong emotional intelligence, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, supported by sound judgment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, executives, and staff.
* Proficiency with project management and operational reporting tools.
* Availability for occasional travel to support leadership alignment, training, and firm-wide initiatives.

**How You'll Stand Out**

* Experience in professional services, particularly accounting, finance, risk management, or consulting.
* Bachelor’s degree.
* PMP, Prosci, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certifications.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, Salesforce, Domo, Power BI, or generative AI tools.

 
**Benefits**

***We embrace authenticity.*** *Kaufman Rossin is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a culture that reflects the diversity of our firm and clients. We encourage understanding, acceptance, and celebration among all people. That includes lifestyle, education, experience, race, ethnicity, age, religion,* *physical ability, sexual orientation, and gender identity.* ***Differences make unique varieties.***

Sun Life U.S. is one of the largest providers of employee and government benefits, helping approximately 50 million Americans access the care and coverage they need. Through employers, industry partners and government programs, Sun Life U.S. offers a portfolio of benefits and services, including dental, vision, disability, absence management, life, supplemental health, medical stop-loss insurance, and healthcare navigation. We have more than 6,400 employees and associates in our partner dental practices and operate nationwide.

 

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

 

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

 

Visit our website to discover how Sun Life is making life brighter for our customers, partners and communities.

*DentaQuest manages dental and vision benefits for more than 33 million Americans. Our outcomes-based, cost-effective solutions are designed for Medicaid and CHIP, Medicare Advantage, small and large businesses, and individuals. With a focus on prevention and value, we aim to make quality care accessible to improve the oral health of all.*

**Job Description:**

**Location:** Sun Life embraces a hybrid work model that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility of virtual work. Our team members and leaders are expected to foster connection and teamwork by being present in the office at least 2 days per week.

 

**The opportunity:**

The Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance leads the Quality Assurance function within Dental Shared Services and is accountable for the consistent execution of quality monitoring, audit, calibration, reporting, and improvement activities across supported operations. This role manages quality teams and programs, translates performance data into actionable recommendations, and partners with Operations, Compliance, Training, Workforce Management, Client Engagement, Technology, and Business Process Outsourcing partners to strengthen controls, address risk, and improve member, provider, client, and business outcomes.

 
 

**How you will contribute:**

* Manage the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of quality assurance programs across Dental Shared Services and supported operational functions, including Contact Center, Claims, Utilization Management, Provider Operations, Complaints and Grievances, Member Enrollment, Intake and Digital Services, and Vision operations.

* Establish and maintain audit procedures, sampling approaches, quality standards, calibration routines, and reporting practices aligned with contractual, regulatory, client, and internal control requirements.

* Lead, coach, and develop quality leaders and professionals by setting clear expectations, balancing workloads, monitoring productivity and accuracy, and supporting engagement, accountability, and career development.

* Analyze quality results, disputes, appeals, re-audits, and operational trends to identify root causes, emerging risks, and practical opportunities for improvement.

* Partner with Operations, Training, Workforce Management, Compliance, Client Engagement, Technology, and BPO leadership to develop and monitor corrective actions, coaching plans, training updates, and sustainable performance improvements.

* Manage client audit and calibration activities, including call and case selection, audit review, documentation preparation, meeting participation, follow-up, and timely response to client or regulatory inquiries.

* Coordinate quality support for internal, external, regulatory, and client audits; prepare evidence, contribute to management action plans, validate remediation, and track findings through closure.

* Implement quality improvement and technology initiatives, including automation, speech analytics, AWS Contact Lens, end-to-end review models, enhanced reporting, and expanded quality monitoring capabilities.

* Assess staffing, capacity, audit volumes, and competing priorities; recommend resource adjustments that support required coverage, service commitments, and cost-effective delivery.

* Maintain enhanced oversight for high-risk, high-profile, and penalty-impacting clients through targeted audit criteria, clear escalation paths, and proactive communication routines.

* Represent Quality Assurance in cross-functional forums, operational readiness activities, transformation projects, vendor discussions, compliance meetings, and leadership reviews.

* Prepare and present quality results, risks, recommendations, and improvement plans to business leaders, clients, and cross-functional partners.

* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, continuous improvement, collaboration, and client-focused service delivery.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

 
 

**What you will bring with you:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

* Seven or more years of progressive experience in quality assurance, healthcare operations, dental operations, contact center operations, claims, compliance, or related business operations.

* Three or more years of leadership or people management experience, preferably in a quality assurance, operations, or shared services environment.

* Experience supporting government, commercial, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, or other regulated healthcare programs preferred.

* Strong knowledge of quality monitoring, audit methodology, calibration, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, internal controls, and performance improvement practices.

* Experience working with BPO partners, client audits, regulatory audits, and cross-functional operational teams preferred.

* Experience with reporting, dashboards, quality analytics, speech analytics, call recording tools, contact center platforms, or AWS Contact Lens preferred.

* Sound business judgment with the ability to connect quality performance to client, compliance, operational, and financial outcomes.

* Strong people leadership, coaching, performance management, and talent development skills.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, determine root causes, and recommend practical solutions.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings, risks, and recommendations to leaders, clients, and cross-functional audiences.

* Strong project management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and competing priorities.

* Ability to influence without direct authority and build effective partnerships across Operations, Compliance, Training, Technology, Client Engagement, and vendor teams.

* Demonstrated ability to lead teams through change, implement standardized processes, and support technology-enabled transformation.

* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, compliance, confidentiality, and ethical business practices.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams.
