role.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
 
 
**Organization Overview:** 
The Senior Director Advanced Therapies External Manufacturing Operations is responsible for providing leadership and oversight for the production operations of Advanced Therapies contract manufacturers (CMs) under the oversight of the Lebanon Advanced Therapies Manufacturing site, integrating all functional requirements to ensure quality, safety, and customer requirements are met through the lifecycle of external partnerships (partner selection, technology transfer, operation, relationship exit). This position will work cross-functionally to build a business plan, meet commitments, and drive continuous improvement.
 
 
**Responsibilities:** 

* Ensuring staff are qualified and that the required initial and continuing training of all operations personnel is carried out and adapted according to need.
* Accountable for the execution of Lilly standards of operational excellence as it applies to each of the CM relationships
* Relationship development with each CM in order to ensure baseline governance of the contractual obligations and deliver value creation
* Staffs and leads a cross-functional team to execute the expectations outlined in Lilly’s standards of operational excellence
* Establish required Process Teams, complying with the expectations established in Lilly’s standards of operational excellence
* Lead required Flow teams comprised of engineering, technical services and quality functional leaders, complying with the expectations established in Lilly’s standards of operational excellence
* Accountable to communicate status and issues to various management levels in manufacturing, quality, commercial, research and development networks
* Serve as a member of the Lebanon Advanced Therapies Manufacturing site lead team to ensure continuity across internal and external manufacturing processes

**Basic Requirements:** 

* High-quality skills to include: Teamwork and interpersonal, technical, leadership, project management, administrative, financial background, organizational, independent, decision making, multi-tasking, ability to influence diverse groups, communication skills, computer skills, and problem solving.
* Good understanding of OSSCE and its integration within a plant.
* Relevant foundational experiences in process engineering, quality control, process development or technical services.
* Administrative experience as a leader of operations or technical support functions.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry/Biochemistry or related science

**Additional Information:** 
Up to 15-20% travel will be required
 
Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
 
 
Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
 
 
Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).
 
 
Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is
 
$168,000 - $246,400
 
 
Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
Location:

Horsham, PA, US, 19044

Business Unit: Sensor, Test & Calibration

Posting Date: Nov 6, 2026

Job Description:

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading all daily operations of the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, high-quality, and cost-effective production. This role oversees production, safety, quality, maintenance, shipping, warehousing, staffing, budgeting, and continuous improvement while supporting company goals, customer requirements, and regulatory compliance.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:**

Facility & Maintenance

* Responsible for leading maintenance, facilities upkeep, asset reliability, and repair operations within plant.
* Respond to emergency repair situations and provide leadership for urgent maintenance needs, including factory visits when required.
* Ensures that production equipment, building systems, utilities, and facility infrastructure operate safely, efficiently, and reliably.
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs for production equipment, heavy machinery, manufacturing utilities, and facility systems.
* Develop and manage maintenance schedules to reduce machine downtime, improve reliability, and extend equipment life.
* Inspect facilities, equipment, and infrastructure regularly to identify issues early and ensure timely corrective action.
* Coordinate repair and maintenance projects involving mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire suppression, security, lifts, cranes, and general building systems.
* Implement and enforce workplace safety policies and standards, including electrical safety, lockout/tagout, fire safety, hot work, and related compliance requirements.
* Lead root-cause analysis investigations for equipment failures and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Supervise mechanical and electrical technicians, assign work, monitor performance, and support training and skill development.
* Source, coordinate, and oversee external contractors and vendors, including service-level agreements and project execution.

Operational Leadership:

* Direct and manage daily plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, shipping, warehousing, and support functions.
* Ensure production schedules, shipment commitments, and customer requirements are met safely, efficiently, and on time.
* Enforce company safety policies, OSHA requirements, environmental procedures, and regulatory standards to maintain a safe workplace.
* Lead, coach, train, and develop employees/ team while promoting accountability, teamwork, and employee engagement.
* Manage labor, materials, equipment, and operating expenses to meet cost, productivity, and business objectives.
* Support operational planning, capital improvement recommendations, staffing plans, and business growth initiatives.
 

**EXPERIENCE/REQUIREMENTS:**

Essential Skills

* Strong leadership, coaching, and team-building abilities.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, safety, quality, maintenance, inventory, and shipping processes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to analyze operational data, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced production environment.
* Commitment to safety, quality, accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Performance Expectations

* Meet or exceed safety, quality, production, shipment, cost, and productivity targets.
* Maintain a safe, organized, compliant, and efficient manufacturing environment.
* Improve operational performance through effective leadership, problem solving, and continuous improvement.
* Develop employees to strengthen plant capability and succession planning.
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, employee engagement, and customer focus.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing leadership experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive leadership experience in a manufacturing, production, or industrial environment.
* Experience leading hourly employees, and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing safety, quality, production performance, budgets, staffing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental, quality, and workplace safety requirements.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with ERP systems preferred.
 

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout a manufacturing facility for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull materials or equipment as required by plant operations.
* Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with noise, moving equipment, varying temperatures, and standard safety requirements.
* Ability to use personal protective equipment as required.
* Ability to climb stairs, bend, reach, and visually inspect production areas, equipment, and workstations.

role.title: Plant Manager - NRO
role.description:
Location:
Chicago, IL, US

Req ID: 42252

Date: Nov 6, 2026

The ASR Group® family of companies make up the world’s largest refiner and marketer of cane sugar. The companies produce a full line of grocery, industrial, foodservice and specialty sweetener products. Across North America, ASR Group® companies operate five sugar refineries, located in California, Maryland, Louisiana, Canada and Mexico. In Europe, ASR Group® companies operate sugar refineries in the United Kingdom, Portugal, and, with a joint venture partner, Italy. The companies also farm sugarcane and own sugar mills in Mexico and Belize. The ASR Group® portfolio includes the leading brands Domino®, C&H®, Florida Crystals®, Redpath®, Tate & Lyle®, Lyle's®, Sidul® and Whitworths®. ASR Group® companies also produce and market Tellus®, a single-use, compostable tableware and foodservice product made from plant fibers, including sugarcane.

 

**Overview**
------------

The ASR Group Chicago plant is a sugar melt & packaging operation, producing a variety of sugar products for customers. The Calumet facility is blending and packing molasses products for further industrial application. We are looking for a Plant Manager to join our team who is a hands-on leader with excellent problem-solving skills and a drive for improvement and success.

 

This position is accountable for managing the overall results of the Chicago and Calumet facilities to ensure safe, reliable and efficient manufacturing operations and support functions required to meet the business objectives and the expectations of our customers.

**Detailed Roles and Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

* Oversees and champions an effective safety program to achieve zero injuries and continuous improvement to both physical safety issues and employee safety attitudes and behaviors

* Promotes a high level of quality and ensures adherence to all Food Safety Standards, requirements and Good Manufacturing Practices.

* Directs, plans and organizes all manufacturing operations including packaging, maintenance, utilities, engineering and quality.

* Ensures that the productivity and efficiency performance required to meet the key results and objectives of the business are achieved with the highest service standards that will exceed our customer’s expectations.

* Ensures that the site operates within all environmental standards and requirements at all times. Maintains positive dealings with all regulatory agencies.

* Implements manufacturing strategies and plans to ensure that the plant supports Redpath and ASR strategic initiatives. Identifies and recommends opportunities to develop and execute the capital improvement plan to support growth of the business.

* Establishes group and individual accountabilities in all departments for problem solving, cost reduction, and continuous improvement. Ensures focus on problem-solving and use of new technologies.

* Improves utilization of manpower in all areas and improves levels of training, knowledge, and skills within the operations group at all levels.

* Develops and oversees operating budgets. Manages spending against budget and implement strategies to improve costs.

* Maintains positive and productive employee relations by promoting constructive and collaborative relations with all employees.

* Establishes practices throughout the organization to foster positive involvement by all employees with opportunity for input and action.

* Manages community relations and deals with city, municipal and government initiatives that will have impact on the site.

* Supports new product development and sales initiatives.

* Work effectively and ensure that food safety, authenticity, legality, and quality are maintained.

* Report any risks or any evidence of unsafe or out-of-specification product, equipment, packaging or raw materials, to a designated manager to enable the resolution of issues requiring immediate action.

**Education and/or Experience**
-------------------------------

WORK EXPERIENCES

* Minimum of 5 to 10 years’ experience in food manufacturing or processing industry

* 3 to 5 years’ experience in a management role overseeing multiple functions and disciplines

* Previous project management and / or project execution experience is expected.

* Strong technical knowledge of packaging and food processing systems

* Demonstrated experience managing and implementing Continuous improvement projects

* Excellent interpersonal and communications skills with abilities to lead, motivate and develop people

* Strong planning, analytical and organizational skills

 

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

* University degree in engineering, operations management or business preferred

**Essential Capabilities / Competencies**
-----------------------------------------

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY

* Responsible for overall direction and supervision of a 20 plus person workforce across two facilities.

 

ESSENTIAL CAPABILITIES (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES AND PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES)

* Strong leadership, organizational and communication skills in a cross-functional role.

* Excellent interpersonal relationship skills focusing on teamwork and collaboration within all levels of the business.

* Highly analytical yet comfortable using judgment to drive recommendations and decisions with imperfect information.

* Proficiency with MS Office a must. Experience with SAP a plus.

**Location of Role**
--------------------

LOCATION OF ROLE

Chicago, IL

 

This developmental role is part of a rotational program designed to build multi-site leadership capabilities and prepare the successful candidate to advance from smaller operations to a larger, more complex role within the ASR network at a refinery in Crockett, CA; New Orleans, LA; or Baltimore, MD.

Pay Range: $119,000 - $221,000

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other category protected under federal, state, or local law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

**Nearest Major Market:** Chicago

role.title: Senior Manager, Drug Substance Manufacturing Upstream
role.description:
**Why Join Us?**

*Be a hero for our rare disease patients*

At Ultragenyx, we fundamentally believe that taking real impactful action to care for the needs of patients and our people is always the right thing to do. To achieve this goal, our vision is to lead the future of rare disease medicine. For us, this means going where other biopharma companies won't go – challenging the status quo and creating a new model that advances our field so more patients and caregivers can benefit from life-changing treatments. We do this by following the science, applying a novel rapid development approach, making innovative medicines at fair and reasonable prices, and creating a collaborative ecosystem to reach patients in ways that are most meaningful for them.

Our commitment and care for patients extends to our people, so culture is an essential cornerstone for Ultragenyx. We remain continuously focused on creating a supportive and inclusive environment of profound learning and growth – so employees can thrive in all areas of their lives, in and outside of work. Ultimately, we want to be an organization where we would be proud for our family, friends and children to work.

If you want to have a meaningful impact, do the best work of your career, and grow a lot, both professionally and personally, come join our team*.*

### **Position Summary:**

***ultra****focused – Work together to fearlessly uncover new possibilities*

The Upstream Manufacturing Manager will report to the Sr. Director of Upstream Manufacturing. The role will be responsible for the supervision of a shift of 5 manufacturing technicians and Associates on a rotating pitman (every other weekend off) 12 hour schedule (7am-7pm). The roles primary focus will be on cell culture operations from vial thaw through to 2K operations for the production of viral particles for gene therapy products.

### **Work Model:**

Core Lab & Ops: This role typically requires that the majority of the work be conducted on-site.

**Responsibilities:** 
 
**Quality Systems:**

* Act as Area Lead for internal/external Audits as required, including hosting tours.

* Front room SME presenting for regulatory inspections.

* Drive the manufacturing review of the completed batch records per the release plan.

* Driver of all assigned quality system items (Deviations, CAPA, Change Control), SOPs, MBRs, Risk Assessments etc.

**Plant & Process:**

* Demonstrate ownership of the process to ensure that all resources (materials, personnel, documentation etc.) required for processing are available.

* Identify any Continuous Improvements to the process/equipment and drive through to completion any projects to which may be assigned.

* Ensure Business System Ownership (BSO) ownership of the equipment and facility is demonstrated at all times.

**Leadership:**

* Oversight and responsibility for technicians that report into the role, including compliance, training, safety and career development within Ultragenyx.

* The Manager will also be assigned as a "project lead" on higher level initiatives and expected to drive projects to completion in a highly collaborative manner in a matrix environment.

* Leader ensures a calm, strong and robust communications between all managers within Manufacturing and ensuring the appropriate dissemination of communications to support staff.

### **Requirements:**

* Ideally, degree in Engineering or Scientific Discipline, equivalent education/experience could be considered.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Plant manager will provide leadership and direction to ensure the continual, efficient and uniform operation which will meet or exceed customer expectations in a safe and orderly manner.
 
He/she will develop and implement plans coordinated with the Corporate Business Plan to increase the reliability and continually improve the quality and efficiencies of the products and services provided by the business unit.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Supervise branch production using RMAS Warehouse Management System and available Production Planning tools
* Develop plans and procedures to insure the safety of all employees and visitors of the warehouse and Clarify and correct any incorrect warehouse procedures
* Ensure operations and equipment is in compliance to corporate guidelines and OSHA Standards
* Verify inventory and make adjustments where necessary
* Hire, train and motivate warehouse employees to build bench strength and increase retention by scheduling and provide training for growth and compliance
* Maintain equipment to provide maximum availability and minimum down time
* Evaluate and recommend new equipment purchases to enhance quality, capabilities and productivity
* Communicate and monitor progress towards company safety, returns and allowances, and on time shipment and delivery directives
* Responsible for building maintenance and security
* Monitor quality and process improvement throughout the warehouse using SAP reports
* Ensure that preventive and corrective action methods are followed to eliminate or correct procedures and practices which do not meet customer requirements
* Follow progressive disciplinary action to adhere to policy and procedures
* Ensure adequate support of the sales department and its customers in a timely and orderly manner
* Assist with customer problems, including on-site visits where necessary
* Facilitate Lean practices in the Plant
* Purchase or direct the purchase of necessary warehouse supplies to insure the ability to comply with written work instructions and customer requirements
* Attend regional and corporate meetings when required
* Perform employee reviews as required
* Assist in contract negotiations, where applicable
* This is a position that works directly on the warehouse floor on or around heavy machinery
* Meets TKMNA Employee Attributes/Competencies

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirement for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

**This position has been identified as** **“safety sensitive”** **by thyssenkrupp under applicable laws. * Bachelor's degree preferred (in a Business, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Behavioral Science curriculum)
* Two years direct Warehouse Supervision or team leadership, experience
* Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Office application, Excel, Word, Access and PowerPoint a must
* An understanding of Basic Lean Manufacturing Principles

Preferred Requirements:

role.title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
role.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

role.description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team:**

**The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people.**

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction. We encourage anyone that wants to join us in our mission to apply.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance is responsible for new hire training, ongoing learning, knowledge management, and quality assurance across DJCS globally. You will report to the Vice President of Customer Support Operations and be based in our New Jersey office.

**You Will**

* Own and modernize curricula across DJCS, defining content, sequence, timing, delivery methods, and readiness standards to shorten time to proficiency and support development beyond initial onboarding. Coordinate Training-led modules and specialist instruction from hiring teams within the agreed plan.
* Lead the expansion of web-based, self-paced learning for onboarding and ongoing uptraining, combining it with live instruction, systems practice, and shadowing where appropriate.
* Improve knowledge accuracy, usability, adoption, and maintenance, and prepare the team, content, and working practices for AI-enabled tools.
* Lead the adoption and validation of automated quality management (AQM) across teams and contact types, establish standards for coaching and performance scoring, and redeploy human QA toward targeted investigation and improvement.
* Develop staff capabilities and close Consumer/B2B knowledge gaps through cross-training and shared responsibilities, identifying where tools or specialist support are needed.
* Manage training capacity and delivery, oversee curriculum standards and trainer quality across outsourcing partners, and extend product training and onboarding capability beyond DJCS.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, agree priorities and delivery commitments, and communicate progress and tradeoffs. Measure both program results and stakeholder feedback to ensure the team delivers effective support and a reliable partnership.

**Who you Are**

* You set a clear direction, challenge established approaches, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
* You are resourceful and persistent, working through obstacles and balancing change with daily operational demands.
* You develop people and deliver through others, setting clear expectations, building skills, and getting into the details when needed.
* You build stakeholder trust through responsiveness, honest communication, and follow-through.
* You use data, employee and stakeholder feedback, and testing to set priorities, make decisions, and measure results.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience managing a training or related performance improvement team in a contact center environment, including developing staff capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading changes to onboarding or ongoing learning, with measurable improvements in proficiency, productivity, and learning effectiveness.
* Experience leading blended learning development and delivery, including self-paced digital content, through internal teams or external specialists.
* Experience using quality evaluation or interaction analytics to identify performance gaps and measure the results of improvement initiatives.
* Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives against agreed commitments, supported by examples of effective stakeholder partnerships.
* Ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.
* Experience implementing or expanding AQM (preferred).

role.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance Ops Excellence and Resiliency
role.description:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Ops Excellence and Resiliency to build and lead the process improvement, operational resilience, and AI transformation capabilities for Last Mile Delivery (LMD) Risk Operations. This role will turn findings and opportunities identified through Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, incidents, and operational performance into redesigned workflows, stronger operating models, and scalable transformation roadmaps. The Senior Manager will bring a TPM/process driven mindset to simplify and standardize how work gets done, identify critical dependencies and failure points, strengthen contingency and readiness practices, and develop an AI transformation roadmap that rethinks how Risk Operations can operate—not simply make today’s manual steps faster. The role will partner across Risk Operations and with Product, Technology, Analytics, and other stakeholders to move validated opportunities from insight to sustainable operational change.

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build the Ops Excellence and Resiliency capability for Risk Operations, creating an integrated approach to process improvement, operational resilience, and technology-enabled transformation.
* Translate findings from Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, root cause analysis, incidents, and operational performance into a prioritized portfolio of process, resilience, automation, and AI transformation opportunities.
* Lead end-to-end process redesign by applying a TPM/process driven mindset to simplify, standardize, and optimize Risk Operations workflows, reducing unnecessary manual work, inefficient handoffs, failure points, and unclear ownership.
* Build an operational resilience model by identifying critical processes, dependencies, single points of failure, technology and data vulnerabilities, and contingency needs across Risk Operations.
* Develop dependency maps, contingency playbooks, and operational readiness practices in partnership with process owners to help critical incident and safety response capabilities continue through disruption.
* Develop and maintain the AI transformation roadmap for Risk Operations, identifying where AI can reshape intake, investigations, monitoring, analysis, decision support, reporting, and other workflows rather than simply automate individual manual steps.
* Evaluate and prioritize AI and automation opportunities based on operational value, feasibility, risk, scalability, and alignment to business needs, and translate validated opportunities into pilots and delivery roadmaps with Product and Technology partners.
* Partner with Incident Management, Safety, Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, Product, Technology, Analytics, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders to redesign workflows and implement sustainable improvements across organizational boundaries.
* Establish measures of success for transformation and resilience efforts, including cycle-time reduction, handoffs eliminated, process consistency, adoption, resilience readiness, recovery performance, and realized benefits from automation and AI-enabled changes.
* Create clear executive reporting and recommendations that show the improvement portfolio, resilience risks and readiness, AI transformation opportunities, implementation progress, dependencies, decisions required, and measurable outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in operational excellence, process engineering, continuous improvement, operational resilience, business continuity, technology transformation, program management, risk operations, or related fields.

role.title: Senior Manager Quality Compliance
role.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Senior Manager Quality Compliance**

**Working at Abbott** 
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists

**The Opportunity** 
This position works out of our Plymouth, MN location in the **Electrophysiology** division, we’re advancing the treatment of heart and vascular disease through breakthrough medical technologies, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

As the **Senior Manager Quality Compliance**, you’ll provide leadership for quality system compliance initiatives, audit readiness, regulatory change management, field actions, and quality compliance strategy across the EP business. This role leads teams and collaborates across functions to strengthen compliance capabilities, support inspections and audits, and drive continuous improvement

**What You’ll Work On**

* Lead quality compliance programs, including external audit support, inspection readiness activities, and quality system effectiveness initiatives.
* Develop and execute compliance strategies for the EP business, strengthening audit capability across sites and functions.
* Manage and support Health Hazard Evaluation (HHE), RRE/SRE, field action, and remediation activities to ensure timely and compliant execution.
* Assess industry trends, regulatory changes, and standards updates, implementing solutions that advance organizational compliance.
* Lead and mentor team members while partnering with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve compliance objectives.

Quality Management Systems/Compliance

* Support life cycle of external audits (ie. execution, preparation, completion, etc).
* Drive site audit readiness for FDA & NB
* Expand compliance capabilities to support IA
* Support Certificate Management and Finance Portfolio Management
* Manage HHE and Field Action Program
* Impact Analysis on Industry Trends
* Manage Field Action Strategy, as appropriate
* As needed, support regulation and standards change assessment

People Management & Strategy

* Lead diverse team to achieve compliance goals
* Develop compliance strategy for EP BU
* Develop audit capability across EP sites and functions
* Demonstrate Compliance Expertise through Leadership Behaviors

Lead Strategic Quality & Compliance Programs

* Develop and execute global quality and compliance strategies that align with divisional priorities and long-term business objectives.
* Build and manage program roadmaps, business cases, budgets, funding requests, and implementation plans for complex, multi-workstream initiatives.
* Establish meaningful partnerships across Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Commercial organizations to drive successful program execution.
* Present program strategies, progress updates, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

Strengthen Audit Readiness & Inspection Success

* Lead and support the lifecycle of external audits, including preparation, execution, response management, and follow-up activities.
* Drive ongoing inspection readiness across global sites, including preparedness for FDA, Notified Body, and other regulatory inspections.
* Partner with site and functional leaders to identify compliance gaps, implement remediation plans, and sustain inspection readiness programs.

Advance the Global Quality Management System

* Ensure effective implementation and governance of quality programs within the division's Quality Management System.
* Assess and manage impacts of evolving global regulations, standards, and industry expectations.
* Own and coordinate standards and regulation change management activities, including impact assessments and implementation plans.
* Support certificate management activities and external certification requirements.

Lead Compliance Improvement & Risk Reduction Efforts

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance compliance effectiveness, operational efficiency, and quality performance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, analytics, AI-enabled solutions, training programs, and process improvements.
* Monitor quality metrics, program effectiveness, and compliance trends to proactively mitigate risk.
* Manage and communicate program dashboards and executive-level reporting.

Support Critical Quality Events & Field Actions

* Provide leadership and support for field action strategies and implementation activities when required.
* Support Health Hazard Evaluation (HHE), Risk Review Evaluation (RRE), and Software Risk Evaluation (SRE) programs to ensure timely completion and compliance.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to effectively manage quality records, communications, and closure activities.

Develop a Culture of Quality

* Mentor and advise colleagues across the organization on compliant decision-making and quality best practices.
* Enhance organizational compliance capabilities through training, consultation, and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor industry trends and emerging compliance risks to help shape future quality strategies and organizational readiness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Industrial Technology, or a related field.
* 13+ years of combined experience in Quality, Compliance, Manufacturing Operations, Regulatory Affairs, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, cross-functional programs in a regulated industry.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and compliance processes.
* Previous management experience.
* Experience influencing stakeholders and driving results in a matrixed global organization.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-facing leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Medical device, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industry experience.
* Experience supporting FDA inspections, Notified Body audits, MDSAP, ISO standards, or related regulatory environments.
* International experience and/or foreign language proficiency.
* Experience with audit readiness programs, field actions, regulatory change management, and quality system governance.
* Strong analytical and business acumen with the ability to connect compliance requirements to operational and business outcomes

role.title: Sourcing Director: NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers
role.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

The Director, NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers leads strategic execution across new product introduction, acquired-business integration, and supplier/manufacturing transfer initiatives. This senior leader is accountable for ensuring products, processes, supply chains, and teams transition successfully from development, acquisition, or incumbent suppliers into stable, compliant, scalable operations. 
The role requires strong business judgment, deep supply-base knowledge, technical fluency, and the ability to lead complex programs in a regulated medical-device environment. The Director partners closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, R&D, Finance, Manufacturing Engineering, and leadership to deliver continuity of supply, cost competitiveness, product quality, and growth objectives. 
 
Reports to: Senior Director Procurement (Cost Center - M&A) 
Direct reports: Integration Program leaders, supplier-transfer leaders, NPI project managers, supplier development personnel

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

1. NPI Execution and Operational Readiness 

* Lead the end-to-end operational execution of New Product Introduction programs, from design-transfer planning through commercialization and sustained production.
* Establish integrated NPI execution plans & Ensure alignment between product development timelines and operational deliverables, including design transfer, process characterization, validation, supplier readiness, and product availability.
* Drive structured phase-gate governance with external suppliers , program reviews, escalation mechanisms, and executive decision-making for high-priority launches.

 
2. M&A Operations Integration 

* Serve as the Procurement lead for M&A integrations.
* Executes the integration for acquired companies for mitigation of supply-chain risk, supplier dependencies, tier-II management, partners with SQ team for quality-system maturity.
* Define and lead integration roadmaps for acquired businesses, including supplier onboarding, quality-system alignment, tier-II management and smooth transition to Contract manufacturing partner(s)
* Lead Procurement part of integration governance, ensuring milestones, decisions, risks, and accountabilities are visible and managed at the appropriate leadership level.

 
3. Supplier Transfer and Supply-Base Optimization 

* Lead complex supplier-transfer programs, including strategic sourcing transitions, supplier exits, dual-source strategies, vertical-integration initiatives, and manufacturing footprint changes.
* Develop transfer strategies that balance continuity of supply, quality, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, cost, capacity, and timing.
* Ensure supplier transfers are executed in accordance with applicable quality-system requirements, change-control processes, validation requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Direct supplier selection, qualification, technical transfer, process validation, first-article activities, production ramp-up, and supplier performance monitoring.

 
4. People Leadership and Organizational Capability 

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of program, technical, supply-chain, and supplier-management professionals.
* Set clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for direct reports.
* Build succession capability and strengthen organizational depth in NPI execution, technical operations, supplier transfer, and integration management.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration among teams with potentially competing objectives, timelines, and priorities.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

Leadership 

* Builds high-performing teams and develops future leaders.
* Establishes clarity, accountability, and disciplined execution
* Leads through ambiguity, organizational change, and competing business priorities.

Business Acumen 

* Connects technical and operational decisions to financial, customer, and enterprise outcomes.
* Evaluates strategic tradeoffs with an enterprise-wide perspective.
* Identifies opportunities for value creation, risk reduction, and sustainable growth.

Technical and Procurement Expertise 

* Understands manufacturing processes, product industrialization, supplier capabilities, process controls, validation, and quality-system expectations.
* Demonstrates strong command of supply-base dynamics, supplier economics, sourcing strategy, and operational risk.
* Can challenge technical assumptions constructively and facilitate fact-based decisions.

Program Execution 

* Drives complex initiatives from strategy through implementation and stabilization.
* Uses effective governance, metrics, risk management, and escalation practices.
* Maintains focus on customer service, quality, compliance, delivery, and financial results.

Influence and Collaboration 

* Builds credibility with senior leaders, technical experts, plant leadership, suppliers, and all other stakeholders.
* Resolves conflict constructively and aligns diverse stakeholders behind common objectives.
* Communicates complex issues in a concise, actionable manner.

**Your Background**
-------------------

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, or a related technical discipline.
* Approximately 20 years of progressive experience in medical devices, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, or another highly regulated industry.
* Hands on experience & leadership experience in one or more of the following areas:
* New Product Introduction and product industrialization
* Strategic Sourcing and Supplier Management
* Supplier Transfers or Manufacturing Transfers
* Mergers, Acquisitions, and Business Integration
* Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations Program Management
* Proven people-management experience, including leading managers and technical professionals in a matrixed global environment.
* Strong knowledge of supplier qualification, supplier development, capacity planning, quality agreements, process validation, and manufacturing transfer principles.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate and manage supply-base risk, including sole-source exposure, capacity constraints, supplier quality issues, and business-continuity risks.
* Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, cost analysis, budget ownership, and value-capture management.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting medical-device product launches and design-transfer activities.
* Experience integrating acquired companies, product portfolios, manufacturing sites, or supplier networks.
* Familiarity with regulated quality systems and supplier-control expectations.
* Experience with lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, operational excellence, or structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Experience leading global suppliers and geographically distributed teams.
* Professional certifications in program management, supply chain, quality, or lean methodologies are desirable.

role.title: Director, Operational Excellence and Innovation
role.description:
**Job Overview**

Citadel Credit Union is seeking a visionary leader to serve as Director of Operational Excellence & Innovation. This role will drive process improvement within the Experience & Retail team and will focus on enhancing current business processes within the team. This position will also focus on integrating new technologies within the organization, such as blockchain (DLT), smart contracts, and artificial intelligence into member and employee experience to drive efficiency, automation and service improvements. The Director will lead, collaborate, and influence the business to modernize workflows, automate processes, and position Citadel as a technology leader in retail financial services.

**What will I be doing?**

As a Director of Operational Excellence & Innovation, you will support Citadel’s Experience and Retail environments in meeting strategic initiatives for our members. The following tasks must be executed with high fidelity:

* Lead the design and implementation of emerging technologies to include blockchain and AI-powered automation solutions for retail operations.
* Act as liaison and collaborate with various lines of business, including EPMO, Digital & Transformation, and Retail Operations & Support.
* Coordinating of testing and implementing branch technology and compliance.
* Act as liaison between the team and internal/external partners to ensure successful deployment of system upgrades and enhancements.
* Manage team related vendor relationships.
* Oversee the development and deployment of smart contracts to automate efficiencies in member onboarding, KYC/AML/NRA compliance, transaction processing, and reporting.
* Identify, assess, and recommend blockchain platforms, smart contract frameworks, and AI vendors to support retail automation initiatives.
* Collaborates on system and workflow enhancements while acting as a vendor and system liaison.
* Manage pilot programs for new automation solutions, collect feedback, refine processes, and oversee full-scale deployment and staff training across team channels.
* Ensure all solutions meet regulatory requirements, maintain data immutability, and enhance fraud prevention through biometric and cryptographic security.
* Monitor system performance, optimize retail workflows, and implement enhancements based on analytics and stakeholder input.
* Develop and execute strategies to overcome resistance to technology adoption, including comprehensive staff training and phased implementation.

**What we are looking for?**

* 7+ years’ experience in process improvement, project management, or technology implementation in retail financial services.
* Bachelor's degree; MBA or advanced degree a plus
* Proven expertise in blockchain/DLT, smart contracts, and AI workflow automation.
* Strong understanding of KYC/AML/NRA compliance and regulatory reporting in retail banking.
* Experience with vendor selection and management for enterprise technology solutions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to analyze complex retail workflows and drive cross-functional collaboration.
* Familiarity with zero-trust architecture and Microsoft Azure AD integration.
* Experience with RPA tools and business process automation platforms.
* Knowledge of UTAUT, TPB, and TAM models for user technology adoption.

role.title: Senior Director, Operational Excellence Manager
role.description:
What We Need
 
Corpay is currently looking to hire a Senior Director, Operational Excellence Manager, within our Corpay Payables organization. In the role as a player coach, you will manage a team of operational excellence professionals and lead enterprise-wide initiatives that simplify operations, improve customer experience, accelerate business growth, and unlock the value of automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI). You will combine deep operational excellence expertise with a passion for digital transformation, Lean Six Sigma methodologies, AI-enabled process optimization, and organizational change. This individual thrives in ambiguity, influences across organizational boundaries, and delivers sustainable improvements that drive revenue, reduce costs, improve speed to market, and elevate performance. You will report to the VP, Operational Excellence and regularly collaborate with Operations, Product Management, Technology, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success to identify opportunities, challenge existing processes, and deliver innovative solutions that create measurable business value.
 
 
How We Work
 
As a Senior Director, Operational Excellence & AI Transformation, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
 

* Company-issued equipment + remote access
* Formal, hands-on training

Role Responsibilities
 
 
**The responsibilities of the role will include:** 
Enterprise Transformation
 
Lead strategic operational transformation initiatives across multiple business functions.
 
Partner with executive leadership to identify opportunities that improve revenue, reduce costs, improve customer experience, and increase operational scalability.
 
Serve as an internal consultant, providing recommendations supported by data, financial analysis, and business cases.
 
 
Process Excellence
 
Conduct discovery workshops, value stream mapping, and current-state assessments.
 
Lead Lean Six Sigma initiatives focused on eliminating waste, improving quality, and reducing operational complexity.
 
Establish future-state operating models that enable sustainable growth.
 
 
Artificial Intelligence & Automation
 
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, intelligent automation, workflow technologies, and digital capabilities to improve operational performance.
 
Develop business cases supporting AI investments, including expected ROI and productivity improvements.
 
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend scalable solutions.
 
Champion responsible AI adoption and establish best practices across operational teams.
 
 
Operational Readiness & Change Management
 
Lead operational readiness planning for strategic initiatives.
 
Develop implementation strategies, communications, training plans, and adoption metrics.
 
Partner with business leaders to ensure successful deployment and long-term sustainability.
 
 
Analytics & Business Performance
 
Establish baseline metrics and define measurable success criteria.
 
Design executive dashboards and KPI reporting.
 
Analyze operational trends and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
 
Measure post-implementation results to validate business outcomes.
 
 
Cross-Functional Leadership
 
Influence senior leaders without direct authority.
 
Facilitate executive workshops and strategic planning sessions.
 
Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Customer Success, and Sales.
 
 
Qualifications & Skills
 

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification (required).
* 12+ years of experience leading enterprise operational excellence, business transformation, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience applying Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, or intelligent automation to improve operational performance, enhance productivity, and deliver measurable business outcomes is required.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms (e.g., ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce, or similar) and the ability to identify and implement AI use cases within business operations strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading large cross-functional initiatives from strategy through implementation.
* Experience delivering measurable business outcomes including cost reduction, revenue acceleration, productivity improvements, or customer experience enhancements.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience building business cases supported by financial analysis and operational metrics.

Artificial Intelligence & Digital Skills
 
 
**Required experience with one or more of the following:** 

* Generative AI (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce, Gemini, Claude, etc.)
* AI-assisted business process redesign
* Intelligent workflow automation
* AI productivity tools
* AI prompt engineering
* Digital transformation initiatives

**Preferred experience:** 

* Process mining
* Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
* Workflow automation platforms
* Salesforce ecosystem
* Business Intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications
 

* PMP certification
* Master's degree (MBA or related field)
* Experience in Financial Services, Payments, SaaS, or FinTech
* Knowledge of Operational Readiness methodologies
* Experience with customer experience transformation initiatives

Benefits & Perks
 

* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire
* Automatic enrollment into our 401k plan (subject to eligibility requirements)
* Virtual fitness classes offered company-wide
* Robust PTO including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, and volunteer time
* Employee discounts with major providers (wireless, gym, car rental, etc.)
* Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations
* Fun culture with the company

About Corpay
 
 
Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.
 
At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.
 
As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.
 
**Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:** Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions.
 
**Learn more about Corpay:** https://www.corpay.com
 
 
Transparency & Compliance
 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer
 
Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. If you require reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.
 
 
Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring
 
Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes.
 
 
Candidate Privacy Notice
 
For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice: https://www.corpay.com/privacy-policy.
 
 
Pay Philosophy
 
Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable.

role.title: Vice President of Operations
role.description:
At Emmi Roth, we’re passionate about creating exceptional cheeses. As a leader in the specialty cheese industry, we blend traditional craftsmanship with innovation. Our commitment to local sourcing and quality makes us a trusted brand in the food industry.

Joining Emmi Roth means becoming part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and a shared dedication to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the finest cheeses in the world while contributing to a company that prides itself on both heritage and progress. If you're passionate about food, craftsmanship, and making an impact, we’d love for you to be a part of our journey!

**Summary** 
The Vice President of Operations serves as a core member of Emmi Roth’s Executive Leadership Team, shaping and advancing the enterprise’s operational agenda across all manufacturing sites. This role defines the long-term Operations vision, aligns enterprise strategy with operational priorities, and ensures sustained, world-class performance across safety, quality, service, cost, and sustainability.

Operating with full executive authority within established governance frameworks, the Vice President of Operations partners closely with the VP of Supply Chain to jointly steward end-to-end value chain outcomes, balancing performance, resilience, and growth.

**Duties and Responsibilities** 
**Executive Accountability & Scope** 

* Enterprise-wide accountability for operational outcomes across all manufacturing facilities, including safety, quality, service, productivity, cost, and ESG outcomes
* Strategic leadership of the Operations function, establishing strategic direction, enterprise priorities, and performance frameworks that enable long-term success
* Oversight of manufacturing, production, employee safety, food safety, maintenance, engineering, R& D and operational excellence capabilities, with full decision authority across these domains
* Ownership of the Operations P&L, including financial performance, capital allocation, and long-range investment strategy, with authority to direct resources within approved plans
* Definition and advancement of a multi-year Operations strategy aligned with Emmi Roth and Emmi Group objectives
* Enterprise accountability for compliance, risk management, and governance across food safety, quality, regulatory, environmental, and employee safety standards
* Strategic partnership with the VP of Supply Chain to co-own value chain performance, aligning trade-offs and outcomes across service, cost, inventory, and supply continuity
* Leadership of organizational capability, including leadership and development, succession planning, and leadership pipeline development within Operations

**Executive Leadership and Responsibilities** 

* Active contributor to enterprise strategy and decision-making as a member of the Executive Leadership Team
* Drives and owns organizational design and functional maturity, ensuring the Operations organization evolves in line with business growth and complexity
* Strategic liaison with Emmi Group Supply Chain leadership, ensuring alignment, transparency, and global integration
* Executive sponsor of capital strategy, manufacturing network evolution, automation, and digital transformation initiatives, with authority aligned to enterprise investment governance
* Executive representative of Operations with internal and external stakeholders, reinforcing credibility, influence, and enterprise alignment

**Strategic & Operational Leadership** 

* Translate enterprise strategy into integrated operational priorities, roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes
* Leverage data, insights, and forward-looking indicators to anticipate risk, identify opportunity, and guide enterprise-level decisions
* Champion enterprise initiatives, including continuous improvement, advanced manufacturing, automation, and productivity acceleration
* Establish and uphold enterprise-wide performance systems, ensuring transparency, rigor, and accountability at all levels
* Foster a culture grounded in safety, quality, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Provide leadership in navigating complex, cross-functional challenges, ensuring alignment and decisive, enterprise-level resolution

 
**Qualifications** 
Required qualifications, skills, and experience for the job; education background, certifications, relevant work experience, technical skills, and soft skills. 

* Degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related discipline
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred, or comparable experience
* Extensive senior leadership experience within Operations, preferably in complex manufacturing environments
* Demonstrated success within food manufacturing
* Proven accountability for operational P&L performance and capital investment strategy
* Track record of leading enterprise transformation and large-scale operational initiatives
* Fluency in English required; additional languages advantageous

**Competency Profile** 

* Enterprise-oriented leader with the ability to balance strategic vision and operational depth
* Decisive, outcomes-focused leader with demonstrated ownership and accountability for outcomes in complex environments
* Collaborative value chain leader, adept at aligning cross-functional priorities and delivering integrated results
* Exceptional developer of talent, with a focus on leadership capability, succession, and organizational effectiveness
* High degree of leadership presence, emotional intelligence, and resilience, with the ability to influence at all levels

**Benefits** 

* Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
* Basic Life Insurance
* Voluntary Life Insurance
* Flexible spending accounts & Health Savings Accounts
* 401k Retirement Plan
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Vacation
* Employee Assistance Program
* Short term/Long term disability
* Volunteer time off (VTO)
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Pet insurance

**The Best Cheese Moments are EMMI ROTH Moments!**
