role.title: VP of Commercial Operations
role.description:
About Us:

Flow Control Group (FCG) is a leading provider of fluid handling, process, and industrial automation solutions across North America. We are a 100% employee-owned organization made up of over 3,000 team members and 115+ entrepreneurial brands, each empowered to think big, move fast, and bring innovative ideas to life.

At FCG, we believe in the power of partnership and entrepreneurship. We work collaboratively across our brands to drive growth, unlock new opportunities, and deliver real impact for our customers, combining local expertise with national strength.

Visit our Website: flowcontrolgroup.com

Job Description:

**Position Overview**

The Vice President of Commercial Operations is a critical enterprise leadership role responsible for driving revenue growth, commercial discipline, and operational excellence across a decentralized network of industrial distribution brands. This leader serves as the connective tissue between the corporate commercial strategy and the front-line selling organizations, translating strategy into execution across 10 Technology Groups (TGs) without disrupting the entrepreneurial culture that makes each brand within the TGs successful.

This is not a role for someone who manages from a dashboard. The right leader spends time in the field, builds relationships with technology groups, commercial leaders, brand leaders, and sellers, and earns the trust of decentralized operators by demonstrating commercial credibility. At the same time, they must be able to proficiently articulate a clear, data-driven commercial narrative to executive leadership.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution and reports directly to the EVP, Commercial Operations. This position owns the commercial operating system (Salesforce) and metrics architecture (pipeline, bookings, win rates). The position will work closely with teams focused on pricing, cross-selling leadership, and strategic/national account programs while enabling each brand to run its own P&L with autonomy.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

1. Commercial Strategy & Revenue Growth

* Partner with brand, commercial, and technology group leaders to set growth targets, identify whitespace opportunities, and build actionable territory plans.
* Support cross-selling initiatives by jointly developing tools, incentives, training, and coordination structures that enable multi-brand selling without disrupting brand autonomy.
* Build and maintain the commercial calendar, including QBRs, pipeline reviews, seller performance reviews, and board-level commercial updates.
* Work directly with brands to define and implement actions to pursue new and emerging markets and customers.

2. Salesforce CRM Ownership & Commercial Operations

* Own the Salesforce platform(s) as the commercial operating system, focusing on adoption, data quality, pipeline integrity, and continuous improvement.
* Drive Salesforce adoption across 100+ brands, from onboarding through advanced usage. Build a culture where sellers see CRM as a tool that helps them win, not a reporting burden.
* Work with the Commercial Operations team to design and maintain the pipeline architecture, including stage definitions and opportunity hygiene standards that support forecasting methodology.
* Build and deliver the commercial reporting suite for field and management teams, including weekly pipeline reports, monthly bookings dashboards, quarterly board presentations, and ad hoc analytics for leadership.
* Partner with IT and Salesforce administrators to evaluate, implement, and optimize new capabilities, such as CPQ integration, seller mapping, Marketing Cloud integration, and AI-assisted selling tools.
* Ensure data integrity and consistency across brands by establishing and maintaining standardized account hierarchies, contact management, and activity logging to support cross-brand visibility.

3. Seller Performance & Enablement

* Build and manage the seller performance framework. Develop and implement common practices for quota setting, attainment tracking, performance tiering, and accountability structures across a decentralized organization.
* Partner with HR and brand leadership to identify, develop, and retain top commercial talent. This includes succession planning for key sales leadership roles and building a pipeline of future sellers and sales leaders.
* Design and deploy seller enablement programs. Work closely with Learning and Development on product training, competitive positioning, value-based consultative sales methodology, and Salesforce proficiency.
* Establish a coaching culture through field ride-alongs, joint customer calls, and quarterly seller reviews that combine data with direct observation.
* Build and track leading indicators of seller health, including activity levels, pipeline creation rates, win rates by category, and new logo acquisition trends.
* Identify and develop a President's Club structure. Establish the KPIs required for qualification, administration, and ongoing management. Through this program, work closely with the field to build a world-class sales organization.

4. Management Reporting

* Prepare and present commercial updates to the FCG Leadership Team and private equity commercial sponsors, including monthly commercial operating reviews and market context.
* Develop and maintain the commercial KPI framework and utilize metrics that provide an accurate picture of business performance, including early-warning bookings indicators that surface issues before they become problems.
* Partner with the CFO, Operations, and Finance teams to align commercial forecasting with financial projections. Ensure the commercial pipeline translates accurately into revenue and margin guidance.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* 15+ years of progressive commercial leadership and direct sales experience, with at least 5 years in a VP or Director-level role with broad commercial scope.
* Experience operating within a decentralized, multi-brand, or multi-location industrial distribution, manufacturing, or services organization. Must have the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Deep Salesforce proficiency, not only as a user but as a platform owner. Extensive experience driving adoption, building reporting architecture that meets field needs, and managing CRM as a commercial operating system across a complex organization.
* Demonstrated track record of building and scaling commercial operations infrastructure from the ground up. Proven sales management success leading commercial teams that have successfully built pipeline frameworks, seller performance systems, and cross-selling capabilities.
* Strong financial acumen and the ability to construct a revenue bridge from pipeline generation (coverage models/bowling charts), model pricing and volume impacts from system KPIs, and communicate credibly with FCG leadership.
* Experience presenting to private equity sponsors or public company boards. Systems and processes built must be capable of supporting publicly traded company performance standards within 3–5 years.
* Industrial distribution, specialty distribution, or industrial services background strongly preferred. Clear and demonstrated understanding of buying motions, customer types, and channel dynamics of MRO and project-based industrial selling.
* Ability to leverage data to identify and build a team of sellers capable of progressing from Level 1 to Level 4 management structures, demonstrating proficiency in sales engagement processes, and partnering with the Strategic Accounts team to secure multi-site, large, complex deals.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in a private equity-backed platform business, including an understanding of value creation plans, EBITDA management, and the commercial levers that drive enterprise value.
* Strategic accounts or national accounts leadership experience.
* Cross-selling or integrated solutions selling experience in a multi-brand or multi-product environment.
* Familiarity with industrial end markets, including:

 + Energy
 + Power generation
 + Aerospace
 + EPC / Construction
 + Food & Beverage
 + Water / Wastewater
 + Automotive
 + Industrial manufacturing
 + Pulp & Paper
 + Data centers
* Experience with eCommerce in an industrial or B2B context, including the ability to promote and integrate eCommerce into sellers' daily workflows to maximize sales opportunities.
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree in business, engineering, or a related field.

Description:

### **JOB SUMMARY:**

The General Manager reports directly to the President and leads the Watertown, Connecticut location. This role translates company strategy into daily execution and is accountable for site performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, employee engagement, and customer satisfaction.

As a member of the Leadership Team, the General Manager establishes operational controls, reporting systems, and performance expectations to improve profitability, workforce development, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term business sustainability. The role collaborates with Sales, Finance, Engineering, Human Resources, Quality, and Operations across locations.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

#### **Operational Leadership & Strategy:**

* Lead daily site operations and align departmental priorities, resources, and execution with company strategy.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and monitor performance indicators for safety, quality, on-time delivery, labor efficiency, inventory accuracy, first-pass yield, productivity, and profitability.
* Use operational reports and dashboards to identify performance gaps, assign corrective actions, and monitor results.

#### **Process & Financial Performance:**

* Manage site operational budgeting, labor planning, cost controls, and financial performance in collaboration with Finance and within approved authority.
* Lead initiatives to reduce waste, improve workflow, standardize processes, and apply lean manufacturing principles.
* Coordinate production priorities and resource planning across departments and locations to support customer commitments.
* Evaluate and implement approved technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve efficiency and reduce non-value-added work.

#### **Safety, Quality & Customer Collaboration:**

* Manage and continuously improve the site safety program in coordination with designated company resources; ensure adherence to applicable company policies and safety and environmental requirements.
* Ensure site adherence to applicable quality management systems and ISO requirements; support audits, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Quality, and customer-facing teams to address customer needs, delivery commitments, product quality, and issue resolution.

#### **Leadership & Talent Development:**

* Lead and mentor department managers and operational leaders to improve accountability, consistency, and professional development.
* Develop succession plans and leadership development initiatives to strengthen organizational depth and business continuity.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee

Requirements:

### **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide site-level leadership and oversight of department managers and operational leaders within the assigned reporting structure.
* Establish performance expectations, provide regular feedback, and assess development needs in coordination with Human Resources and company leadership.

### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

#### **Required Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong business acumen and understanding of manufacturing operations, finance, quality systems, supply chain, customer service, sales support, and workforce management.
* Ability to lead operational change, build trust, and develop accountability and employee engagement across organizational levels.
* Proficiency in manufacturing metrics, operational reporting, financial analysis, and cost controls.
* Experience implementing process improvements, lean manufacturing initiatives, and operational standardization.
* Ability to use ERP/MRP systems, reporting tools, and other business systems to improve operational effectiveness.

#### **Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field preferred, but not required.

role.title: Director, Filling & Assembly
role.description:
At Revlon, we create beauty innovations for everyone that inspire confidence and ignite joy every day.

Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company's DNA. Since its game-changing launch of the first opaque nail enamel in 1932 (and later, the first long-wear foundation), Revlon has provided consumers with high-quality product innovation, performance, and sophisticated glamour. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand.

Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world's most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more.

We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers.

We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty.

**This role is an Onsite Role:** This role requires full-time presence at our Oxford, NC office.

**Overview:**

* Responsible for the safe and efficient operation of the Oxford Filling and Assembly operation – may include multiple cost centers (or all). Specific responsibilities include Ensuring that the workplace is safe, and employees work in a safe manner; Provide that all GMP requirements and regulations are complied with; Ensuring that all people issues and developmental needs are met; monitoring production requirements such that all customer needs are met on a timely basis; Responsible for all financial results of the operation.
* Act as a backup to the Vice President of Manufacturing (as needed) and the Oxford site General Manager (as needed). Be aware of any major issues/action underway in other cost centers / production areas in order to fill in as needed.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Safety:** Ensure that a safe workplace is maintained at all times. Provide resources necessary to be proactive towards addressing issues in the workplace. Comply with all OSHA & Revlon guidelines and procedures. Assist Safety Director as needed with task forces, projects and teams. Measures: Safety incident rate; OSHA & Workmen's comp rates; Revlon Safety Index.
* **People:** Strive to make the Oxford site a great place to work by: proactively developing people (cross training, class work and challenges); Addressing all issues, concerns and disciplinary actions promptly and effectively; contributing to site efforts to address issues and concerns. Measures: GPTW survey results; Developmental activity; providing challenges & changes to drive the organization forward.
* **GMP / Regulatory:** Ensure that all Revlon & Governmental Good Manufacturing Practices are complied with. Provide resources necessary to address any issues before the operation is adversely affected. Work with the site Quality Director (and others – as needed) to implement any new requirements due to new products or new regulations. Provide / facilitate training as needed. Ensure that all appropriate records are accurate and maintained within guidelines. Measures: First pass yields, rejection rates (domestic and international); GMP audit scores.
* **Customer Service:** Ensure that all Customer requirements (domestic, international & special markets) are met per company objectives (Regular business forecast & Promotional commitments). Evaluate production needs on a forward basis to ensure that needed equipment and people resources are available to meet the customer's needs. Measures: Schedule adherence; % Dollars shipped vs. ordered (CSL); performance to promotional ship on time commitments.
* **Financial:** Responsible for all financial aspects of the Filling and Assembly operation: Control of Labor – Direct (productive effort); Indirect (support effort); Nonstandard (Rework & First pass yield issues); Material – performance to established standards & minimization of waste; Overhead – effective utilization of management staff, supplies and ancillary equipment; Capital – effective, proactive utilization of installed equipment base, addressing capacity and new product needs with adequate lead time to meet customer's needs. Support and facilitate site cost reduction objectives. Measures: Labor – Direct efficiency, indirect % to earned, nonstandard % to earned; Material – MUV; Overhead – performance to budget & tasks.
* + Overhead – Supplies, executive staff, support labor – Up to $14 Million annually
 + Material – Value of material moved through the filling and assembly operation - $250 Million annually
 + Labor – Direct Labor managed in the filling and assembly operation - $30 Million annually

**Responsible for establishing processes to:**

* Ensure that all employees in the operation have defined job duties and expectations and are managed according to those duties – and that timely corrective action takes place when needed.
* Ensure that reasonable schedules are formulated, meeting customer's needs and equipment capability. Interface with appropriate departments as needed to affect change.
* Ensure that all equipment is operational and performs within expected tolerances.
* Ensure that all Revlon and governmental policies, guidelines, rules and procedures are followed and adhered to.
* Interface with all other sites functional areas as needed (HR, Quality, Distribution, Finance, etc.)

**Qualifications:**

* Extensive knowledge of production equipment, especially safe operating techniques, product capabilities and trouble-shooting methods
* Knowledge of planning / scheduling forecasting processes and systems
* Knowledge and experience with operations in an FDA – GMP environment
* Significant communication skills – verbal and written
* High level ability to analyze situations, and ability to facilitate cross functional teams
* Demonstrated success in people development and driving an organization forward
* Basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and use of MRP systems
* Prefer a 4-year degree in an engineering discipline, but other areas of study will be considered with appropriate and relevant experience
* Minimum 15 years of experience required
* Ability to make decisions
* Ability to effectively set and enforce company policy affecting up to 2,500 employees – communicate changes and issues to said group
* Significant operating knowledge of the Cosmetic industry – products, equipment and business practices
* Knowledge of Customer / Supplier relationships and how to best manage those to get results

Shift hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm

role.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Rensselaer

* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Senior Manager Quality Control (QC) Lab Operations to support our teams at our new highly automated drug substance manufacturing facility. The Senior Manager, QC Lab Operations leads a team who supports the technical and operational lifecycle of assigned QC laboratories, including new lab builds, fit-outs, relocations; new technology implementation; and continuous capability upgrades. The role sets strategy for lab operations, accounting for testing demand, equipment utilization, capacity, sample and data flow, and staffing. They partner with internal partners to resolve cross-functional conflicts and schedule, resource, and compliance risks. The role ensures changes meet FDA cGMP requirements and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Represents the team during regulatory inspections and internal audits. Oversees hiring, training, performance management, and development of team members while standardizing lab implementation practices across sites.

**When & where:**

* Location: Rensselaer, New York, United States
* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
* Travel: 50% domestic- mostly capital region

**Discover your role:**

* Lead and develop a larger team, own organizational design, headcount planning, and workforce strategy for QC lab technology and facilities delivery
* Build the leadership pipeline through talent calibration and stretch assignments; set the competency framework managers apply, and hold them accountable for team performance, coaching quality, and employee relations outcomes
* Ensure training compliance and a site-wide skills strategy (equipment qualification, CSV, LIMS and CDS integration, GMP authorship); identify capability gaps
* Lead the integrated portfolio of lab builds, technology implementations, and upgrades, with accountability for capital and project spend, schedule, and resource allocation
* Set prioritization criteria, balance resources across managers’ portfolios, and resolve cross-portfolio conflicts; sponsor business cases and scope trade-off recommendations tied to site strategy
* Serve as QC’s design authority for lab technology delivery; set standards for URS content, assay-to-space and material flow design, and lab bus, LIMS, and CDS integration so data integrity is designed in rather than remediated later
* Represent QC Lab Operations at executive and cross-functional forums on design, vendor strategy, and value engineering; own the QC position on any scope reduction
* Act as senior escalation points for critical issues during installation, FAT and SAT, qualification, and post-handover support; make risk-based decisions with Engineering, QA, and IT
* Accountable for deliverable compliance with cGMP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and site data integrity requirements; define the quality gates managers apply before QA review
* Lead all aspects of change control, deviation, and CAPA performance; set expectations for investigation quality and closure timeliness; own the data integrity gap assessment and remediation roadmap, reporting progress to QC and QA leadership
* Serve as senior spokesperson in regulatory inspections and internal audits; prepare managers and SMEs to defend qualification and implementation records
* Set standard templates, work instructions, and delivery methods across all project types, and institutionalize lessons learned into standards, planning assumptions, and vendor strategy
* Partner with QC and site leadership on the multi-year technology roadmap, assessing automation, sample management, and digital integration against projected demand
* Define the function’s performance metrics (on-time breakthrough delivery, right-first-time qualification, post-handover issue rate) and use trends to drive resource, process, and make investment decisions

**This role requires:**

* BS/BA in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering or a related field and 8+ years of experience
* Previous people leadership/ supervisory experience
* Led, or held a core role on, a build, relocation, major fit-out, or significant technology implementation from requirements through handover
* Experience supporting GMP inspections or internal audits, including presenting and defending records

Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

Sunbelt Rentals strives to be the customer's first choice in the equipment rental industry. From pumps to scaffolding to general construction tools, we aim to be the only call needed to outfit a job site with the proper equipment. Not only do we offer a vast fleet that ranks among the best in the industry, we pair it all with a friendly and knowledgeable staff. Our employees are our greatest asset, and although we present a comprehensive equipment offering, our expertise and service are what truly distinguish us from the competition.

We pride ourselves on investing in our workforce and offer competitive benefits, as well as extensive on-the-job training for all eligible employees.

As a highly successful national company, we are constantly looking for talented individuals to support our growth. If you are interested in pursuing a rewarding career, we invite you to review our opportunities!

**Job Description Summary**

Position Objective: 
The General Manager, Manufacturing oversees all aspects of manufacturing processes to ensure proven product functionality with a sustainable return on investment (ROI). The General Manager Manufacturing manages subordinate staff and coordinates with remote departments that are responsible for engineering development and manufacturing engineering. This candidate must have proven supervisory and technical skills, and an appreciation for the complex nature of the rental HVAC industry. Personal skills that will be required include exceptional business foresight, superlative communication skills, working knowledge of several engineering disciplines and how they relate to one another, and an aptitude for managing risk.

Position Responsibilities: 

* Develops and promotes a “Zero Harm Safety Culture” leveraging Sunbelt’s Engage for Life Safety programs, fine tuning safety policy as it relates to manufacturing operations
* Has overall financial responsibility of local manufacturing operation, inventory, budgeting, cost controls, capital equipment acquisition and manufacturing facilities
* In partnership with senior management, develops and implements manufacturing plans support growth, safety and manufacturing efficiencies
* Develops the manufacturing management team, inspiring leadership through empowerment, coaching and accountability
* Develops manufacturing forecast and roughcut capacity plans
* Communicates with fleet planning, coordinating changing priorities and product deliveries
* Utilizes proven continuous improvement strategies to refine manufacturing processes and products, that minimize scrap, reduce rework & line failures and has emphasis on building the highest quality equipment at the lowest costs
* Establishes, implements, and maintains administrative policies, procedures, and standards
* Ensures production facility adheres to all local, national laws, including labor and environmental
* Develops long-term strategic initiatives for manufacturing operations
* Maintains knowledge of new trends, developments, technologies, materials, and best practices; applies this knowledge to continually improve product lines and production efficiency

Requirements: 
Education & Experience: 

* Degree in Business Administration or a related field
* 5+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operation (metal fabrication & production assembly environments experience preferred)
* Possesses knowledge and understanding of manufacturing processes and systems, engineering systems, and product inventory management, manufacturing accounting and ERP systems
* Analytical and mathematical mind, capable of evaluating and solving various complex problems
* Leadership skills necessary to manage several experienced and driven teams, including proven supervisory and technical skills
* Self-motivated attitude with the ability to multitask and thrive in a timeline-driven environment
* Interpersonal communication skills with expertise in distilling complicated topics to a broader

Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. Please visit https://www.sunbeltrentals.com/careers/ for more information on our benefits and to join our Talent Network. 
 
Sunbelt also provides a comprehensive benefits package to its full-time employees. This package includes:

* Health, Dental and Vision plans
* 401(k) Match
* Volunteer time off
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Accident, Life and Travel insurance, as well as flexible spending
* Tuition Reimbursement Options

You will become eligible for benefits on the first of the month following 30 days from your start date. Sunbelt offers team members the following paid time off from work, subject to Sunbelt’s policies (unless specified in a collective bargaining agreement):

* 5 sick days
* 6 holidays

* 1 inclusion day
* 1 volunteer day

role.title: Senior Manager, Test Operations
role.description:
Application close date:
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed. 
 At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!    
 
 
This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities. 
 
 We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety and operational excellence. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable space flight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin’s vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.
 The Sr. Manager, Test Operations role is responsible for leading the GEEx engine test stand near Van Horn, Texas. The Sr. Manager is a leader of passionate team of engineers and technicians who perform testing on our LH2 and LOX engine. The Sr. Manager works closely with all Blue Origin business units developing tests to develop and qualify in-space fluid and engine systems. The Sr Manager integrates with Test Operations senior leaders and support organizations to plan, prepare, and conduct test operations on a multi-cell test stand safely and efficiently. The Sr. Manager is responsible for effectively planning and leading all aspects of capital, overhead and labor budgets, and managing capital improvement projects. Effective communications and long term planning are vital to a successful Sr. Manager.
 We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!
 Management Responsibilities: 
 Lead the team at the Giant Engine Experiment (GEEx) test stand to include recruiting, training, coaching, mentoring, developing, and retaining talent by following and developing performance management processes.
 Promote teamwork, employee engagement, and good employee morale.
 Be an exemplar of Blue Leadership Principles, focusing on demonstrating operational excellence.
 Maintain employee training and development records.
 Demonstrate high standards in test operations and work cooperatively with a team of Responsible Engineers, Test Ops counterparts from other test stands, maintenance, Quality Specialists, and other team members to ensure requirements are met.
 Assist in the preparation of regular programmatic reports to help communicate inwards and outwards across the organization.
 Prepare quantitative strategic plans to ensure the targets are met, and leverage team skills and capabilities to implement and supervise progress against the plans.
 Lead capital, overhead, and labor budget planning and execution.
 Engineering Responsibilities: 
 Establish the technical direction for the GEEx test engineering team.
 Develop and implement test plans and procedures; perform subsequent data reduction and reviews.
 Lead the team in the design, planning, fabrication, installation, and operation of test facilities to the unique requirements from business unit customers
 Lead daily test operations, , direct technician work and coordinate with internal customers
 Understand and solve issues in fluid and instrumentation systems.
 Perform root cause analysis and failure investigations, lead implementation of corrective actions or continuous improvement projects
 Perform process hazard analyses (PHA)..
 Perform schedule and cost estimation and management.
 Find opportunities for safety improvements and cost savings.
 Align with and improve processes for test stand configuration management.
 Qualifications: 
 BS degree in engineering or related field
 3+ years as a manager or lead of a technical team
 12+ years in an operations environment in large industry, petrochemical, or aerospace facilities
 Strong background in fluid dynamics and thermodynamics
 Strong project management, and team leadership
 Outstanding technical and non-technical writing and verbal skills
 Demonstrated leadership in establishing a high performing safety culture
 Demonstrated habitual drive to correct errors at their root and not pass them downstream
 Demonstrated experience in setting high standards of performance and holding teams accountable
 Demonstrated effectiveness in implementing continuous improvement to improve processes, methods and practices
 Demonstrated effectiveness in conflict-resolution and an ability to bring a group to a decision
 Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum
 Desired: 
 Demonstrated technical expertise in cryogenic test design and operations.
 Demonstrated technical expertise in liquid rocket engine test stand design, operation, and maintenance
 Previous experience operating in Process Safety Management (PSM) environment
 Knowledge of fabrication and integration processes, systems engineering and quality control practices
 MS in engineering or PMP certification
 


 Culture Statement 
 Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

 Export Control Regulations 
 Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

 Background Check 
 Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
 Required for Certain Job Profiles:  Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
 Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
 Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical
 
 Benefits 
 Benefits include:  Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
 Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
 Paid Time Off:  Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
 Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details. 
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here .

 Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation 
 Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at  EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com . Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

Working at Freudenberg: We will wow your world! 
 
 
 Responsibilities: 
 
 
 Lead, coach, and develop the Quality team, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
 Maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensure compliance with ISO and IATF standards .

 Strong communicator with confidence, urgency, and the ability to influence others.
 Experience in nonwovens/textiles, medical, pharmaceutical, or automotive manufacturing preferred.
 Bachelor’s degree required; Engineering or Business preferred.

 At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. 

 Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

 The LADS SBU is seeking an Execution Production Chief Engineer (P5) to support technical execution for the LTAMDS (Lower Tier Air and Missile Defense Sensor) Production program. LTAMDS is a Raytheon franchise program delivering next‑generation radar capability with 360‑degree coverage to counter advanced threats, including hypersonic weapons. This role reports to the Production Chief Engineer and supports the LTAMDS Sub‑Strategic Business Unit (SSBU) Office of the Chief Engineer (OCE). The Execution Production CE assists with daily technical oversight across design, development, production, and delivery of LTAMDS production units and variants. This role focuses on disciplined execution, issue resolution, technical coordination, and maintaining alignment with program goals. This is an on‑site position located in Andover, MA.

 What You Will Do 
 Support execution of the product vision, technical strategy, and goals to meet program and customer milestones; assist in resolving technical conflicts.
 Ensure technical integrity and rigor across engineering execution for production efforts, meeting cost, schedule, and technical requirements.
 Serve as a technical point of contact for internal program leadership and customer engineering stakeholders as delegated by senior CE leadership.
 Contribute to new business activities, including technical inputs to proposals and influencing product roadmaps aligned with program planning.
 Drive continuous improvement within the production environment through participation in Failure Review Boards, FRACAS, and related activities.
 Coordinate technical engagement with subcontractors and partners to ensure product deliverables meet requirements.
 Lead and mentor teams of multi‑discipline engineers in resolving production and design issues.
 Travel domestically up to 25% to support hardware, test, supplier, and program activities; occasional international travel may be required.
 
 Qualifications You Must Have 
 Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math (STEM) and a minimum of 10 years of prior relevant engineering experience.
 Experience supporting system development activities such as trade studies, requirements development, integration, test, or production support.
 Experience driving engineering execution, including developing work plans and coordinating cross‑functional activities.
 Experience leading engineering teams or task forces and supporting proposals or EAC activities.
 Experience managing or influencing work associated with multi‑million‑dollar budgets.
 Active and transferable Secret U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date. U.S. citizenship is required as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.
 
 Qualifications We Prefer 
 Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar technical discipline.
 Experience with radar systems, radar subsystems, or related sensor components.
 Familiarity with formal Technical Data Package (TDP) release processes.
 Strong communication, technical writing, and presentation skills.
 Experience supporting or executing complex system design and development activities.
 Demonstrated experience across the product lifecycle including concept, design, integration, verification, and production.
 Experience working with Department of Defense and/or commercial customers, including requirements interpretation and stakeholder engagement.
 Ability to cultivate strong customer relationships to support program success.
 Experience with Engineering Risk & Opportunity management.
 Master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
 Experience supporting technical dispositions related to Export/Import (EXIM).
 
 What We Offer 
 Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
 Relocation Eligibility– Relocation assistance is available.
 
 Learn More & Apply Now! 
 Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role. Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
 This position requires a security clearance. DCSA Consolidated Adjudication Services (DCSA), an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. More information about Security Clearances can be found on the US Department of State government website here: https://www.state.gov/m/ds/clearances/c10978.htm

 As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote. 
 
The salary range for this role is 145,600 USD - 276,800 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills. 
 
 
Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. 
 
Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance. 
 
This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply. 
 
RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

role.title: Director of Quality Assurance
role.description:
**Corporate Overview**

Aluris Sciences is a contract manufacturing organization (CMO) headquartered in Carlsbad, CA with over 50,000 square feet of manufacturing space. The company is dedicated to serving highly innovative companies in the life sciences, diagnostics, drug-device, and combination product industries. Aluris is a full-service, cost-effective partner, providing complete solutions across technical transfer, formulation, filling, lyophilization, assembly, and final kitting of reagents, consumables, and combination products. Aluris provides quality and regulatory expertise to assure the highest in quality manufacturing and supply chain excellence.

**Position Overview**

The Director of Quality Assurance (QA) is responsible for leading and managing the company’s quality assurance and regulatory compliance programs. This role ensures that all quality systems align with regulatory requirements and industry best practices, maintaining compliance with ISO-13485, ISO 14971, GMP/GLP, QSR, 21 CFR 820.30, and other relevant medical device (IVD) regulations.

The Director of QA will work closely with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to develop and implement strategic quality initiatives, oversee external audits and regulatory inspections, and drive continuous improvement across the organization. This role also involves coaching and mentoring staff, managing compliance metrics, and supporting client engagements by serving as the company’s quality systems representative.

Success in this position requires strong leadership, a deep understanding of quality regulations, excellent communication skills, and the ability to build and maintain a culture of compliance and operational excellence.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and assist in performing all tasks necessary to achieve the organization's mission and help execute growth
* Work with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to formulation and execute the
* strategic vision.
* Work with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to develop and actively manage the company's quality system consistent with the culture and intent of the company
* Oversee and coordinate the quality management systems implementation.
* Accountable for maintaining a state of compliance to f CFR 21 820, 210 and 211.
* Act as the "management representative" within the quality plan.
* Will formulate and lead the management team to maintain ISO 13485 compliance.
* Will assist the leadership in implementation of the technology and process capability roadmap with specific emphasis on validation (10/OQ) and documentation support.
* Will be involved in strategic planning, evaluation, and professional development initiatives.
* Will recruit, hire and manage a motivated and highly talented staff of quality and regulatory professionals
* Provide leadership and/or support as needed throughout the organization, specifically all activities associated with bill of materials structuring, part numbering, SKU attributes, set up, training and quality management systems.
* Represent the quality systems acumen and quality systems capabilities of the company.
* Support all clients engagements as the quality system voice of the company and our capabilities
* Will actively work with the VP of Manufacturing to solve challenges in the production environment related to workflow, internal audits, material dispositions (MRP) and process changes/deviations.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Successfully served in a similar capacity in a contract manufacturing company for a highly regulated market, preferably the life science/pharmaceutical environment.
* Proven credibility as a Quality leader in the life science manufacturing environment.
* Experience and familiarity in reagent formulation, filling and finishing activities with several years of directly related accountability for quality in this form of manufacturing.
* Proven track record of exceptional performance in these FDA regulated environments with audit experience from the FDA and clients
* FDA rapport and relationships are strongly desired
* A familiarity with Lean Manufacturing cultures in a volume production facility
* Experience and proven results in driving process/technology validation efforts.
* Experience and expertise in communication exchanges with clients during tours, meetings, and audits.
* Consistently exhibited through their actions, decisions, and interactions (internally and externally), the highest standards of ethics and integrity.
* The ability to create, direct and implement corporate objectives in an environment with a high sense of urgency
* A proven capability to generate shareholder value
* Negotiation skills to maximize value in client/regulatory body discussions
* Experience building compliance and standardization of processes (building a scalable organization).
* Experience participating in ERP implementations managing and driving documentation control, bills of materials, routings and workflows.
* A track record of recruiting exceptional talent within the economic constraints of a small company.
* A "hands-on" management style with the interpersonal skills required to build a successful team and the desire to motivate, inspire and develop management team members
* High intelligence with effective analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and listening skills.
* A proactive style using initiative and perseverance in order to bring about meaningful change.
* Demonstrated high energy.
* Team Player.

**What to Expect:**

This is a full-time, 100% on-site position based in Carlsbad, CA, with a Monday–Friday schedule and 8-hour workdays, excluding meal breaks. Overtime, weekend, and holiday work may be required as business needs arise.

The position offers a flexible start time between 6:00 a.m. and 9:30 a.m.; however, employees are expected to maintain a consistent schedule. Any exceptions to the established schedule must be approved in advance by the manager.

**What We Offer/Compensation**

At Aluris Sciences, LLC. we value our employees and are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and financial future. Eligible employees enjoy:

**Health & Wellness**

* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
* Company-paid life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage

**Financial & Time Off**

* 401(k) plan with company match
* Paid vacation
* California Paid Sick Leave
* Paid company holidays

**Additional Benefits**

* Employee Assistance Program
* Voluntary and supplemental benefit options

The pay range for this position is $195,000 - $205,000 annually. The final compensation offered will be based on a variety of job-related factors, including geographic location, skills, education, experience, certifications, and other relevant qualifications.

Aluris Sciences, LLC. is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age or disability, or any other class protected by Federal, State or local laws. Argonaut complies will all employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and all must have the authorization to work in the US.

role.title: Director, Contract Manufacturing--Remote
role.description:
Empowering Physicians. Improving Lives.
 
 
Are you ready to join a team that is redefining the medical device industry?
 
 
AngioDynamics develops innovative medical technologies that empower physicians to deliver improved care and patient outcomes globally. We believe that people living with society’s most challenging diseases deserve trusted medical solutions that deliver high-quality care, wellness, and cures to live healthier, happier lives.
 
 
Invested in You
 
 
We believe world-class innovation starts with world-class people. In this role, you will be surrounded by top talent and equipped with in-depth training to maximize your potential and accelerate your career.
 
 
Total Wellness
 
 
AngioDynamics helps physicians deliver better care for their patients. We take the same approach with our own people. Our comprehensive benefits package supports your health and your loved ones, so you can do your best work.
 
 
Ready to make a lasting impact on patient care? Learn more about this role below.
 
 
JOB SUMMARY – To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.
 
 
The Director of Contract Manufacturing is responsible for developing and executing the company's contract manufacturing strategy to ensure reliable supply, consistent product quality, cost competitiveness, and operational scalability. This role oversees the selection, qualification, development, and ongoing performance management of external manufacturing partners to support current business requirements and future growth.
 
Working cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Research and Development, Finance, and Commercial teams, the Director ensures that contract manufacturing partners meet established standards for safety, quality, service, cost, compliance, and delivery.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong background in external manufacturing, supplier relationship management, manufacturing operations, sustaining engineering, and continuous improvement. This individual will build strong partnerships, mitigate supply chain risks, drive operational efficiencies, and establish a scalable contract manufacturing network aligned with the company's long-term business objectives.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
1. Contract Manufacturing Strategy
 

* Develop and implement the contract manufacturing strategy in alignment with company objectives, production requirements, and growth plans.
* Evaluate and optimize the external manufacturing network, including capacity, capabilities, geographic footprint, cost structure, and risk exposure.
* Identify, assess, and qualify new contract manufacturers to support new products, increased demand, and business expansion.
* Lead make-versus-buy assessments and provide recommendations regarding outsourcing, insourcing, and manufacturing footprint optimization.
* Develop long-term manufacturing partner strategies to ensure flexibility, scalability, and business continuity.

2. Contract Manufacturer Relationship Management
 

* Establish and maintain strategic relationships with contract manufacturing partners, serving as the primary executive-level point of contact.
* Negotiate manufacturing agreements, service-level expectations, pricing structures, capacity commitments, and performance objectives in collaboration with Procurement and Legal.
* Establish clear governance processes, business reviews, escalation protocols, and performance improvement plans.
* Drive accountability and transparency across external manufacturing partners.
* Resolve complex operational, commercial, and relationship issues to protect business performance and customer commitments.

3. Operational Performance and Supply Assurance
 

* Oversee contract manufacturer performance related to production planning, capacity utilization, on-time delivery, lead times, yield, and throughput.
* Ensure manufacturing partners maintain adequate capacity, materials availability, staffing, and production readiness to meet forecasted demand.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Planning teams to align demand forecasts, production schedules, inventory targets, and capacity plans.
* Develop contingency plans and risk mitigation strategies for supply disruptions, quality issues, capacity constraints, and geopolitical or logistical challenges.
* Lead recovery plans when external manufacturing operations fail to meet required service or production targets.

4. Quality, Compliance, and Regulatory Oversight
 

* Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure contract manufacturers comply with applicable regulatory requirements, company standards, and contractual obligations.
* Ensure appropriate supplier qualification, audits, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), change control, and continuous compliance processes are in place.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring defects, deviations, customer complaints, and manufacturing nonconformances.
* Promote a culture of quality, product safety, accountability, and continuous improvement across the contract manufacturing network.
* Ensure manufacturing changes, process validations, and product transfers are appropriately controlled and documented, creating standard work for each key process and CM transaction.

5. Financial Management and Cost Optimization
 

* Develop and manage the contract manufacturing budget, including conversion costs, tooling, capital expenditures, and other external manufacturing expenses.
* Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives through process improvements, yield enhancement, productivity gains, material optimization, and commercial negotiations.
* Analyze cost drivers and manufacturing economics to improve total cost of ownership without compromising quality or service.
* Establish financial performance metrics and monitor actual results against budgets and targets.
* Support annual operating plans, long-range financial planning, and business cases for new manufacturing partnerships or capacity investments.
* Manage consignment inventory program – insuring planning alignment to forecast requirements. Establish standard reporting requirements.

6. New Product Introduction and Manufacturing Transfers
 

* Partner with Research and Development, Engineering, Quality, and Commercial teams to transition new products from development into commercial production.
* Oversee manufacturing readiness, process scale-up, technical transfer, validation, and production ramp-up activities.
* Ensure contract manufacturers have the technical capabilities, equipment, processes, and resources necessary to meet product specifications and volume requirements.
* Manage timelines, risks, and cross-functional deliverables associated with product launches, manufacturing transfers, and commercialization initiatives.

7. Performance Metrics and Continuous Improvement
 

* Establish and maintain a standardized contract manufacturer scorecard and key performance indicator (KPI) framework.
* Monitor performance against targets for quality, delivery, cost, service, productivity, and compliance.
* Lead regular operational reviews and executive business reviews with strategic manufacturing partners.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, root-cause analysis, and other operational excellence methodologies.
* Benchmark partner performance and implement best practices across the manufacturing network.

8. Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration
 

* Lead, develop, and mentor contract manufacturing, supplier management, or external operations personnel, as applicable.
* Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, and accountability across internal teams and external partners.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships to align manufacturing decisions with business needs.
* Communicate manufacturing performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.
* May perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS –The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill or ability required.
 
 
Education and Experience
 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business, or a related field required.
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or Supply Chain Management preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, procurement, or external manufacturing.
* 5+ years of experience managing contract manufacturers, outsourced production, or strategic manufacturing partners.
* Demonstrated success developing manufacturing strategies, managing supplier performance, and improving operational and financial results.
* Experience negotiating manufacturing agreements and managing complex supplier relationships.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, product transfers, capacity expansions, or manufacturing scale-ups.
* Experience working in a multi-site, global, or complex manufacturing environment preferred.

Skills/Knowledge
 

* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, capacity management, and supply chain operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and performance management.
* Strong financial acumen, including cost modeling, budgeting, and cost reduction.
* Knowledge of quality management systems, supplier audits, risk management, and corrective action processes.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to influence stakeholders and drive results across organizational boundaries.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, supply chain planning tools, and data-driven performance reporting.
* Willingness and ability to travel to manufacturing partner locations as required.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to effectively communication both internally and externally.
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance. instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected status.
 
 
AngioDynamics does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruiters and/or vendors who are not expressly under current written contract.
 
 
Your ultimate salary may vary depending on your job-related skills, knowledge, and experience.

**Director of Engineering (Food Manufacturing)**

Dessert Holdings is the leading premium dessert company in the world. We craft artisanal, scratch-made desserts at scale, combining culinary innovation with the finest real ingredients. With a rich heritage spanning seven distinctive brands, we bring unmatched expertise and tailored solutions to our Retail and Foodservice partners.

Dessert Holdings is looking for a **Director of Engineering**to be based in **Humble, TX** or ideally near one of our production facilities, who will travel as needed to sites for projects. Under the direction of the VP of Engineering & Reliability and in coordination with Corporate and Site Management teams, this individual will provide technical and professional leadership for project management and engineering across Dessert Holdings' tenFood Manufacturing Plants. This role is responsible for capital projects and for identifying, vetting, and championing new manufacturing opportunities and new or emerging technical advancements. This position requires strong personal initiative to identify opportunities, achieve engineering standardization, and implement asset and process best practices within the Dessert Holdings manufacturing facilities.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide engineering counsel and leadership for multiple facilities and internal and external project engineers.
* Manage and execute all facets of Dessert Holdings capital projects such as building expansions, and capacity expansion including brownfield and greenfield projects.
* Identify and champion cost reduction projects (capital and non-capital) through process or equipment improvements, capital automation, and robotic opportunities.
* Define technology and manufacturing capabilities to support new business and line extensions.
* Aid with developing 3/5-Year Capital Plan, including originating capital appropriation requests, developing project schedules and work teams, writing of contracts, coordinating project activities, controlling project funds, and implementing startup/training procedures as necessary.
* Write capital projects that include preparation of studies, proposals, estimates, technical reports, capital required, cash flow on approved CEA format.
* Assist in the development and implementation of new facility planning and construction. Includes developing packages, creating equipment and construction specifications, establishing and tracking project budgets, utility utilization, EPA and OSHA requirements, knowledge of GMP's, writing and justifying projects.
* Administer project bid documents and assist with rewarding contracts to outside vendors, architects, and engineers.
* Create and maintain the appropriate engineering records including equipment records and manuals, drawings and diagrams, inspection reports and legal records as required by the appropriate agencies.
* Maintain effective reporting and communication with the appropriate people both within and outside of the plant.
* Work closely with outside agencies in their respective fields, i.e., OSHA, EPA, FDA, etc., to ensure plant compliance with current regulations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering required or equivalent technical degree. Substantial applicable experience will also be considered.
* 10-15 years of engineering leadership with progressive technical and/or management experience including project management and extensive food manufacturing experience
* Ability to travel up to 75%, throughout the US (8 sites) and Canada (2 sites)
* Hands on approach to problem solving with creative solutions and ability to handle ambiguity
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Understand business implications of decisions, align work with strategic goals
* Ability to prioritize and plan work activities, set goals, timelines, and objectives
* Display original thinking, creativity and resourcefulness to generate innovative approaches and ideas
* Ability to create and drive automation opportunities including robotic manufacturing capability
* Possess leadership skills and the ability to effectively manage and communicate with engineers, construction personnel, project managers, clients and executives
* Demonstrated proficiency in Word, Excel, Gantt, Power Point, AutoCAD, and project planners
* Familiarity with controls, process, packaging, electrical, mechanical, refrigeration systems
* Knowledge of six sigma and Lean Manufacturing principles

**About Dessert Holdings**

Dssert Holdings is a collection of premium dessert companies and brands: The Original Cakerie, Lawler's Desserts, Atlanta Cheesecake Company, Steven Charles, Dianne's Fine Desserts, Kenny's Great Pies, and Willamette Valley Pie Company. Dessert Holdings is owned by Bain Capital, is headquartered in St. Paul, Minnesota, employs more than 3,500 people across ten manufacturing facilities, and is continuing its journey of rapid growth.

Dessert Holdings and its related entities provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or any other characteristics protected by law.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
Description:

**Come Join the Toledo Tool & Die Team!**

Located close to the Michigan/Ohio border, Toledo Tool and Die has diligently served the people of both of those great states since 1940. It was a company founded on one simple principle: to do the finest work possible for our clients and to deliver on every promise we make. Today Toledo Tool & Die has four facilities in the Toledo area and one in Pioneer, Ohio.

Toledo Tool & Die is looking for a **Plant Manager** to join our team to support our continued growth.

This is a full-time position based in Toledo, Ohio. We offer competitive wages, growth opportunities, and a clean, safe work environment.

**WHAT TOLEDO TOOL & DIE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* Weekly pay
* 10 paid holidays
* 401k
* Full benefits

**WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT FOR THIS POSITION:**

* Previous experience at the plant manager level or equivalent
* Strong work ethic
* Positive attitude
* Consistent attendance
* Willingness to learn
* Safety minded

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, direction, and operational performance of an automotive manufacturing facility. This role ensures the plant meets or exceeds expectations for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee engagement while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence. The Plant Manager provides strategic leadership to all plant functions—including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Materials, HR, and EHS—ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer requirements. This position plays a critical role in developing a high-performing culture, optimizing manufacturing processes, growing talent, and ensuring the long-term success and competitiveness of the facility.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Provide overall leadership and accountability for plant operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production across robotic assembly, and related processes.
* Establish and execute plant strategies focused on safety performance, customer satisfaction, financial targets, operational efficiency, and workforce development.
* Lead, mentor, and develop department managers, supervisors, and cross-functional teams to drive a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* Ensure compliance with safety policies, regulatory requirements, and environmental standards while actively promoting a world-class safety culture.
* Oversee adherence to IATF 16949, ISO, customer-specific requirements, and internal quality standards; partner with Quality to address issues and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor and manage plant KPIs including OEE, scrap, uptime, throughput, labor efficiency, and cost performance; ensure action plans are in place to address underperformance.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering to ensure equipment reliability, effective PM programs, and timely response to downtime or tooling issues.
* Oversee Materials/Logistics operations including inventory accuracy, material flow, scheduling, shipping, and customer delivery performance.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives, waste elimination efforts, standardized work implementation, and continuous improvement projects throughout the facility.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and visual factory standards across all production areas.
* Develop and manage annual plant budgets, capital expenditures, and long-term investment strategies.
* Collaborate with corporate leadership on production planning, capacity analysis, new program launches, engineering changes, and customer development initiatives.
* Ensure organizational compliance with HR, labor, ethics, and employment practices, including respect for human rights, non-discriminatory treatment, proper working hours, and wage law compliance.
* Build a positive employee relations environment through strong communication, coaching, and recognition; address workforce concerns and support effective engagement strategies.
* Lead regular plant meetings to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective communication across all levels of the organization.
* Represent the facility with customers, suppliers, auditors, and corporate partners.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all environmental practices are in line with job scope / position. Examples include but not limited to: proper waste disposal practices, reporting of spills, non-compliance to permit, and addressing any improper practices.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all human resources, ethics, and labor policies and practices are carried out in accordance with company policy and as in line with the scope of the position. Examples include but are not limited to: respecting the human rights of all workers (prohibition of forced labor, no child labor, maintaining appropriate working hours, and non-discriminatory treatment of all workers), abiding by ethical standards such as zero tolerance for bribery, corruption, extortion, and embezzlement, maintaining appropriate working hours of employees along with ensuring compensation is paid to workers that complies with all applicable wage laws.
* Assumes additional duties as assigned, which may fall outside the primary scope of the role.

**ISO / ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (EMS) RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure that the resources needed for the environmental management system are available.
* Communicate the importance of effective environmental management and of conforming to the environmental management system requirements.
* Ensure that the environmental management system achieves its intended outcomes.
* Direct and support persons to contribute to the effectiveness of the environmental management system.

Requirements:

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, Industrial Technology, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10–15 years of progressive manufacturing experience with at least 5 years in a leadership role; automotive robotic assembly experience strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of managing large teams, complex manufacturing operations, and high-volume production environments.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong understanding of automotive quality systems, including IATF 16949 and ISO standards.
* Demonstrated success improving plant performance, reducing costs, and driving operational excellence.

**GENERAL SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:**

* Strong leadership presence with the ability to inspire, influence, and motivate teams.
* Excellent communication skills for interacting with employees at all levels, customers, and executive leadership.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
* Ability to build a culture of trust, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

**SOFTWARE/COMPUTER SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with ERP or MES systems such as SAP, Oracle, Plex, QAD, or similar manufacturing platforms.
* Ability to interpret data dashboards, KPIs, and operational reports to guide decision-making.
* Demonstrated proficiency with digital tools used for production reporting, labor tracking, and quality management.
