role.title: Director, NG9X4 Vehicle Operations
role.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

 

This role is part of Blue Origin's Launch Operations organization, where our focus is launching and recovering New Glenn safely, reliably, and at an ever-increasing cadence. Launch Operations owns everything required to turn a rocket into a flight-ready vehicle on the pad and to recover and refly it, from vehicle preparation and integration to pad operations and booster recovery.

 

The 9x4 is the next step for New Glenn: a larger, more capable vehicle with a nine-engine booster, built, stacked, and launched vertically. The design decisions made about it now will determine, for the life of the program, how fast, how safely, and how reliably we can assemble, stack, and launch it. As Director of NG9x4 Vehicle Operations, you will be the single leader thinking about the 9x4 from the point of view of the people who will operate it, and the voice of Launch Operations in every decision meeting about the vehicle.

Reporting to the Vice President of Launch Operations, you will start with a team of about a dozen engineers. Together you will evaluate the vehicle design and the concept of operations and shape both, help define and install the tooling and facilities in our new vertical integration facility, and write the first draft of the work orders for final assembly of the booster and for everything it takes to get the rocket to launch. Some of your scope will also reach the new launch pad being built for this vehicle. If you are successful, you will go on to build the organization that staffs the vertical integration facility and builds and stacks the first 9x4.

 

This is a mission-critical leadership role for Blue Origin. We need a leader who drives relentlessly toward results, unencumbered by the old way of doing things, and constantly inventing new ways to solve problems and perform our mission. This leader must not be afraid to get hands-on with engineers and technicians, on the tooling, in the facility, and eventually on the vehicle itself, when the mission requires it, including in the middle of the night. At the same time, your long-term measure of success is building in, from the start, a vehicle and a set of processes that let the Launch Operations teams assemble, stack, and launch at a fast, repeatable, "boring" cadence. You'll make the impossible look routine through detailed, quantitative, hands-on command of the work your team executes down to the individual work order.

 
 

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

***Be the Voice of Operations on the 9x4***

* Represent Launch Operations in all design, configuration, and readiness decisions for the vehicle, bringing the perspective of the people who will assemble, stack, and launch it

* Evaluate the vehicle design and challenge requirements, driving design changes that make final assembly of the booster, stacking, and launch easier, faster, and safer

* Bring the lessons learned from today's horizontal integration operations into the design of vertical operations, and question which of them still apply

* Partner with vehicle design and engineering, facility, and pad teams so that operations needs are in the design before changes become expensive

***Stand Up Vertical Operations***

* Help shape the tooling, ground support equipment, and other installations in the new vertical integration facility, and help get them procured and installed

* Formalize the concept of operations in greater detail: how the nine-engine booster is finally assembled, how the second stage and payload are stacked vertically, and how the vehicle is prepared and launched

* Write the first draft of the work orders for final assembly of the booster and for all of the preparation needed to get the rocket to launch, and set the standard for high-quality, executable work orders (clear, sequenced, measurable, and completable by shift) so launch readiness is derived from objective data

* Take on operations scope for work at the new launch pad being built for this vehicle

***Lead Execution and Manage Risk***

* Manage technical and schedule risk as the vehicle, the facility, and the tooling come together; when schedule slips, personally own and drive the recovery plan rather than simply reporting the slip

* Perpetuate a high-standard safety culture across all vehicle work, given the significant personnel, process, and material hazards involved

* Be willing to get on the ground with engineers and technicians to solve problems directly, at any hour, when the mission requires it

***Drive Cross-Functional Integration***

* Serve as the primary point of contact between the operations teams and New Glenn vehicle design/engineering, facility, tooling, and pad leadership

* Partner with the business operations function (scheduling and operations analytics) to maintain an objective, data-driven view of remaining work and schedule risk

* Build the organization's own engineering ownership and judgment over time, reducing reliance on borrowed engineering support from other Blue Origin programs

***Build and Lead a High-Performing Organization***

* Lead an initial team of about a dozen engineers, and grow it into the organization that staffs the vertical integration facility and builds and stacks the first 9x4

* Build, mentor, and develop a bench of leaders and engineers in a fast-growing organization

* Take difficult, immature processes and mature them into fast, repeatable operations that don't require nightly heroics to execute

* Foster a culture where every technician and engineer is genuinely excited about Blue Origin's mission and understands the "why" behind the work

* Champion the use of AI to reduce engineering workload (including work-order authoring) and to accelerate the ramp of less experienced engineers

***Deliver Results***

* Use your own data and numerical analysis to understand team performance, drive decisions, and communicate progress

* Set quantitative targets for the labor hours and calendar time to assemble, stack, and launch the 9x4, and shape the vehicle and the processes to meet them, so the vehicle supports a much higher launch cadence

Present vehicle design, readiness, and risk to Blue Origin's most senior executive leadership, including with little to no coaching 

 

**WHAT YOU BRING**
------------------

 

***Minimum Qualifications***

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience building and leading complex vehicle or aircraft programs

* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience building, integrating, or maintaining complex vehicles, aircraft, or other high-reliability systems: aerospace, defense, marine, oil & gas, or similar heavy/complex-machine environments

* Experience representing operations, manufacturing, or production in design decisions, with a demonstrated track record of challenging engineering requirements and driving design changes to improve manufacturability or maintainability

* Leadership experience with budget and resource management responsibility for technical/operational organizations

* Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams, with the ability to grow a team and lead through subordinate managers

* A specific, demonstrated track record of driving measurable rate or throughput improvements in a complex manufacturing, assembly, or operations environment

* A demonstrated track record of building and perpetuating a high-standard safety culture in environments with significant personnel, process, or material hazards

* Demonstrated ability to make high-stakes technical and operational decisions under schedule pressure

* Strong executive presence with excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, including senior executive leadership

Strategic thinker with a bias for action and a track record of hands-on operational execution 

 

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Direct experience in final assembly, integration, or maintenance of military or civilian aircraft, weapons systems, or launch vehicles

* Experience with vertical assembly or stacking of large vehicles or structures, such as launch vehicles, or comparable heavy lifting and integration

* Experience standing up a new factory, production line, or facility, including shaping the tooling and the concept of operations

* Experience writing the first work instructions or work orders for a new vehicle or product

* A track record of taking a new vehicle, aircraft, or complex product from first-unit production to rate production

* Hands-on experience as an aircraft mechanic (or similar trade) and/or as a manufacturing engineer

* Working knowledge of aerospace standards and workmanship requirements

* Experience building or scaling an engineering/technical organization from a nascent, dependent state to self-sufficiency

* Master's degree in a related engineering field, or an MBA

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

 

**Export Control Regulations**

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

 

**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical 

 

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details. 

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws.

 

**Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation**

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com . Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

role.description:
**Date Posted:**

2026-11-10

**Country:**

United States of America

**Location:**

US-RI-PORTSMOUTH-PS1 ~ 1847 W Main Rd ~ NIMITZ BLDG

**Position Role Type:**

Onsite

**U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:**

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Security Clearance Type:**

DoD Clearance: Confidential

**Security Clearance Status:**

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Raytheon has an opening for a Sr. Production Control Lead supporting our Undersea Factory in our Portsmouth, RI facility. The successful candidate has experience with Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems in a manufacturing environment and utilizes data-driven decision making to enable effective material and workforce forecasting. This role requires daily interaction with cross functional teams, programs, and business units to maintain and meet organizational goals and objectives. These groups include planning, production control, operations, quality, and manufacturing/test/design engineering.

**What You Will Do**

* Managing a highly visible area with 6 production control professionals reporting into this position.
* Set strategic vision, direction and plan to execute on short to medium term program and functional strategies and initiatives.
* Material Availability Analysis, Tracking, and Reporting.
* Manage Kit Readiness including working with cross-functional team in BOM, Material Master, Process Engineering, Operations, and Document Control.
* Releasing production schedules in multiple tools through the MRP system and confirming in shop floor system.
* Coordinates kitting process with multiple stores and consolidation areas.
* Provide production floor support including replacement part management, shop floor material staging, Work in Progress (WIP) movement through shared resource areas, completion of units in shop floor and MRP system, delivery to next step (inventory or shipment), and meeting MRP schedule.
* Control the physical disposition of nonconforming or specially handled material including Return to Vendor, purged material, WIP STOP per contractual restrictions, and configuration of components/sub-assemblies as required.
* Maintain integrity of the shop floor, MRP, and inventory systems through key performance metrics.
* Process piece part movement to support internal build requirements through subcontractors, internal shared resources, and other Raytheon Technologies facilities.
* This position is an onsite role in our Portsmouth, RI facility.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years experience.
* Experience in Production Control, Supply Chain, Planning, Logistics, Scheduling, Operations, Manufacturing, or other production driven environments within manufacturing.
* Experience with MRP/ERP systems.
* Experience leading daily team operations and/or comparable leadership experience.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience leading in a Department of Defense (DoD) environment.
* Experience in Special Program Access and other business systems, including shop floor data systems.
* Experience in Six Sigma, CORE, Lean Manufacturing processes, diagnostics, and continuous improvement.
* Experience driving financial performance, cost reduction, staffing, and budgeting.

**What We Offer**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

* **Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role.**
 + **Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
* **Clearance Information:** This position requires a security clearance. **DCSA Consolidated Adjudication Services (DCSA CAS)**, an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. More information about Security Clearances can be found on the US Department of State government website here: https://www.state.gov/m/ds/clearances/c10978.htm

role.title: Audit Senior Manager, Manufacturing
role.description:
**Locations:**
--------------

Lincolnshire, Illinois

At Wipfli, people count.

At Wipfli, our people are core to everything we do—the catalyst behind our ability to create exceptional impact and extraordinary results.

We believe in flexibility. We focus on relationships. We encourage each individual to follow their own path.

People truly matter and they feel it. For those looking to make a difference and find a professional home, Wipfli offers a career-defining opportunity.

Wipfli is seeking an experienced Audit & Accounting Senior Manager to serve our growing MRD practice.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and oversee complex audit, review, and attest engagements for manufacturing and distribution clients, ensuring compliance with firm and professional standards
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior living clients, communicating audit results, financial insights, and emerging accounting or regulatory issues clearly and effectively
* Build and deepen relationships with existing clients while partnering with engagement leaders to enhance service delivery
* Plan and manage engagement staffing, schedules, and budgets, leveraging both U.S.-based and international team members
* Coach, mentor, and develop associates, seniors, and managers, with opportunities to take on performance coaching or people leadership responsibilities over time

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting
* CPA certification required
* Requires 8-10 years of job related experience with a public accounting firm.
* Demonstrated experience serving Manufacturing and Distribution clients
* Proven client relationship skills, with interest or experience in business development and practice growth
* Management and/or mentoring experience with other staff members

Kristin Kallies, from our recruiting team, will be guiding you through this process.

#LI-Remote

#LI-KK1

**Additional Details:**

Wipfli is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All candidates will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Wipfli is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, interview, or participate in our recruiting process, please send us an email at hr@wipfli.com

Wipfli values fair, transparent, and competitive compensation, considering each candidate's unique skills and experiences. The estimated base pay range for this role is $142,000 to $200,000, with offers typically not made at the maximum, allowing for future salary increases. The actual salary at the time of offer depends on business related factors like location, skills, experience, training/education, licensure, certifications, business needs, current associate pay, and relevant employment laws.

Individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, subject to participation rules and based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual and Firm performance.

Wipfli cares about our associates and offers a variety of benefits to support their well-being. Highlights include 8 health plan options (both HMO & PPO plans), dental and vision coverage, opportunity to enroll in HSA with potential Firm contribution and an Employee Assistance Program. Other benefits include firm-sponsored basic life and short and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) savings plan & profit share as well as Firm matching contribution, well-being incentive, education & certification assistance, flexible time off, family care leave, parental leave, family formation benefits, cell phone reimbursement, and travel rewards. Voluntary benefit offerings include critical illness & accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, legal, long-term care, pet insurance, ID theft protection, and supplemental life/AD&D. Eligibility for all benefits programs is dependent on annual hours expectation, position status/level and location.

"Wipfli" is the brand name under which Wipfli LLP and Wipfli Advisory LLC and its respective subsidiary entities provide professional services. Wipfli LLP and Wipfli Advisory LLC (and its respective subsidiary entities) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. Wipfli LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients, and Wipfli Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. Wipfli Advisory LLC and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

**Our commitment:**
-------------------

We invest in the growth of all our associates through ongoing education and career development. To learn more about how we invest in you, see our learning and development page.

We also invest in a strong work-life balance by providing benefits, such as flexible time off and wellness programs. We provide health, vision and dental insurance, generous family leave, flexible work options, 401(k) contributions and paid time off and holidays.

**What you can expect:**
------------------------

If your resume is a fit for the position, a recruiter will reach out to you for an initial conversation so we can tell you more about Wipfli and the benefits of working here. We don’t just expect you to just answer our questions. We encourage you to ask us about Wipfli to see if we’re a good fit for you.

 Travel benefits to give associates across the country equitable access to quality care across a broad spectrum of needs

role.title: Senior Manager - Quality Control
role.description:
**NOTICE: The posting for local applicants only - is not for those applying for a global assignment and/or for employees working outside of Cipla's U.S. Subsidiaries or Affiliates.**

 

**Job Title**: Senior. Manager, Quality Control

**FLSA Classification**: Full-Time, Exempt Professional

**Work Location**: Central Islip, NY (Unit 3)

**Work Hours:** General Shift: 8:30AM – 5:00PM (may vary based on business needs)

**Reports To**: Quality Control Director

**Salary: $103,000 - $136,000**

 

**Position Summary**

The Manager, Finished Product & Stability Quality Control is responsible for leading all analytical testing, stability program execution, laboratory compliance activities, investigations, and personnel management associated with Finished Product and Stability testing. The role ensures compliance with cGMP, FDA, ICH, USP, Data Integrity, and internal quality requirements while supporting product release, stability commitments, regulatory inspections, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage Finished Product and Stability testing activities to support commercial product release and ongoing stability programs.
* Oversee testing and review of assay, related substances, chromatographic purity, degradation products, dissolution, content uniformity, residual solvents, and other compendial requirements.
* Ensure timely execution of stability sample pulls, testing, data review, trending, and reporting activities.
* Lead laboratory investigations including OOS, OOT, deviations, atypical results, and CAPA implementation.
* Review and approve analytical data, laboratory records, chromatograms, and technical reports.
* Support method verification, method transfer, process validation, cleaning validation, and troubleshooting activities.
* Ensure inspection readiness and actively support regulatory and customer audits.
* Supervise, train, mentor, and develop laboratory personnel while ensuring efficient workload distribution and resource utilization.
* Partner with QA, Manufacturing, Validation, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and R&D to meet business and compliance objectives.
 

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related scientific discipline.
* Minimum 5+ years of pharmaceutical Quality Control experience with at least 3-5 years in a supervisory or managerial role.
* Strong experience supporting FDA-regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.

 

**Technical Knowledge & Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in Finished Product and Stability sample testing within a pharmaceutical Quality Control laboratory. Experience with Raw Material testing is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of chromatographic techniques including assay testing, related substances (impurity profiling), degradation product analysis, and chromatographic purity determination using HPLC, UPLC, GC, and IC systems.
* Proficient in operation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of analytical instruments including HPLC, UPLC, GC, IC, Dissolution Testers, Karl Fischer, FTIR, UV-Vis, and XRPD.
* Thorough understanding of Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) product testing requirements and regulatory expectations.
* Strong technical expertise in pharmaceutical analytical methodologies, laboratory investigations, data review, and compliance-driven laboratory operations.
* Working knowledge of cGMP, GLP, GDP, Data Integrity requirements, USP, ICH guidelines, and FDA expectations.
* Experience with chromatography data systems and laboratory software including Empower, LabSolutions, Tiamo, and other computerized laboratory systems.
* Working knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN), and Quality Management Systems such as TrackWise.
* Demonstrated experience in method execution, method troubleshooting, data review, technical assessments, and investigation management.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and customer audits, including USFDA, customer, and corporate audits.
* Strong leadership, communication, documentation, decision-making, and problem-solving skills with the ability to effectively manage teams and collaborate across functions.

 

**GLOBAL COMPANY**

 

Cipla is a leading global pharmaceutical company, dedicated to high-quality, branded and generic medicines. We are trusted by healthcare professionals and patients across geographies. Over the last eight decades, we have strengthened our leadership in India’s pharmaceutical industry and fortified our promise of strengthening our global focus by consolidating and deepening our presence in the key markets of India, South Africa, the U.S., and other economies of the emerging world.

 

Cipla employs handpicked professionals not just for their knowledge and experience but for their zeal to make a difference to the world of healthcare. The company believes that our biggest assets are the employees, who lead us to prosperity and growth in the future. Driven by the vision, none shall be denied, Cipla’s focus has always been on making affordable, world-class medicines with a reputation for uncompromising quality standards across the world.

 

**CIPLA NEW YORK (INVAGEN PHARMACEUTICALS, INC.)**

 

About InvaGen Pharmaceuticals, a Cipla subsidiary InvaGen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing, and distribution of generic prescription medicines with focus on a range of therapeutic areas, including cardiovascular, anti-infective, CNS, anti-inflammatory, anti-diabetic, and anti-depressants. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Central Islip and Hauppauge, New York. As of February 18, 2016, InvaGen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Cipla (EU) Limited.

**EEO Statement**

 

Cipla is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, genetic information, disability, or protected veteran status.

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**ABOUT US**

**Join a Global Photonics Leader Engineering Solutions from the Deep Ocean to Outer Space!**

G&H (Gooch & Housego) designs and manufactures advanced optical components and systems for demanding applications. Our Chicago-area acousto-optics operation employs approximately 20+ people and supports high-precision photonics manufacturing.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are seeking a hands-on Director of Operations to lead a Chicago-area acousto-optics manufacturing site of approximately 20+ employees. This leader will own daily operational execution, workforce performance, safety, quality, delivery and cost, while aligning production capacity, materials and customer demand. Working closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial and Finance, the Director will drive disciplined planning and practical continuous improvement.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

**Site Leadership & Manufacturing Execution**

* Lead day-to-day site operations, establish priorities, allocate labor and equipment, and coach a small manufacturing team to achieve safety, quality, delivery and productivity objectives.
* Oversee production scheduling, capacity, workflow and bottlenecks for high-precision acousto-optic manufacturing, including high-mix or low-volume requirements where applicable.
* Build a culture of accountability, engagement and cross-functional teamwork consistent with G&H values.
* Change Manage/Leadership of culture
* Fluent in NPI/product transfer for insourcing – Leadership, team formation and oversight, risk identification & mitigation.
* Maturing and scaling production methodologies and technologies.

**Planning, Inventory & Financial Performance**

* Lead site inputs to SIOP, aligning customer demand, backlog, materials and production plans with Commercial and Supply Chain partners.
* Monitor raw materials, work-in-progress, finished goods and safety stock to balance delivery performance, inventory turns and working capital.
* Manage site operating plans and budgets within delegated authority; weekly report out of plan vs actual and financial forecasts using ERP data and operating trends.

**Quality, Safety & Customer Commitments**

* Partner with Quality and Engineering to resolve nonconformances, strengthen root-cause and corrective-action practices, and maintain applicable ISO/AS requirements.
* Champion health and safety, manufacturing process discipline and customer requirements, including aerospace and defense obligations where applicable.
* Coordinate customer delivery risks, new-product introductions, manufacturing readiness and escalation resolution across functions.

**Operational Excellence & Performance**

* Drive practical Lean, 5S and process improvement initiatives to reduce scrap, increase yield and improve throughput and cost.
* Establish an operating cadence and report actionable KPIs including on-time delivery, schedule attainment, scrap/yield, productivity, inventory and safety.
* Use ERP, Excel and business data to identify constraints, prioritize actions and sustain measurable improvements.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* At least five years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including direct people management.
* Experience in precision manufacturing, photonics, optics, electronics or similarly technical operations; acousto-optics strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated production planning, inventory management and operational budgeting experience.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, Excel and manufacturing performance metrics.
* Experience with Lean, 5S or other continuous improvement methods.
* Ability to lead hands-on in a small-site environment while balancing strategic and daily operational priorities.
* Strong coaching, communication, decision-making and cross-functional stakeholder skills.
* Experience supporting regulated aerospace/defense manufacturing or ISO/AS systems preferred, where applicable.
* Ability to analyze operational data, resolve production constraints and drive sustained improvements.

**G&H BENEFITS INCLUDE:**

* Paid Time Off and Company Holidays
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Life and Disability Insurance
* Enhanced Employee Assistance Program
* Employee Wellness Resources
* Professional Development Opportunities

**If you’re ready to make a real impact in a world-class photonics environment, we’d love to hear from you.**

***Notes****: This job description is not intended to be exhaustive in every respect, but rather to clearly define the fundamental purpose, responsibilities and dimensions for the role. Therefore, this job description does not describe any individual role holder. In addition to the contents of this job description, employees are expected to undertake all other reasonable and related tasks allocated by their line manager.*

*The Company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the grounds of gender, race, religion or belief, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by national laws under which the Company operates.*

***\*\*US Applicants:*** *In the instance that the position will involve having access to items and technical data that may be controlled under U.S. export laws and regulations ("U.S. Export Control Laws"), including but not limited to the Export Administration Regulations ("EAR") and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations ("ITAR"). To comply with the U.S. Export Control Laws, and in conjunction with the review of candidates for those positions within G&H that may present access to export-controlled technical data, G&H must assess whether candidates are "U.S. persons" as defined under the EAR (15 C.F.R. Part 772) and the ITAR (22 C.F.R. § 120.15). Certain questions asked during the application process are intended to assess this and will be used for evaluation purposes only. Failure to provide the necessary information in this regard will result in our inability to consider you further for this position.*

role.title: Director of Operations Excellence
role.description:
**Brand:**

Bagel Brands

**Bagel Brands is the parent company for your favorite breakfast brands, Einstein Bros. Bagels, Bruegger's Bagels, Noah's NY Bagels, and Manhattan Bagel. We believe in the bagel and how it has the unique ability to bring people together. Our team has a standard set of values and behaviors that allow us to spread a little more joy and happiness in the world. They let us laugh, smile, and enjoy each other’s company a little more. These are the behaviors that guide how we work, how we treat each other, and how we treat our guests. We believe that there is no better way to make someone’s day than with a warm, fresh-baked bagel and a heart-felt good morning.**

**POSITION MISSION**

The Director, Operations Excellence leads the strategy, team, and discipline that make it easier for our bakery teams to obsess over our guests and deliver great results every day. This role owns the enterprise operations engineering agenda for Bagel Brands — evaluating how work gets done, designing better ways of working, and building the team needed to test, scale, and sustain change across Field Operations and Support Center teams.

 

In alignment with Bagel Brands’ Mission, Vision, and Values, this role builds an organization that helps teams Take Ownership of better ways of working, Support Each Other through thoughtful change, and ultimately creates simpler, more consistent operations that allow bakery teams to Obsess Over Our Guests.

 
 

Department: Operations

Salary: $180,000 to $200,000

Annual Bonus: 20%

Long Term Incentive Plan: $30,000

 

**RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**

**Strategic Leadership & Vision**

* Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Operations Excellence, aligning priorities with enterprise strategy and Field Operations needs.

* Build and prioritize a portfolio of process engineering and continuous improvement initiatives across the bakery system.

* Represent Operations Excellence in senior leadership and strategic planning forums, translating field findings into enterprise decisions.

 
 

**Operations Excellence & Process Engineering**

* Oversee evaluation of bakery processes, workflows, and systems to simplify work, optimize labor investments, reduce waste, and strengthen performance.

* Guide application of Lean, Six Sigma, process mapping, and root-cause analysis across a portfolio of concurrent initiatives.

* Own the standard for future-state process design, balancing efficiency, guest experience, team member experience, and financial impact.

* Ensure the team produces process maps, standard work, and tools that translate solutions into repeatable bakery practices at scale.

 
 

**Testing, Piloting & Continuous Improvement**

* Set the standard for how the organization designs and governs operational pilots before broader rollout.

* Review pilot results with senior leadership and make scale, refine, or discontinue recommendations.

* Sponsor root-cause analysis on significant recurring challenges, ensuring solutions are sustainable rather than short-term fixes.

 
 

**Labor and Inventory Analytics and Systems Optimization**

* Own labor and inventory system optimization through consistent review of program enhancements, labor/inventory performance opportunities, and cross-functional partnerships with IT, Finance, and program owners.

* Create and maintain regular reporting for Ops teams that highlights opportunities for improvement

 
 

**Project & Change Management**

* Own the portfolio of cross-functional operational excellence initiatives from problem identification through sustainment.

* Set the organization’s approach to structured change management and ensure it is applied consistently.

* Maintain enterprise-level visibility to portfolio progress, risks, and business impact.

 
 

**Team & Field Leadership**

* Build, lead, and develop a team of Operations Excellence managers and professionals.

* Coach the team on problem solving, project management, and change leadership, building bench strength for future roles.

* Maintain regular presence in bakeries, partnering with Field Operations leaders to test and validate solutions.

* Identify successful practices within the bakery system and lead efforts to standardize and scale them.

 
 

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Measurement**

* Partner with Training, Technology, Marketing, Culinary/R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, and Development to evaluate the impact of enterprise initiatives.

* Represent the Operations perspective in cross-functional and executive-level project governance.

* Own the measurement framework used to demonstrate whether operational improvements are delivering results.

* Deliver clear, data-driven recommendations and portfolio updates to senior Operations leadership.

 

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES (DIRECTOR / SENIOR DIRECTOR)**

* *Effective Communication:* Articulates vision and manages difficult conversations cross-functionally; communicates complex initiatives and navigates executive discussions.
* *Accountability & Ownership:* Owns budget and strategy and drives a culture of accountability; manages multi-team performance and champions data-driven decisions.
* *Adaptability & Perseverance:* Leads the department through major change and anticipates trends; drives change across functions and builds resilient teams.
* *Empowerment:* Creates space for innovation and mentors emerging leaders; designs structures for decentralized decision-making.
* *Curiosity:* Probes beyond surface issues and fosters a learning environment; benchmarks against top organizations and sponsors new ideas.
* *Self-Awareness:* Understands own leadership brand and exhibits humility; holds deep clarity on values and stays resilient under pressure.

 

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES**

**Required**

* 10+ years of experience in restaurant operations, operations excellence, continuous improvement, or a related discipline.

* 3+ years of experience directly leading and developing a team.

* Track record of leading enterprise-scale, cross-functional projects with measurable business impact.

* Strong strategic, analytical, and structured problem-solving skills.

* Strong portfolio and project management skills, with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and budgets.

* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change at the senior leadership level without direct authority.

* Excellent executive presentation skills and ability to travel regularly to bakery locations.

 
 

**Preferred**

* Direct restaurant or multi-unit operations leadership experience.

* Advanced experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, or comparable methodologies.

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, Prosci Change Management, or comparable certification.

* Experience within QSR, fast casual, retail, or another high-volume, multi-unit consumer environment.

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree (MBA or related) preferred, or equivalent experience.

 

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

This position requires regular travel to bakery locations across multiple regions, including standing, walking, and observing operations on-site, as well as the ability to sit, use a computer, and participate in meetings for extended periods. These requirements may be met with or without reasonable accommodation.

 

**The duties of this position may change from time to time. The Company reserves the right to add or delete duties and responsibilities at the discretion of the Company or its managers. This job description is intended to describe the general level of work being performed. It is not intended to be all-inclusive.**

role.title: Director of Quality and Informatics

postingQuotes: Director of Quality and Informatics
### **Director of Quality and Informatics**
* Provide departmental leadership and supervision to direct reports, including performance management, coaching, hiring, and training
* Must comply with training and supervision requirements during first 90 days of employment, and throughout employment.
The Director of Quality and Informatics plays a pivotal leadership role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality, data-informed behavioral healthcare services.

JR2889

**Advancing medicine to save lives. Together.**

Thanks to many decades of experience and our passion for what we do, we make an essential contribution to the global availability of biopharmaceuticals, especially for patients with rare and serious diseases.

Rentschler Biopharma SE is a leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) focused exclusively on client projects. We offer customized full-service solutions for bioprocess development and the production of complex biopharmaceuticals. As a German family-owned company with an international footprint and global reach, we combine experts, expertise and years of experience to develop best-in-class solutions – together with our clients.

Rentschler Biopharma has approximately 1,400 employees and is headquartered in Laupheim, Germany, with a site in Milford, MA, USA. In 2024, we joined the United Nations Global Compact, underlining our commitment to sustainability.

As an independent family-owned company, we live by the motto: Many hands, many minds - ONE TEAM! Open, respectful cooperation characterizes our working environment, where quality awareness, diligence and responsibility are our top priorities. With all the diversity of our talents in the Rentschler team, we pursue one vision together: advancing medicine to save lives.

As a member of the QC leadership team in Milford, the Director, Quality Control Technical Services will manage and oversee a Quality Control team responsible for maintaining GxP systems and processes that support site business objectives; within QC this will be from Clinical Development to Clinical Supply and/or Commercial manufacture at a Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). The candidate will work in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Supply Operations, Process Sciences and Quality Assurance to support continual improvement and cGMP compliance. The Director will work functionally as well as part of a multi-disciplinary team to support the development and approval of our clinical development programs, commercial operations, and implement strategic imperatives within a fast-paced environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

 

* Will manage teams of professionals within Quality Control encompassing raw materials testing, microbiology, QC LIMS master data and electronic systems, analytical equipment lifecycle management, documentation and data integrity
* Hire and develop employees within the department through coaching and mentorship while setting clear expectations for success
* Leads and manages the Milford Site QC Leadership team meetings and follow up action plans
* Establish and maintain Quality Control systems and processes at Milford, MA site
* Develops and maintains department budgets (expense and capital) in alignment with overall organizational goals for profitability

* Acts as portfolio manager for QC project work including scheduling, prioritizing and resource planning to ensure client contract deliverables are met
* Represents QC at the project team level and interacts with Rentschler clients as needed
* Ensure timely execution of client projects and clear communications to clients
* Identify and initiate improvements to Quality Control Systems and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring compliance with all relevant quality standards and regulatory requirements
* Verify & establish department readiness for audits by both internal and external authorities, serve as primary Quality Control contact for regulatory inspections and client audits
* Analyze regulatory authorities’ programs, guidance documents and activities in areas relevant to testing biological products
* Consistently advise site and Quality management of potential and actual actions that could adversely affect the business; represent quality exposures or represent opportunities to be pursued
* Collect and report quality control metrics via Quality Management Reviews and the Quality Council
* Promotes a strong Quality Culture based on the Rentschler core values

**Qualifications and Key Characteristics**

 

* BS required, MS preferred in a scientific/technical discipline with 15+ years of experience in a QC position within the biological and/or CDMO industry
* 10+ years in a management/leadership role(s)
* PhD in a scientific/technical discipline a plus
* Experience in microbiological methods and contamination control
* Subject matter experiment in laboratory equipment qualification and data management
* Ability to apply GMP regulations and international guidelines to all aspects of the position
* Experience with regulatory inspections and client audits specifically within a startup/early phase and commercial QC laboratories
* Extensive experience with writing and managing investigations and risk assessments
* Proficient in MS Office application suite as well GMP electronic applications such as LIMS
* Outstanding leadership abilities with demonstrated analytical and critical thinking skills while managing high performing teams
* Proven leader, delegator, and decision maker with the ability to interact with all levels
* Executive presence with strong interpersonal and communication skills, verbal and written

**Working Conditions**

 

* Manufacturing environment with potential chemical, electrical and physical hazards
* Personal protective equipment must be worn in the laboratories according to Rentschler safety requirements
* Exposure to cool/hot storage conditions
* May be working in a loud area at times, that requires hearing protection and other protective equipment to be worn
* Working around chemicals such as solvents, acids, bases and reactive or flammable materials
* May require immunization before performing work within the manufacturing area
* Pace may be fast and job completion demands may be high
* Some international travel (no more than 5% time)

**Physical Requirements**

 

* May be required to stand for long periods of time while performing physical duties
* May be required to lift up to 10 lbs
* Must be able to work safely with materials and equipment
* PPE as required

Base Pay Range 
 
$180,000 - $220,000 
 
Disclosure Statement 
 
Rentschler Biopharma, Inc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base pay range listed for this position is the anticipated annual base salary range the organization reasonably, and in good faith, expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other application factors permissible by law. The annual base salary is just one component of our Total Rewards package, which also includes our annual discretionary bonus program, medical insurance, our generous 401K program, plus a host of other benefits to aligned to support our employees’ personal and professional wellness. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.

role.title: Senior Manager of Digital Quality Systems
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 Anduril’s Quality organization is seeking a Senior Manager, Digital Quality Systems to lead the team responsible for our digital quality platform and analytics infrastructure. The Quality team works with our customers, internal teams, and suppliers to ensure the deployment of reliable products that meet all mission requirements. We develop cutting-edge quality processes and methods to secure scalable, long-term business success. We are growing rapidly across multiple product lines and sites, and this role will own the quality workflows inside Forge, our homegrown Manufacturing Execution System, and the Quality Intelligence Hub, our centralized analytics and compliance layer built on Databricks. The right person for this role lives at the intersection of software and quality engineering, someone who can design a data model, review code, ship in sprints, and understand how nonconformance, CAPA, and inspection processes work on a real factory floor. If you want to build the digital quality backbone for the next generation of defense manufacturing, this is the seat.

 This role is subject to ITAR. Applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance. 

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 
 Platform architecture. Own the design of quality workflows in Forge: inspection routings, data capture points, decision logic and audit trails. Keep them version-controlled and audit-ready.

 Core quality workflows. Build NC, disposition, containment, CAPA, SCAR and inspection instructions into production flow, not bolted on after it.

 Quality Intelligence Hub. Direct the data models and dashboards behind FPY, DPU, escape rates, CAPA aging, NC Pareto, supplier scorecards and SPC trending.

 Operator experience. Make sure floor operators and quality engineers get fast, error-resistant tools they actually want to use.

 Team leadership. Lead developers, data engineers, analysts and quality SMEs: set sprint priorities, review designs and code, and unblock decisions.

 Cross-functional alignment. Keep the platform in step with product development, supplier quality, reliability and manufacturing as programs and sites scale.

 
 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on software experience.

 10+ years building or leading enterprise software, manufacturing systems or quality systems, with 5+ years leading engineers or analysts.

 Hands-on software credibility: you can sketch an architecture, challenge a schema, read a pull request and make build-vs-buy calls.

 Working knowledge of enterprise quality processes: NC, CAPA, SCAR, disposition, containment, inspection and document control, and how each translates into data capture and workflow.

 Data and analytics fluency: SQL and Python, and experience with a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or similar.

 Experience running agile delivery: sprint planning, backlog grooming, CI/CD and iterative releases with a cross-functional team.

 Comfort making architecture decisions with imperfect information in a fast-scaling environment.

 U.S. citizenship is required pursuant to contractual obligations.

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 Experience with a homegrown or heavily customized MES, not only out-of-the-box SAP QM or Windchill.

 Aerospace, defense, medical device or other regulated manufacturing background (AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485).

 Practical AI/ML use in production workflows or strong personal fluency with AI tooling.

 Statistical methods in practice: SPC, MSA and process capability analysis.

 IoT-enabled inspection data capture, automated optical inspection or machine vision integration.

 APQP/PPAP or FMEA tied into digital quality systems.

 ASQ certification (CQE, CMQ/OE or Six Sigma Black Belt).

 US Salary Range
 $191,000 — $254,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

role.title: Senior Director, Manufacturing Sciences & Technologies
role.description:
Description:

**Transforming Cancer Therapy Together**

At ADC Therapeutics, we are passionate about revolutionizing cancer treatment. When you join our team, you become part of a mission-driven group of talented individuals dedicated to making a difference in patients' lives.

**Why ADC Therapeutics?**

ADC Therapeutics (NYSE): is a commercial, global leader and pioneer in the field of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) with specialized capabilities from clinical through commercialization. Our CD-19-directed ADC for relapsed/refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma, ZYNLONTA® (loncastuxamab tesirine lpyl) has received accelerated approval in the United States, conditional approval from the European Commission and conditional approvals in other countries. ZYNLONTA is also being evaluated in combination with other agents and in earlier lines of DLBCL therapy as well as indolent lymphomas including follicular lymphoma and marginal zone lymphoma with the potential to reach significantly more patients through expanded use.

We are a team of approximately 150 patient-focused, purpose-driven employees with a shared mission to transform the treatment paradigm for patients. If you’re interested in making a difference in the lives of patients worldwide with a team of like-minded colleagues, operating in a flexible work environment, come join us on our journey! To learn more about ADC Therapeutics, our values, and our exceptional culture, please visit us at https://adctherapeutics.com/ and LinkedIn.

**Job Summary****:**

The Senior Director of Manufacturing Sciences & Technologies (MSAT) is a senior technical leader responsible for end-to-end process ownership, technical oversight, and lifecycle management of drug substance intermediates, ADC drug substance, and ADC drug product manufactured through a global network of external CDMOs.

This role ensures robust, scalable, and compliant manufacturing processes that support commercial manufacturing, process development projects and clinical development, while serving as the senior-level technical support for internal Production Management Teams and external manufacturing partners.

The position plays a critical role in process validation, technology transfer, continued process verification (CPV), change management, technical and regulatory support across antibody, linker-payload, conjugation, formulation, fill/finish, and packaging operations.

This position reports to the Vice President, Global Supply & Operations. The role is remote based, with a preference for candidates located on the U.S. East Coast.

**What You'll Do****:**

MSAT Strategy and Leadership

* Lead and develop the MSAT function covering ADC end-to-end manufacturing across clinical and commercial stages.
* Define MSAT strategy for external manufacturing aligned with corporate objectives.
* Develop and mentor a high-performing MSAT team with deep expertise in biologics, highly potent payloads, and aseptic operations.
* Serve as a key member of the Operations Management Team to contribute to long-term supply, risk mitigation, and operational excellence initiatives.

Manufacturing Process Oversight (External Manufacturing)

* Accountable for overall manufacturing process stewardship, ensure robust process knowledge management and align process understanding within ADCT and at the CDMO partners.
* Partner with Quality and Supply Chain to ensure ADCT’s Production Management Teams effectively interface and manage CDMO performance.
* Oversee and guide: MSAT activities at CDMOs, process characterization, validation (PPQ), process monitoring and CPV programs.
* Ensure consistent process understanding and control across global manufacturing partners.
* Drive effective issue resolution for manufacturing deviations, CAPAs, and change requests.
* Support CDMO selection, technical due diligence, and onboarding for new manufacturing partners.

Process Lifecycle Management

* Provide scientific and technical oversight across the full ADC manufacturing lifecycle.
* Assess and implement post approval changes, comparability strategies, and process optimization initiatives.
* Oversee and endorse process improvements to enhance process robustness, yield, cost, and supply reliability.

Regulatory & Quality Support

* Serve as the senior-level accountable MSAT person for regulatory submissions and inspections, including INDs, BLAs, MAAs, supplements to these filings.
* Author, review, and approve CMC regulatory sections and responses.
* Support health authority inspections and technical audits of CDMOs.
* Partner closely with Quality to ensure compliance with cGMP, ICH, and global regulatory expectations.
* Ensure sound scientific justifications for process control strategies, specifications, and lifecycle changes.

Cross Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Supply Chain and CMC Regulatory
* Provide MSAT input into development programs, commercial readiness, and long range supply planning.
* Participate in internal governance forums, change control boards, and technical review committees.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

* Establish and track critical process parameters (CPPs) and CPV metrics.
* Proactively identify and mitigate technical and operational risks within ADC Therapeutics’ external manufacturing network.
* Drive lessons learned, standardization, and continuous improvement across CDMOs and Production Management Teams.

Requirements:

**Who You Are****:**

* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or related field; BS with significant industry experience considered.
* 12+ years of relevant experience including biologics manufacturing, CMC operations, and CDMO management.
* Extensive experience in commercial GMP manufacturing operations, process validation, CPV, and regulatory submission preparation.
* Strong scientific problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
* Proven ability to lead through influence in external or remote environments.
* Excellent communication skills for executive, regulatory, and partner interfaces
* Strategic thinker with strong execution focus.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, commercial-stage organization.
* Deep knowledge of relevant bioconjugate technologies is preferred (antibody, high potency linker-payload, conjugation, aseptic fill and lyophilization).
* Strong track record of building and leading technical and cross-functional teams.
* Visionary leadership with a strategic mindset.
* High standards of excellence, urgency, and accountability.
* Collaborative, team-oriented approach.
* Strong organizational and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to mentor, influence, and drive change across a remote organization.
* Domestic and international travel up to 20%, primarily to CDMOs.

role.title: Seating Plant Manager
role.description:
**Seating Plant Manager**

**Position Summary**
====================

DARRAN is a family-owned furniture manufacturer based in High Point, North Carolina, creating thoughtfully designed furniture for 50 years. Our work brings together craftsmanship, innovation, and a commitment to quality, supported by people who take pride in what they build.
===================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

We are seeking a Production Manager over our Seating Operations to guide our seating manufacturing operation and support its continued growth. This leadership role brings together people, processes, and craftsmanship to build a strong team and deliver exceptional products. The ideal candidate leads by example, develops others, and creates an environment where accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.


**Management and People Leadership**
====================================

* Direct and supervise seating department employees, assign work, communicate daily priorities, and hold employees accountable for meeting expectations.
* Set clear expectations for productivity, quality, attendance, conduct, and safe work practices. Ensure employees understand their responsibilities and department goals.
* Monitor individual and team performance daily, including output, work quality, efficiency, attendance, and adherence to established procedures. Identify concerns and address them promptly.
* Provide ongoing coaching and timely feedback. Establish improvement expectations, document follow-up, and verify that required improvements are achieved and sustained.
* Administer and document disciplinary actions in partnership with HR and in accordance with company policy. Clearly communicate the concern, required correction, and consequences of continued issues.
* Complete annual performance reviews and provide accurate, specific feedback supported by documented performance observations.
* Partner with HR on hiring and employee matters. Coordinate onboarding and training, assess employee skills, and identify development and cross-training needs.
* Apply company policies consistently, address employee concerns respectfully, and maintain clear communication with employees, HR, and senior operations leadership.

**Production**
==============

* Lead daily production startup and ensure teams, materials, and priorities are ready at the beginning of each shift.
* Manage production flow across frame building, cutting, sewing, upholstering, and final assembly to keep work on schedule.
* Partner with senior operations leadership to review daily objectives, constraints, and priorities.
* Drive results across output, delivery performance, labor utilization, overtime, quality, and production flow.
* Develop and improve standard operating procedures and processes that increase throughput and reduce bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with outside and original-equipment suppliers to maintain production capacity and quality standards while expanding internal capabilities.
* Collaborate with engineering and product development on patterns, production readiness, and the launch of new seating collections.
* Establish, maintain, and enforce quality checks and corrective actions.
* Coordinate maintenance needs, execute safety programs, and reinforce safe work practices throughout the operation.
* Advance shop-floor organization and housekeeping practices that support a structured, clean, and efficient workplace.

**How Success Is Measured**
===========================

Success is measured by consistent people leadership and department results against goals established with senior operations leadership. Performance is evaluated through production and quality reports, employee performance records, training progress, and completion of corrective actions.

* People management and accountability: Employees understand their goals and responsibilities. Performance and attendance concerns are addressed promptly, company policies are applied consistently, and coaching and disciplinary actions are documented with HR.
* Performance improvement: Individual and team results are monitored regularly. Employees receive specific feedback, improvement expectations and follow-up dates are documented, and progress is verified. Annual reviews are completed on time.
* Employee development: New employees complete assigned training, demonstrated skills meet job requirements, and cross-training improves coverage across seating operations.
* Production and delivery: Actual output and on-time completion meet established targets. Bottlenecks and schedule delays are identified early, communicated, and addressed.
* Quality: Products meet established standards. Defects, rework, and recurring quality issues are tracked, and corrective actions produce sustained improvement.
* Labor and operational efficiency: Labor utilization and overtime remain within established expectations. Process improvements reduce avoidable downtime and improve production flow.
* Safety and workplace organization: Safe work practices and housekeeping standards are consistently enforced. Hazards and incidents are reported promptly, and assigned corrective actions are completed by their due dates.
* Communication and follow-through: Priorities, staffing concerns, and production risks are communicated promptly to the appropriate partners. Assigned actions and production readiness milestones are completed on time.

**Qualifications**
==================

* 10+ years of upholstery, pattern, and assembly experience and 5+ years of running an upholstery operation.
* High school diploma or GED required.
* Strong reading, writing, math, analysis, comprehension, administrative, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to set clear priorities, manage and hold people accountable, monitor performance, document personnel matters, and collaborate across operations, HR, engineering, product development, and suppliers.
* A practical, continuous-improvement mindset with a strong commitment to safety, quality, delivery, and respectful people leadership.

**Physical Requirements and Work Environment**
==============================================

This is an on-site role in an active manufacturing environment. The position requires excellent vision, hearing/listening, and clear speech; hand and finger dexterity; lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds; pushing and pulling; local driving; color perception; touch/feel; and the ability to move within and between facilities. Work includes frequent face-to-face and verbal interaction with others and may involve dirt or dust, fumes or odors, moving objects, and work at heights.

**Benefits**
============

401(k), dental insurance, health insurance, life insurance, paid time off, retirement plan, and vision insurance.
