role.title: Senior Manager of Digital Quality Systems
role.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's Quality organization is seeking a Senior Manager, Digital Quality Systems to lead the team responsible for our digital quality platform and analytics infrastructure. The Quality team works with our customers, internal teams, and suppliers to ensure the deployment of reliable products that meet all mission requirements. We develop cutting-edge quality processes and methods to secure scalable, long-term business success. We are growing rapidly across multiple product lines and sites, and this role will own the quality workflows inside Forge, our homegrown Manufacturing Execution System, and the Quality Intelligence Hub, our centralized analytics and compliance layer built on Databricks. The right person for this role lives at the intersection of software and quality engineering, someone who can design a data model, review code, ship in sprints, and understand how nonconformance, CAPA, and inspection processes work on a real factory floor. If you want to build the digital quality backbone for the next generation of defense manufacturing, this is the seat.

**This role is subject to ITAR. Applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.**

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Platform architecture.** Own the design of quality workflows in Forge: inspection routings, data capture points, decision logic and audit trails. Keep them version-controlled and audit-ready.
* **Core quality workflows.** Build NC, disposition, containment, CAPA, SCAR and inspection instructions into production flow, not bolted on after it.
* **Quality Intelligence Hub.** Direct the data models and dashboards behind FPY, DPU, escape rates, CAPA aging, NC Pareto, supplier scorecards and SPC trending.
* **Operator experience.** Make sure floor operators and quality engineers get fast, error-resistant tools they actually want to use.
* **Team leadership.** Lead developers, data engineers, analysts and quality SMEs: set sprint priorities, review designs and code, and unblock decisions.
* **Cross-functional alignment.** Keep the platform in step with product development, supplier quality, reliability and manufacturing as programs and sites scale.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on software experience.
* 10+ years building or leading enterprise software, manufacturing systems or quality systems, with 5+ years leading engineers or analysts.
* Hands-on software credibility: you can sketch an architecture, challenge a schema, read a pull request and make build-vs-buy calls.
* Working knowledge of enterprise quality processes: NC, CAPA, SCAR, disposition, containment, inspection and document control, and how each translates into data capture and workflow.
* Data and analytics fluency: SQL and Python, and experience with a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or similar.
* Experience running agile delivery: sprint planning, backlog grooming, CI/CD and iterative releases with a cross-functional team.
* Comfort making architecture decisions with imperfect information in a fast-scaling environment.
* U.S. citizenship is required pursuant to contractual obligations.

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with a homegrown or heavily customized MES, not only out-of-the-box SAP QM or Windchill.
* Aerospace, defense, medical device or other regulated manufacturing background (AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485).
* Practical AI/ML use in production workflows or strong personal fluency with AI tooling.
* Statistical methods in practice: SPC, MSA and process capability analysis.
* IoT-enabled inspection data capture, automated optical inspection or machine vision integration.
* APQP/PPAP or FMEA tied into digital quality systems.
* ASQ certification (CQE, CMQ/OE or Six Sigma Black Belt).

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

 

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
 + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
 + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.
 
 
Job Summary
 
 
Position is responsible for Customer Relationship Management (CRM) for patients, families, and physicians at the hospital level. This position includes development and implementation of initiatives to drive behavior change, process improvement and environment changes based on customer wants and needs. This position works closely with the CEO and the Memorial Hermann CRM team, develops objectives and goals, specific to the facility, to achieve best-in-class customer satisfaction.
 
Job Description
 
 
Minimum Qualifications
 
**Education:** Bachelors degree
 
**Licenses/Certifications:** (None)
 
 
**Experience / Knowledge / Skills:** 

* One (1) year of education, customer service or process improvement experience
* Experience in leading and managing multi-functional teams to improve processes
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and listening)
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills
* Experience in using both qualitative and quantitative consumer information to drive customer satisfaction

Principal Accountabilities
 
 

* Plans and coordinates overall program to assure excellent customer service in all areas; develops improvement programs based on identified customer service needs; analyzes and interprets customer service surveys’ works with directors, managers, and front line staff to achieve desired outcomes; reports regularly at departmental meetings, hospital and medical staff committees and service lines.
* Works in collaboration with the Memorial Hermann CRM department in developing and implementing initiatives designed to improve the customer experience either through behavior change, process improvement or environmental factors.
* Accountable for making measurable improvements in customer satisfaction measures and achievement of Memorial Hermann targets and goals with respect to customer opinion and services.
* Collaborates with administrative, medical, nursing, ancillary, and legal/risk management staff on problem investigation, resolution, response, and prevention. Provides education to staff on complaint management, patient rights, and customer service.
* Resource for leadership in hospital for customer satisfaction surveys and process improvement around the patients and families and physicians experience.
* Leads and participates in cross-functional teams to manage initiatives related to the customer experience.
* Demonstrates organizational agility to keep CRM initiatives moving forward.
* Ensures hospital customer service projects are completed on time and on budget.
* Present to various audiences ranging from customer service modules for employees to presentations for hospital leadership.
* Works with performance improvement techniques to proactively implement systems (people, processes, and technology) to enhance the customer’s experience.

role.title: Plant Manager III Monroe Plant (Monroe, NC)
role.description:
**Job Details:**

**Summary**

This position is responsible for all functional areas of a poultry processing plant, including the efficient operation of three production shifts, maintenance, personnel safety, shipping and receiving, sanitation, scheduling, quality, and process improvement. The role also includes motivating managers to provide guidance and development programs that enhance employee skill levels, resolving issues related to the quality of incoming and outgoing goods, and reviewing cost and performance data to identify areas for improvement.

Additional responsibilities include compiling monthly expense and efficiency reports, promoting and explaining Total Quality Management (TQM) philosophy to employees, and obtaining approval for and executing all plant capital improvement projects. This position is responsible for facilitating Talent Mapping and Succession Planning programs and supporting retention initiatives. The role is also accountable for food safety, food quality, and product legality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Direct and oversee all functional areas of a poultry processing plant.
* Ensure the efficient operation of three production shifts, including maintenance, personnel safety, shipping and receiving, sanitation, scheduling, quality, and process improvement activities.
* Motivate and support managers in providing guidance and development programs to enhance employee skills and performance.
* Resolve issues related to the quality of incoming and outgoing goods.
* Analyze cost and performance data to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* Compile and present monthly expense and efficiency reports.
* Promote and communicate the principles of Total Quality Management (TQM) throughout the facility.
* Obtain approval for and execute all plant capital improvement projects.
* Facilitate Talent Mapping and Succession Planning programs.
* Support employee retention initiatives.
* Maintain accountability for food safety, food quality, and product legality.
* Initiate and implement improvements across all phases of production.
* Assist in identifying, evaluating, and correcting operational problems.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as needed.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, typically acquired through four years of college-level study in a general professional or technical field.

**Experience**

* Eight (8) or more years of progressive leadership experience required.
* Experience in the poultry industry or the food processing industry preferred.

**Computer Skills**

* General knowledge of computer applications used in plant operations, including Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Outlook
* Working knowledge of SAP systems preferred.

**Communication Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Travel**

* Ability to travel approximately 6 to 11 times per year.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Responsible for managing multiple groups of personnel performing diverse tasks and activities across more than one department.

All professional team members are expected to demonstrate responsible use of approved AI tools, including safeguarding sensitive information, adhering to company policies, and validating AI-generated outputs. Individual Contributors should demonstrate the ability to integrate AI into daily work, improve efficiency through AI-enabled solutions, evaluate outputs critically, and apply professional judgment when using AI. People Leaders should demonstrate the ability to drive responsible AI adoption, enable effective use of approved solutions, identify opportunities to improve team performance through AI, and ensure accountability for the quality and accuracy of AI-supported outcomes.

Yes

1ST SHIFT (United States of America)

role.title: Sr. Director Data Engineering and Operations - Erlanger, KY
role.description:
**Sr. Director Data Engineering and Operations - Erlanger, KY**
 
 
**Role Summary**
 
The Head of Data Engineering & Operations leads data engineering as a capability at ADM: the talent, engineering standards, and delivery quality of the data engineers who work inside data product and digital product teams. You are one of the builders of the enterprise data foundation, working in partnership with Platform & Architecture and the Product teams. Engineers from the ADM Capability Center (ACC) are part of the team from day one.
 
Operations sits within this role, including the managed-services partner relationship. You will lead its integration into the product model, so that running data products and building them are owned together rather than by a separate organization.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
 
**Scope & Parterships**

**What you lead**

* Data engineering as a capability across data product and digital product teams, including ACC engineers: talent, standards, and delivery quality.
* Operations, including the managed-services partner relationship, as part of a planned path to full integration into the product model.
* Managing budgets, capacity, sourcing strategy, and vendor performance.
* Lead and partner with globally distributed teams across North America, EMEA, LATAM, APAC, and the ADM Capability Center, overseeing employees and contractors, including data engineers embedded within Data Product and Digital Product teams, as well as Data Operations.
* Communicating strategy, progress, risk, and value to executives, product leaders, and business partners.
* Measure and report the value of the capability including productivity, cost, quality, retention, and innovation output.

**Who you partner with**
------------------------

* Platform & Architecture, who own the data platform and architectural direction. You make sure engineers build well on them and bring what teams need back to them.
* Product teams, who own product priorities and roadmaps. You make sure they have the engineering talent and delivery quality to meet them.
* Data Governance and MDM teams, on data quality, metadata, lineage, and validation.
* Advance Analytics and AI teams to ensure data is trusted, accessible and AI ready.

**Outcomes You Will Deliver**
=============================

**1. Data products the business trusts and uses**
-------------------------------------------------

Production-grade, reusable data products, built and run by product teams, that are adopted across the enterprise.

* Secure, scalable pipelines and data products with clear ownership, defined data contracts, and service levels for availability, freshness, quality, and resolution time.
* Production health visible by design: observability, incident and problem management, and release readiness built into every product, with Operations performance reported against agreed service levels.

**2. ACC leverage**
-------------------

The ADM Capability Center is a fully integrated global engineering team

* ACC engineers work as full members of product teams, under the same standards, expectations, and career paths.
* Depth, ownership, and scope in ACC across design, build, and operations, will be measured through productivity, quality, retention, and innovation output.

**3. Engineering practices**
----------------------------

Consistent, modern engineering practices in every data and digital product team.

* Engineering standards and patterns adopted by teams, including testing, CI/CD, code review, security, privacy, and ITGC and SOX controls, as guardrails that speed delivery rather than gates that slow it.
* AI-assisted engineering and other emerging capabilities evaluated through disciplined pilots, then operationalized where they work.

**4. Talent for both product models**
-------------------------------------

A deep bench of data engineering talent that grows and moves across data product and digital product teams.

* Hiring, development, retention, and succession for a global team, supported by a strong team culture, clear communication rhythms, and knowledge-sharing across regions and time zones.
* Capacity, sourcing, and partner mix matched to the demands of both product models, with budgets and partner performance managed to plan.

**5. Data readiness**
---------------------

Enterprise data that is trusted, governed, and ready for analytics, operations, and AI.

* Data quality, metadata, lineage, and validation built into engineering work in partnership with Data Governance, MDM, and Platform & Architecture.
* Integration across applications, files, APIs, and operational and IoT sources following shared patterns, so analytics and AI use cases move from pilot to production.

**Qualifications** 
**Required**
================================

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (Master's preferred).
* Minimum 12 years in data engineering, data platforms, or data operations, with 5+ years leading large, global teams.
* Experience leading engineering talent embedded in product teams, and partnering effectively with platform, architecture, and product leaders.
* Experience building global teams in which capability center engineers work as full members of product teams.
* Proven delivery of production-grade data products on enterprise-scale cloud data platforms (Lakehouse/data lake, Data warehousing, ETL, batch and streaming ingestion).
* Experience setting and driving adoption of engineering standards and practices across multiple teams.
* Experience running production data operations with SLAs, observability, incident management, and ITGC/SOX-type controls, ideally within a product-aligned operating model.
* Experience managing managed-service partners alongside internal teams.
* Experience contributing to large-scale technology transformation and aligning data capabilities to enterprise strategy.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen.

Preferred
---------

* Hands-on exposure to AI/ML or generative and agentic AI enablement, including AI-assisted engineering.
* Background in a global, regulated, or manufacturing/supply-chain enterprise, including operational technology (OT) or IoT data.
* Familiarity with enterprise application data landscapes (e.g., ERP).
* Relevant cloud or data platform certifications.

Excited about this role but don’t think you meet every requirement listed? We encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings.
 
 
ADM requires the successful completion of a background check.

**Benefits and Perks**
 
 
Enriching the quality of life for the world begins by taking care of our colleagues. In addition to competitive pay, we support your diverse needs with a comprehensive total rewards package to enhance your well-being, including:

* **Physical wellness** – medical/Rx, dental, vision and on-site wellness center access or gym reimbursement (as applicable).
* **Financial wellness** – flexible spending accounts, health savings account, 401(k) with matching contributions and cash balance plan, discounted employee stock purchasing program, life insurance, disability, workers’ compensation, legal assistance, identity theft protection.
* **Mental and social wellness** – Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and Colleague Giving Programs (ADM Cares).

Additional benefits include:
 

* Paid time off including paid holidays.
* Adoption assistance and paid maternity and parental leave.
* Tuition assistance.
* Company-sponsored training and development resources, such as LinkedIn Learning, language training and mentoring programs.
* Benefits may vary for bargained locations, confirm benefit eligibility with your recruiter.

We respect and value the unique backgrounds and experiences that each person can bring to ADM because we know that diversity of perspectives makes us better, together.

At ADM, we unlock the power of nature to provide access to nutrition worldwide. With industry-advancing innovations, a complete portfolio of ingredients and solutions to meet any taste, and a commitment to sustainability, we give customers an edge in solving the nutritional challenges of today and tomorrow. We’re a global leader in human and animal nutrition and the world’s premier agricultural origination and processing company. Our breadth, depth, insights, facilities and logistical expertise give us unparalleled capabilities to meet needs for food, beverages, health and wellness, and more. From the seed of the idea to the outcome of the solution, we enrich the quality of life the world over. Learn more at www.adm.com.

role.description:
Location:
Gaithersburg, MD, US, 20879 Gaithersburg, MD, US, 20879 US

**Preparedness today, safer tomorrow.**

Emergent is a leading public health company that delivers protective and life-saving solutions to
 
communities around the world.

We go where others won’t, taking on some of the biggest public health challenges to protect and enhance millions of lives, and create a better, more secure world. Here, you will join passionate professionals who advance their scientific, technical and professional skills to develop products designed to protect and enhance life.

 

**Why This Role Matters**

At Emergent, our work protects communities and strengthens global health security. As **Head of IT Infrastructure & Operations**, you will lead the organization’s global technology infrastructure and end-user services.

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Senior Director, Head of IT Infrastructure & Operations leads the strategy, engineering, security, reliability, and day-to-day operation of the company’s global technology infrastructure and end-user services. The role is accountable for resilient, secure, compliant, and cost-effective delivery across hybrid cloud, data centers, networks, compute, storage, workplace technology, service management, collaboration, and infrastructure platforms supporting a global 24/7 business and regulated operations. The position modernizes the infrastructure operating model through automation, observability, data-driven service management, and responsible use of AI, while maintaining disciplined lifecycle, continuity, validation, and vendor governance.

 

**What You'll Do**

*Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Enterprise leadership and strategy**

* Serve as a member of the CIO’s IT Leadership Team and act as the executive owner for enterprise infrastructure and operations capabilities.
* Define and execute a multi-year infrastructure and operations strategy, architecture, investment roadmap, lifecycle plan, and operating model aligned to business priorities, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data strategy, and application modernization.
* Translate technology choices into clear business outcomes, risks, service commitments, investment requirements, and decision points for senior leaders.
* Bring an infrastructure, integration, resiliency, and operability perspective to enterprise programs, acquisitions, site changes, and major technology initiatives.

**Hybrid cloud, platforms, and architecture**

* Lead a fit-for-purpose hybrid cloud strategy spanning public cloud, SaaS, private hosting, and on-premises environments; establish standards for landing zones, connectivity, identity integration, workload placement, scalability, portability, and cost governance.
* Own infrastructure architecture and engineering standards for networks, compute, storage, backup, recovery, databases and middleware where assigned, collaboration, telephony, endpoint and workplace platforms, and core operational tooling.
* Partner with application, data, security, quality, and business teams to ensure platforms are interoperable, supportable, validated where required, and designed for availability, performance, recoverability, and lifecycle sustainability.
* Establish technology currency and technical-debt practices that reduce unsupported platforms, single points of failure, and avoid operational risk.

**Operational excellence, service management, and employee experience**

* Lead global 24/7 infrastructure operations, service desk, workplace services, major incident management, problem management, change enablement, configuration and asset practices, capacity management, and service continuity.
* Establish service catalogs, service ownership, service level objectives and agreements, operational level agreements, KPIs, experience measures, and executive reporting that connect service performance to business impact.
* Build mature monitoring, observability, event management, and command-center practices to identify degradation early, accelerate restoration, and drive permanent corrective action.
* Continuously improve employee technology experience across offices, laboratories, manufacturing and distribution environments, remote work, and executive support.

**Cyber resilience, continuity, and compliance**

* Partner with the Chief Information Security Officer and Quality organization to embed secure-by-design, zero-trust, privileged-access, vulnerability, patching, hardening, segmentation, backup protection, recovery, and logging requirements into infrastructure services.
* Own infrastructure disaster recovery and technology continuity capabilities, including business-aligned recovery objectives, dependency mapping, crisis response integration, documented recovery procedures, and regular exercises.
* Ensure infrastructure services meet applicable company policies and regulated-life-sciences requirements, including controlled change, documentation, qualification or validation, data integrity, audit readiness, and evidence retention where required.
* Ensure operational risks, exceptions, and control gaps are visible, assigned, prioritized, and remediated or formally accepted.

**Automation, AI-enabled operations, and data**

* Develop an automation-first operating model using infrastructure as code, orchestration, self-service, policy as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment and recovery patterns.
* Adopt AI-enabled operations responsibly to improve event correlation, knowledge retrieval, service desk support, capacity forecasting, anomaly detection, and operational decision support, with appropriate human oversight, security, privacy, records, and compliance controls.
* Create trusted operational data and dashboards that enable trend analysis, predictive insight, cost transparency, risk prioritization, and measurable continual improvement.
* Build workforce capability in cloud, automation, AI, cybersecurity, service reliability, and modern engineering practices.

**Financial, supplier, and talent leadership**

* Own infrastructure and operations financial planning, forecasting, cloud financial management, contract optimization, and investment prioritization.
* Lead strategic sourcing activities, including RFPs, RFIs, SOWs, contract and service-level negotiations, supplier performance, concentration risk, exit planning, and third-party resilience.
* Lead, develop, and retain a diverse global team; clarify accountabilities, succession, cross-training, on-call expectations, and skills plans across employees, managed service providers, and specialist partners.
* Create a culture of ownership, disciplined execution, transparency, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
 

The above statements describe the general nature of work performed in this job. They are not an exhaustive list of duties, and other duties may be assigned.

 

**What You Bring**

 

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Advanced degree is preferred.
* Typically 15+ years of progressive technology experience, including 7+ years leading multiple infrastructure, operations, engineering, or service delivery teams in a complex global enterprise.
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide infrastructure transformation and operating-model change in a highly regulated environment; life-sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated accountability for global, business-critical, 24/7 services delivered through a mix of internal teams, public cloud, SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, colocation, telecommunications, managed services, and outsourcing partners.

**Required Skills and Abilities**

* Executive leadership, business acumen, financial stewardship, and the ability to communicate complex technology choices as business value, risk, resilience, cost, and employee impact.
* Deep working knowledge of hybrid cloud, enterprise networking, compute, storage, backup and recovery, identity dependencies, endpoint and workplace technology, collaboration, telephony, monitoring, observability, and service management.
* Experience with modern engineering and operations practices, including automation, infrastructure as code, configuration management, APIs, DevSecOps, site reliability concepts, capacity engineering, and technology lifecycle management.
* Ability to establish metrics and use operational, experience, risk, and financial data to prioritize work and demonstrate outcomes.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity infrastructure controls and close partnership with security teams on zero trust, segmentation, vulnerability and patch management, privileged access, secure configuration, logging, resilience, and incident response.
* Experience designing, testing, and improving business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities across complex application and infrastructure dependencies.
* Knowledge of cGMP expectations and experience supporting validated or qualified technology in regulated life-sciences environments, including change control, documentation, data integrity, and audit readiness.
* Experience governing AI-enabled operational use cases with appropriate controls for security, privacy, compliance, transparency, reliability, and human oversight.
* Proven ability to lead in a matrixed environment, build coalitions, influence executives, negotiate with suppliers, and manage competing priorities during incidents and transformation.
* Strong talent leadership, coaching, succession planning, organizational design, sourcing strategy, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive influencing skills.

**Preferred Knowledge and Credentials**

* Familiarity with ITIL practices and modern service management; relevant ITIL certification is preferred.
* Familiarity with cloud architecture and financial management practices; relevant cloud or FinOps credentials are preferred.
* Familiarity with recognized cybersecurity, resilience, and control frameworks used by the company.
* Experience supporting ERP, laboratory, manufacturing, quality, and data platforms with demanding availability, integration, and compliance requirements.
 

**Ready To Make an Impact?**

If you’re an IT Infrastructure Leader ready to bring your expertise and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join a mission-driven organization where your insights will support decisions that protect and enhance lives around the world. Apply today and help us build a safer, healthier future.

 

U.S. Base Pay Ranges and Benefits Information

The estimated annual base salary as a new hire for this position ranges from [206,500 to $250,000]. Individual base pay depends on various factors such as applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. Certain roles are eligible for additional incentive compensation, including merit increases, annual bonus, [and/or long-term incentives in the form of stock options.]

Additionally, Emergent offers a comprehensive benefits package\*. Information regarding additional benefits can be found here: https://www.emergentbiosolutions.com/careers/life-at-emergent

*(\*Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies).*

If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a Human Resources Partner about our compensation philosophy and available benefits.

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform all essential functions.*

Emergent BioSolutions is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and values the diversity of our workforce. Emergent does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, marital status, physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, genetic information or any other characteristics protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

**ABOUT EMERGENT**
------------------

Emergent prepares those entrusted with protecting their communities against current and future health threats.

Our drive towards this vision informs all of our actions—whether it is our approach to product development, manufacturing, encouraging employee health and wellness or giving back to the community—we strive every day to achieve this shared goal.

**WE BELIEVE IN OUR VALUES**

 + *We are engaged and accountable for delivering on our commitments.*

role.title: PE Quality Senior Manager
role.description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The PE Quality Control Head of Department (HOD) is responsible for leading the company's overall quality management function across internal manufacturing processes, suppliers, outsourcing partners, and OEM customers for MOBIS North America Electrified Powertrain, LLC. (MNAe). Reporting to both the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and the Quality Control Head of Group (HOG), the HOD establishes quality strategy, objectives, governance, and priorities; oversees MIP process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, and overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production; leads major investigations and escalations; and ensures that containment, root cause, corrective action, and effectiveness verification are completed to protect customers, stabilize production, and prevent recurrence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** *(To perform within this position successfully, the incumbent must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.)*

* Represent the Quality Control function in executive reviews, customer meetings, supplier escalations, audits, and other strategic business discussions.
* Promote a proactive quality culture, continuous improvement, customer focus, supplier accountability, and workplace safety.
* Define decision-making and escalation authority and make timely quality decisions, including containment, production hold, shipment hold, sorting, rework, and controlled release recommendations when required.
* Supervise, coach, and develop Quality Control HOSs, managers, Assistant Managers, Specialists, and other assigned quality personnel.
* Evaluate departmental capability, workload, staffing, competency, and training needs and allocate resources based on business and quality risk.
* Plan and oversee internal, supplier, customer, and certification audits and ensure timely closure and effectiveness of follow-up actions.
* Lead cross-functional quality decisions and collaboration with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering, Maintenance, Logistics, Purchasing, Supplier Quality, Program Management, and other relevant functions.
* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, internal policies, and applicable quality requirements.
* Develop and continuously improve quality management systems, procedures, standards, inspection controls, traceability, rework controls, NCR processes, Quality Alerts, and escalation processes.
* Review and approve daily, weekly, and monthly departmental quality reports, quality trends, KPIs, recurring issue analysis, and improvement priorities.
* Report quality performance, significant risks, customer and supplier escalations, resource needs, and recovery status directly to the CEO and executive management.
* Maintain executive-level relationships with OEM customers and lead quality communication, claims, audits, investigations, corrective action submissions, and escalation response.
* Maintain management-level communication with outsourcing partners and OEM customers regarding ICCU and HPCU production quality performance, major issues, investigation results, corrective action status, and quality recovery plans.
* Communicate directly with suppliers and oversee supplier quality activities, including supplier containment, investigation, corrective action, response status, escalation, and closure.
* Oversee containment, affected-scope determination, traceability, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification.
* Ensure issues are properly classified as internal process, supplier, design, logistics, or customer-interface related and assign clear ownership for resolution.
* Lead and approve major investigations involving internal defects, supplier-related issues, customer complaints, field concerns, and quality escalations.
* Direct MIP process quality, supplier quality, and customer quality activities across Stator, Motor, Reducer, PE System, Inverter, and related electrified powertrain products.
* Direct overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production, including outsourcing-partner performance, process controls, change points, audits, defect trends, containment, corrective actions, escalation, and effectiveness verification.
* Establish and execute departmental quality strategy, objectives, policies, governance, priorities, and performance indicators aligned with company business objectives.
* Lead the company's overall quality management activities covering internal manufacturing processes, supplied components, finished products, and OEM customer interfaces.

**Required Knowledge, SkillsAbilities:**

role.title: Executive Director Operations – West Palm Beach
role.description:
Join the Cleveland Clinic team where you will work alongside passionate caregivers and provide patient-first healthcare. Here, you will receive endless support and appreciation while building a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.

 

As Executive Director of Operations – West Palm Beach, you will oversee the daily operations of assigned hospitals, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational priorities, and high-quality patient care. You will work closely with hospital leadership and the Vice President of Operations to improve efficiency, monitor financial performance, support physicians and caregivers, and lead key strategic growth initiatives across the market.

 
 

This position will also play a critical leadership role in the planning, activation, and operational oversight of major expansion efforts in the West Palm Beach market. Our new 120,000-square-foot outpatient facility, is fully designed and currently under construction, with an anticipated opening in November 2027. Activation workstreams for this facility are now beginning, and this role will be instrumental in leading and coordinating those efforts.

 

As Executive Director of Operations – West Palm Beach, you will oversee the daily operations of assigned hospitals, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational priorities, and high-quality patient care. You will work closely with hospital leadership and the Vice President of Operations to improve efficiency, monitor financial performance, support physicians and caregivers, and lead key strategic growth initiatives across the market.

 

**A caregiver in this position works days from 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.**

 

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

* Execute the strategic and operational goals of the organization and supports strategy implementation for assigned hospital(s).
* Lead planning, activation, and operational readiness efforts for 15 City Place, the new 120,000-square-foot outpatient facility opening in November 2027.
* Serve as the West Palm Beach operations lead for planning, activation, and oversight once the new hospital opens.
* Assess and drives stakeholder engagement for new business opportunities that are presented from local, national, and international sources.
* Partner with hospital leadership to develop the strategic and operational goals and needs of the organization and support strategy implementation.
* Work with partners such as Regent ASC Management Company and others to support community physician engagement and identify opportunities across outpatient and inpatient settings.
* Lead teams to execute on service line transitions, new services or programs and operational enhancements and changes.
* Manage daily facility operations for assigned hospital(s). Manage ambulatory operations and hospital facilities for associated Provider-Based Billing locations.
* Manage daily ancillary services in partnership with Institute leadership.
* Coordinate and direct the hospital allied health and operational leads to ensure operational efficiencies and patient focused care.
* Demonstrate visibility and accessibility to staff by making rounds, conducting staff meetings, and focus on caregiver engagement strategies. Support caregiver engagement initiatives by driving response rates and any required improvements for caregiver engagement and culture of safety surveys.
* Provide input to design facility master plan and specific physical facilities. Participate and execute on planning activities.
* Develop and monitor annual operating budget for the areas assigned and financials of designated hospital(s) in partnership with shared services, where appropriate.
* Monitor financial and operational performance in partnership with Finance (e.g. budgeted volumes, revenues, expenses) for assigned hospital(s).
* Oversee execution of capital projects, expansion projects, and operating initiatives. Provide input to design facility master plan and specific physical facilities for anchor facility assigned hospital(s).
* Monitor workforce productivity of shared services and allied health, maximizing productivity with appropriate authority delegation to achieve goals in partnership with shared services and ancillary leaders. Seek to maximize productivity and efficiencies across submarket.
* Support hospital throughput in collaboration with physician and nursing leadership. Serve as a liaison between the medical staff and clinical departments; promotes environment of collaboration with medical staff and hospital clinical departments to provide for the needs of patients.
* Assure regulatory requirements (TJC, AHCA, CMS, NFPA, OSHA, etc.) are met for entire submarket. Collaborates with the governing body, management, medical staff and clinical staff in planning, promoting and conducting hospital-wide performance assessment and improvement. Report findings to appropriate hospital, medical and governing board committees.
* Participate with members of hospital governing board, medical staff, administrative team, and hospital management in the design and execution of strategic plan.
 

Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Health Care Administration or related field and ten years of progressively responsible experience in a healthcare environment, hospital or health system, including 5 years of demonstrated management experience
* Understanding of economics and market forces of the health care industry
* Strong hospital management experience
* Experience and responsibility for recruitment, budgeting, and strategic development with a strong track record of success
* Experience in managing clinical services and support services in competitive markets, including productivity enhancement, cost reduction, new program development, quality improvement, and lean and process improvement strategies.
 

Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

* Master’s Degree
* Hospital activation/opening experience
* Design and construction planning experience
* Physician relationship development
* Experience leading growth initiatives
 

 

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to perform work in a stationary position for extended periods.
* Ability to operate a computer and other office equipment.
* Ability to communicate effectively and exchange accurate information.
* Ability to travel throughout the health system.
 

 

**Personal Protective Equipment:**

* Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment as required for procedures.

**Pay Range**

Minimum Annual Salary: $151,220.00

Maximum Annual Salary: $298,640.00

The pay range displayed on this job posting reflects the anticipated range for new hires. A successful candidate’s actual compensation will be determined after taking factors into consideration such as the candidate’s work history, experience, skill set and education. The pay range displayed does not include any applicable pay practices (e.g., shift differentials, overtime, etc.). The pay range does not include the value of Cleveland Clinic’s benefits package (e.g., healthcare, dental and vision benefits, retirement savings account contributions, etc.).

role.title: Vice President, Commercial Manufacturing Operations
role.description:
Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney. Vera Therapeutics’ flagship commercial product is TRUTAKNATM (atacicept-vymj), a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand *(*APRIL) inhibitor. Vera Therapeutics is evaluating multiple diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies through inhibition of BAFF and APRIL may prove clinically meaningful. Vera Therapeutics was founded in 2016 and is based in Brisbane, California. To learn more, visit www.veratx.com.

At Vera, our values are the cornerstone of our culture and guide how we work together every day. We lead with empathy, act with an owner’s mindset, demand clarity, work without fences, and execute with urgency because patients are counting on us. From how we hire and develop our people to how we advance rigorous science, we are building a team committed to transforming medicine in autoimmune diseases, starting with the kidney.

**Position Summary:**

The Vice President, Manufacturing Operations will report to the SVP Product Development and Manufacturing (PD&T) and will be responsible for leading the transition from a clinical-stage organization to an effective commercial manufacturing organization. As a key partner to the SVP PD&T, the candidate will lead and develop a best-in-class manufacturing and supply chain team that can collaboratively work across functions to enable commercial launch of our lead product into global markets. While working with internal teams, such as quality, regulatory, commercial, and finance, and external contract service providers, the individual is responsible for ensuring that the end-to-end supply chain is set up to meet the global commercial product demand with keen eye towards continuous process improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Leads the manufacturing and supply chain teams, providing leadership aligned with Vera values resulting in a high performing organization
* Contributes to the strategic leadership of Vera’s late-stage programs acting as a strong team player
* Participate in sales and operations planning (S&OP) and Product Development Teams representing the Product Development and Manufacturing function
* Create synergy and knowledge sharing to enable optimal production planning processes to balance supply/demand risks
* Serves as a single point of contact to manage end-to-end global supply chain and foster the needed supplier relationships to drive excellence using appropriate metrics
* Serves as a strategic thought leader to craft and manage commercial supply contracts with an eye towards life cycle extension programs
* Create, develop and manage necessary tools for end-to-end demand/supply planning
* Provide strategic direction, technical guidance, and long-range planning for late-stage programs: BLA-enabling studies through BLA submission, commercial launch, and sustaining operations
* Develop and manage department budgets and ensure fiscal responsibility for manufacturing operations
* Develop fit for purpose operational processes and systems to support supplier metrics and other tools to enable continuous improvement / process excellence
* Willingness to take on additional duties and responsibilities as assigned, and to adapt to changes in job scope as organizational needs evolve

**Qualifications:**

* Master's degree required. PhD preferred. Degree in Life Sciences or Engineering preferred
* 15+ years of relevant experience from biopharmaceutical manufacturing required.
* 5+ years of senior-level line management experience leading other leaders required
* Proven track record of creating business results
* Deep technical, operational, regulatory, strategic, and quality expertise, along with a proven track record of leading late-stage programs in innovative biotech or pharmaceutical organizations
* Experience with operating and navigating regulatory requirements including authoring and reviewing BLAs and interacting with regulatory authorities
* Solid understanding of drug development within the biopharmaceutical industry
* Experience within development and manufacturing of monoclonal antibodies or related field preferred
* Excellent interpersonal skills, collaborative leadership style
* Leads by example in recognizing and modeling Vera values
* Learning agility: ability to seek input, make connections, recognize patterns that lead to effective decision-making and action
* Proven ability to thoughtfully evaluate processes, identify opportunities for improvement and successfully execute on those plans
* Strong communication skills (oral & written); able to effectively interact with all levels internally and externally – able to tailor communications to the audience to achieve desired results
* Attention to detail with ability to move easily between hands-on work and strategic thinking
* Ability to multitask and prioritize.
* Strong leadership skills with a desire to nurture, train, and grow the existing finance group
* Demonstrated ability to influence and deliver results in a virtual (outsourced) environment

Vera Therapeutics Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

Vera Therapeutics is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.

For this role, the anticipated base pay range is

$264,000 - $400,000 USD

At Vera, base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus, new hire equity, and ongoing performance-based equity. Vera Therapeutics also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k match, flexible time off, and a number of paid holidays.

**Notice to Recruiters/Staffing Agencies**

Recruiters and staffing agencies should not contact Vera Therapeutics through this page. All recruitment vendors (search firms, recruitment agencies, and staffing companies) are prohibited from contacting our hiring manager(s), executive team members, or employees.

We require that all recruiters and staffing agencies have a fully executed, formal written agreement on file.

Vera Therapeutics’ receipt or acceptance of an unsolicited resume submitted by a vendor organization to this website or employee does not constitute an actual or implied contract between Vera Therapeutics and such organization and will be considered unsolicited and Vera Therapeutics will not be responsible for related fees.

**Fraud Alert**

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are a top priority for us. At Vera Therapeutics, recruiters only direct candidates to apply through our official career page at https://veratx.com/careers/.

Recruiters will always contact you using the domain of veratx.com. We will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information like social security numbers. If you are unsure if a message is from Vera Therapeutics, please email human resources.

**CA Privacy Notice**

Applicants residing in California should review our California Privacy Notice for Employees, Job Applicants, and Contractors, which describes the categories of personal information we collect, how we use it, and your privacy rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act: https://veratx.com/ca-privacy/.

**Company:** HealthAlliance Hospital

**City/State:** Kingston, NY

**Category:** Executive/Management

**Department:** Quality/Performance Improvement

**Union:** Yes

**Union Name:** N/A

**Position:** Full Time

**Hours:** 7.5

**Shift:** Day

**Req #:** 50089

**Posted Date:** Nov 11, 2026

**Hiring Range:** $160,013-$202,547

External Applicant link Internal Applicant link

\*If you are hired by WMCHealth, your final base salary will be determined based on job-related factors, including employment status (full-time, part-time or per diem), relevant skills, qualifications and experience. Consistent with our commitment to pay equity, we also consider internal equity among similarly situated employees when determining final compensation.

 

### **Job Details:**

JOB SUMMARY Working directly under the VP, Quality Management, provides oversight to designing and administering a comprehensive hospital wide Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement with focus on the Patient Experience that meets organization strategic objectives and improves patient outcomes and quality of care. RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible for directing QA/QI Management activities by identifying areas of potential for improvement in quality, safety or other identified risks in accordance with the department and hospital mission. Directs the collection, measurement and presentation of data required for monitoring performance improvement and quality initiatives regardingpatient satisfaction and experience.Oversees and designs quality dashboards as appropriate Provides leadership to the Medical Staff in identification of quality and performance improvement opportunities based on department peer review activity and organization-wide quality initiatives data. Communicates and acts as a liaison with outside agencies such as CMS, IPRO,National Research Corporation or other appropriate agency as to ensure compliance with external reporting requirements and improvement initiatives. Works closely with Vice President QualityMgt. and all departments by serving as a resource, facilitator and consultant for hospital wide quality improvement activities including QI Teams, RCAs and other organization projects. Provides leadership to departments and teams in quality improvement activities with the integration of continuous improvement methodologies such as PDSA, Rapid Response processes, Lean Thinking, ISO9001 and performance improvement tools. Responsible forcontributing to the “Quality” section on the hospital intranet site to provide staff updates on organization quality and patient safety initiatives, the Patient Experience activity. Responsible for the review, revisions and leadership of the Hospital Wide Quality Management program so as to include all performance activities and patient experience initiatives. Participates and provides expertise and support to multiple committees and programs within and external to the organization for broadening the opportunities of PI activities as driven by goals for quality, safety and customer relation QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS EXPERIENCE 5 years experience in health care environment–preferable in acute care. At least three years in quality and/or risk management and quality improvement activities is preferred. Current experience in assessment and analysis skills. EDUCATION Registered Nurse with BSN and MSN or other healthcare degree equivalent — desirable. LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS Advanced computer and analytical skills. Current knowledge of NYS Health Code, DNV Standards, and CMS Quality Initiatives. Continuing education in quality improvement and management of risks. Excellent oral and written communication, interpersonal and presentation skills required. Current NYS RN Licensure. OTHER None specified SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS N/A PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS PHYSICAL ACTIVITY Physical ability to investigate any area of the hospital and off site facilities. Close eye work with use of computer. OTHER PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Generally none, but may be exposed to hazard during an emergency Ability to use computer keyboard. Skill in writing reports

**About Us:**

**HealthAlliance Hospital**

role.title: Director of Continuous Improvement & Business System Development
role.description:
Skybound Service Partners is a national platform dedicated to partnering with leading commercial roofing and building services companies. We invest in exceptional teams, proven businesses, and long-term relationships to help our partner companies grow stronger and deliver greater value to their customers. At Skybound, we offer more than a job, we offer the opportunity to build a meaningful career within a network that prioritizes people, performance, and sustainable success.

Skybound Service Partners is a private equity-backed commercial roofing platform of five regional brands, and we're continuing to grow through acquisition. Each brand keeps its own name, leadership, and P&L. Skybound provides the shared support and systems that help them grow faster together. Our work happens on rooftops, on jobsites, and in trucks, not on a production line.

**The Role** 
We're looking for a builder to take the Skybound Business System (SBS) from concept to a working system across every brand. You'll partner with the executive team to define the framework, build the tools, and deploy them. You'll also lead continuous improvement projects from start to finish, focused on standard work, waste reduction, and productivity. The brands own their businesses, so this role leads through influence, not mandate.

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with the executive team to define SBS principles, tools, and operating cadence, starting from what already works inside the brands.
* Own multi-site CI roadmaps tied to business priorities, with the governance and KPIs to track adoption and results.
* Drive CI projects from start to implementation, including standard work for our core processes across all brands.
* Embed daily management, visual metrics, and structured problem solving at every site, adapted for field crews and project-based work.
* Lead kaizen events and training, and build a certification path so internal practitioners can run improvement work on their own.
* Bring SBS fundamentals into newly acquired brands as part of each integration, while respecting what those businesses already do well.
* Partner with IT on technology, including AI and automation, to reduce manual work and improve consistency.

**What It Takes**

* **Builder, not just an operator.** There's no playbook waiting for you. You've built a system where none existed, and a blank page energizes you.
* **Influences without authority.** You earn adoption by making leaders more successful, and you know what needs a common standard and what should stay local.
* **Credible with leadership and on the roof.** You're as effective with the executive team as you are with superintendents, foremen, and estimators.
* **Teacher first.** You measure success by how many leaders can run a kaizen without you.
* **Results over ceremony.** Every improvement ties to cycle time, quality, cash, or margin.
* **Owns outcomes.** When something stalls, you say so, find out why, and fix it or stop it.
* **Hands-on with technology.** You're comfortable building an AI or automation prototype yourself before handing it to IT.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 10–20 years of experience in operations and continuous improvement, including roles with direct responsibility for results
* A proven track record of leading large-scale process mapping and standard work rollouts
* Experience building a CI function or business system where none existed
* Bachelor's degree
* Must live near a major airport (Eastern or Central time zone preferred) and be willing to travel heavily during initial rollouts, settling to under 50%

*Preferred*

* CI leadership in field service, service operations, construction, or another service or project-based business
* Hands-on experience leading (not just participating in) a lean business system rollout, such as the Danaher Business System, Fortive Business System, or similar
* Experience rolling out a business system in newly acquired businesses
* Lean or Six Sigma certification; equivalent hands-on rollout experience is valued equally
* Advanced degree

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

* SBS principles, operating cadence, and core tools agreed with leadership and launched at pilot sites
* Standard work established for our core processes across all five brands
* Measurable gains in cycle time, quality, and margin, validated by finance
* AI and automation tools piloted to reduce manual work
* A first group of internal practitioners trained and running improvement work on their own
* A repeatable process for bringing newly acquired brands onto the system

*Thank you for considering a career with Skybound Service Partners.**We believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We invest in our people and provide competitive pay, benefits, and a supportive work environment where your skills and contributions matter.*

role.title: Operations Director
role.description:
**Description**

 

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work-guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity-are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

At A&M, the North American Data and AI team, IQx (Official name to be announced) SBU is combining A&M's market-leading execution with AI and digital expertise to help clients redesign processes, improve performance and achieve better outcomes. Come be part of the launch of this cutting-edge team that is making an impact on A&M's future. Join us in making a difference.

We are seeking a Operations Director to join our team. This position is an internal role within A&M's IQx operations team, reporting directly to the COO and Finance lead for IQx.

We value a healthy work-life balance and promote in-person collaboration by providing a flexible remote work arrangement with select days in the office, as needed. Ideal office locations are New York City or Philadelphia, but this is flexible.

We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and building leadership skills. Our business is committed to each team member's development, training, and exposure to business leaders.

**How you will contribute**

As an Operationsirector, your primary responsibility will be for program management, resource management, onboarding activities, supporting the growth for our business, and helping us thrive to achieve our goals. The Operations Director is expected to grow to support the operations functions of the IQx business more broadly. Your primary responsibilities as we launch will include:

* Lead program management for IQx, including planning, tracking, and driving to completion the initiatives that support the launch and growth of the business
* Support and drive internal initiatives, coordinating across stakeholders, managing timelines and deliverables, and reporting progress to leadership
* Establish and run IQx meeting cadences (e.g., leadership, staffing, and pipeline reviews), including agendas, materials, action tracking, and follow-up
* Help set up and scale the IQx practice, building the operating processes, tools, and governance that will support the team as it grows
* Go-to person for all staffing matters for our business unit
* Assess and plan future resource requirements, driving utilization based on a thorough understanding of current and future project pipeline.
* Build relationships across the business with internal stakeholders including Senior Management, Talent Acquisition, HR, Finance and Operations teams
* Effectively plan for, and advise on conflicts and issues, on a regular basis, prioritizing based on commercial needs and key skills available
* Build awareness of individuals' performance goals and development needs, influencing resourcing decisions that further the continuation of business and individuals' skill-set development
* Advanced use of staffing/ workforce planning tools, AI and reporting (for example Profinda, Claude, PowerBI) in measuring utilization and influencing staffing decisions
* Collaborate extensively with the wider Resource Management teams across North America and globally, as required by project needs

**Qualifications**

The ideal candidate will be excited about becoming a true strategic partner for our business. We are looking for people who are personable, knowledgeable, entrepreneurial, and fun. A unique blend of qualities that cannot be fast-tracked into existence. You possess desirable qualities such as being anticipatory, engaged, and respectful, which earns the respect of others. Other preferred experience includes:

* Program management experience, with a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, managing multiple workstreams, and setting up operating rhythms and meeting cadences
* Resource Manager with several years of experience in a consulting firm or matrix organization; experience in Ops, HR or Recruitment role also beneficial for the role
* Able to effectively partner with Business Leaders and other Resource Managers in the firm, working closely with the wider North America Resource Management leads
* Excellent relationship building skills, communicating with Business Leaders and staff
* Able to manage staffing by efficiently prioritizing multiple competing demands and dealing with tight deadlines
* Able to present meaningful reporting insights to senior leadership, delivering key resourcing messages and driving agreed-upon actions
* Degree educated with several years of work experience in a professional services or corporate environment
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, and knowledgeable in AI as well as resource planning tools
* Previous experience using a Resource Management/ Planning tool would be advantageous but not essential
* Keen to take on responsibility and grow the role
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, and drive positive change
* Strong time management skills with the ability to plan and priorities workload
* High degree of accuracy and attention to detail
* Use initiative to solve problems and make appropriate recommendations for resourcing decisions
* Works well under pressure and with challenging individuals
* Keen to take ownership of resourcing problems and motivated to deliver value

If you see yourself in this description, we want to hear from you!

*How will you grow and be supported?*

Our team prides itself on sustaining a culture that reflects our core values. We value integrity, quality, and objectivity in our work. We believe every day is a choice, and so we like what we do and with whom we do it. We embrace diversity, foster inclusiveness, and reward merit. We encourage and support our employees and communities through ongoing investments from leadership, social and networking events, peer-to-peer networks, Employee Resource Groups, volunteer opportunities, and pro-bono work. We are committed to promoting an inclusive environment in which all can develop, grow, and be supported.

**Your journey at A&M**

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person's unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.

We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings' fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M's benefits programs.

The salary range is $150,000 - $170,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

role.title: Plant Manager - Ready Mix Concrete - Jackson MI
role.description:
About the Opportunity:

Are you a proven leader who thrives on building strong teams and delivering exceptional service? At SRM Concrete, our Plant Managers are the driving force behind our commitment to operational excellence and customer satisfaction. As a Plant Manager, you’ll lead by example—empowering your team, optimizing daily operations, and ensuring every load meets the highest standards of safety, quality, and service.

If you’re passionate about leadership, logistics, and making a positive impact in your community, this is your opportunity to join a company that values integrity, teamwork, and growth.

Your Mission & Key Responsibilities:

* Lead with purpose: Inspire, coach, and develop your plant team to achieve operational excellence and deliver outstanding service to every customer.
* Oversee daily plant operations: Manage staff scheduling, load planning, and route optimization to ensure efficient and timely concrete deliveries.
* Champion customer service: Collaborate with drivers, dispatch, and sales teams to exceed customer expectations and resolve any issues with urgency and care.
* Drive performance: Implement and monitor key metrics to assess plant efficiency, productivity, and service quality.
* Foster a culture of safety: Ensure full compliance with safety regulations and company policies, creating a safe and positive work environment for all.
* Promote teamwork: Conduct regular meetings to review performance, address challenges, and celebrate successes.
* Build relationships: Develop strong connections with customers, suppliers, and SRM team members to support seamless operations.
* Contribute to growth: Participate in strategic planning and budgeting, sharing insights to enhance plant efficiency and profitability.

What Sets You Apart:

* Inspirational leadership style with a passion for developing high-performing teams.
* Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and building lasting relationships.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills; able to prioritize and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep understanding of logistics, supply chain management, or plant operations—experience in the concrete or construction industry is highly valued.
* Proficiency with dispatch software, Microsoft Office Suite, and a willingness to learn new systems.
* Knowledge of DOT regulations and safety standards for transportation and delivery.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; you build trust with team members, customers, and partners.
* Dedication to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Willingness to undergo SRM’s pre-employment screenings.

About SRM:

SRM Concrete (Smyrna Ready Mix) is a family-owned, values-driven leader in the ready mix concrete industry. Founded in 1999 with a single plant in Smyrna, Tennessee, we’ve grown to over 600 locations nationwide by focusing on quality, integrity, and service. Our mission is to serve our customers, our communities, and our team members with excellence—every load, every day.Why Join SRM Concrete?

**Why Join SRM Concrete?**

* **Growth & Advancement:** Be part of a rapidly expanding company with real opportunities to grow your career.
* **Impact:** Lead a team that plays a pivotal role in building America’s future.
* **Competitive Pay & Exceptional Benefits:** Low-cost medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance; paid holidays; PTO/vacation; 401k with $100 weekly match; family days; and more!
