role.description:
Job Description 
 General Summary: 

 Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation to create transformative medicines for people with serious diseases. As Vertex continues to grow, we are accelerating capabilities in technology and data to remain at the forefront of science, medicine, and technology.

 The Data & Technology Engineering, Biopharmaceutical Science, Manufacturing, Supply & Quality organization is focused on improving patients’ lives through AI, data, and technology innovation.

 The Senior Director, Quality AI, Data & Technology Engineering will define and execute the strategic vision for transforming Vertex’s global Quality operations through AI, data, and technology. This leader will champion AI-driven approaches that enhance the complete suite of quality activities including batch release, assurance, oversight, compliance, inspection readiness, deviation management, corrective and preventive actions.

 Working across multiple Vertex business units, internal teams, external partners, and operating models, this role is accountable for advancing the end-to-end global Quality experience. The Senior Director will serve as a key member of the Data & Technology Engineering leadership community and the Data & Technology Engineering, Biopharmaceutical Science, Manufacturing, Supply & Quality Leadership Team, partnering with leaders in Quality, Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, data science, infrastructure, data platforms, and security to deliver smart, scalable, and compliant solutions.

 Key Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Vision and Strategy Develop, communicate, and execute a clear vision for AI-powered Quality technology solutions across Vertex’s global internal and external operations.
 Shape a strategic roadmap that applies generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, data products, and data-driven automation to transform Quality processes.
 Partner closely with Quality leadership to ensure technology strategies accelerate portfolio and commercial priorities while enabling operational excellence.
 Lead strategic thinking across Quality oversight, inspection readiness, batch release, compliance, and related global Quality activities.
 Influence stakeholders across a broad internal and external ecosystem to identify and prioritize opportunities for innovation.
 
 Operational Execution
 Identify, evaluate, and advance opportunities involving AI, data science, data products, internal and external integrations, software, protocols, and technology platforms.
 Assess the applicability, value, risks, and compliance considerations of AI-enabled solutions within regulated Quality environments.
 Deliver strategic, flexible, scalable, and reusable technology solutions aligned with Vertex architectural principles, standards, and governance.
 Establish disciplined operating practices that maximize financial, resource, and operational effectiveness.
 Lead a robust Quality technology operation that enables dependable support for drug research, manufacturing, and product supply while maximizing return on investment.
 Partner with external suppliers to ensure high-quality delivery that meets Vertex expectations for compliance, security, and performance.
 Drive coordinated digital transformation initiatives across CMC, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality.
 
 Leadership and Collaboration
 Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing and diverse team of technology professionals.
 Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, inclusion, diversity, and equity.
 Align the Quality technology organization and data strategy with enterprise priorities, business outcomes, and regulatory requirements.
 Represent the Quality technology organization in internal and external forums, advocating for innovation and the organization’s ability to achieve strategic objectives.
 Build trusted partnerships with leaders and teams across Quality, Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, data science, technology, infrastructure, data platforms, and security.
 
 
 Knowledge and Skills: 
 Experience creating and applying technologies to solve computationally intensive and data-intensive challenges within Quality or similarly regulated life sciences environments.
 Demonstrated success developing and implementing technology strategies within complex organizations, preferably pharmaceutical Quality organizations.
 Proven experience delivering multiple complex technology development or transformation initiatives.
 Extensive knowledge of global Quality environments and the ability to translate user needs into effective technology solutions.
 Strong understanding of biotech regulatory requirements, compliance, and integrity in systems, processes, and actions.
 Demonstrated ability to communicate strategic ideas, technology solutions, and complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences at all organizational levels.
 Exceptional strategic thinking, problem-solving, organizational leadership, and team-building capabilities.
 
 Technical Skills Required
 Artificial intelligence and machine learning
 Generative AI and agentic AI
 Data-driven automation
 Data products and data science
 Quality technology platforms and transactional systems
 Quality assurance and Quality oversight technology
 Inspection readiness and inspection management
 Deviation management
 Corrective and preventive action processes
 Product batch release processes
 Internal and external technology integrations
 Software and technology solution evaluation
 Data platforms and infrastructure
 Cybersecurity and technology security considerations
 Distributed computing environments
 Cloud computing environments
 High-performance computing
 Technology architecture, standards, governance, and risk management
 
 Preferred Skills
 Experience leading AI, data, or technology transformation in a global pharmaceutical Quality organization.
 Experience supporting clinical and commercial supply operations.
 Experience working across CMC, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and R&D functions.
 Experience partnering with external technology suppliers and service providers in highly regulated environments.
 Advanced certification in product management, Agile, software engineering, leadership, or a related discipline.
 Experience developing scalable solutions that balance innovation, operational needs, regulatory compliance, and security.
 
 Education and Experience: 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Computer Science, Engineering)
 12+ years’ experience and 5+ years of management experience
 2+ year’s experience setting agentic AI vision and governance framework development

Job Description 
 General/Position Summary 
 The Senior Director, CGT Quality Systems, Personalized Medicine provides strategic Quality leadership for personalized medicine and advanced cell therapies across the patient journey. The role is accountable for advancing Quality oversight, governance, compliance, and continuous improvement while ensuring efficient, patient-centric process across the end to end patient journey.
 This highly cross-functional position requires strong matrix leadership and partnership with Global Quality and Manufacturing, MS&T, Regulatory, Commercial, and Supply Chain stakeholders.  Success requires the ability to influence enterprise decisions, build strong partnerships, and drive alignment through executive presence and effective communication.   The  ability to balance long-term vision with flawless execution of complex business and quality priorities is key for the position.
 
 Key Duties & Responsibilities 
 Leadership, Strategy & Organizational Capabilities 
 Provide strategic Quality Systems leadership in support of personalized medicine /advanced CGT programs, ensuring alignment with CGT Business Objectives, Vertex Global Quality Strategy, commercial priorities, regulatory expectations, and patient-centered outcomes.
 Define, prioritize, and execute the CGT Quality Systems across clinical, launch, and commercial lifecycle stages.
 Partner with stakeholders to ensure effective risk management, resolution and mitigation plans are identified, established, and executed.
 Lead, mentor, and develop team members; build organizational capability and foster accountability, collaboration, innovation, and operational excellence.
 Leverage technical and Quality expertise across CGT QA to resolve critical challenges, drive timely decision-making, and ensure effective communication and escalation of risks, constraints, and commitments.
 Create and foster a culture of collaboration, quality excellence, continuous improvement, transparency, and accountability across Quality and partner functions.
 Responsible for leading and participating in key CMC Quality initiatives to advance and mature Vertex’s  Global Quality Systems.
 
 Quality Systems & Compliance Oversight for Advanced CGT Personalized Medicine
 Provide End to End compliance oversight for personalized medicine/advanced CGT internal and external quality operations, ensuring quality remains compliant with applicable enterprise Vertex Global Quality procedural requirements and global regulations.
 Establish compliance governance routines to proactively monitor compliance trends, operational performance, and emerging risks that may impact product quality, patient safety, supply continuity, or program execution; lead or support risk-based mitigation plans, continuous improvement actions, and sustainable process enhancements.
 Partner with digital stakeholders to ensure CGT user requirements are embedded in lifecycle management projects from design through implementation including sustainment.
 Support inspection readiness and audit-related activities in relation to Quality CGT oversight.
 
 Patient Treatment Journey Quality Oversight
 Lead and provide Quality oversight across the end to end patient CGT treatment journey assuring GMP requests are assessed, governed, documented, escalated, and resolved in a timely, compliant, risk-based, and patient-centric manner.
 Chair or support cross-functional review of GMP related patient treatment journey requests including requests involving patient-specific constraints.
 Ensure Quality Management Review Boards are executed in line with Global Quality System requirements when quality or compliance impact is identified across the patient treatment journey.
 Analytics, Data Integrity & Continuous Improvement
 Partner with Global Quality and cross-functional stakeholders to support development and deployment of advanced digital reporting solutions and use of artificial intelligence in CGT to enable transparent governance, decision-making, and escalation of quality and operational risks.
 Improve compliance and strengthen proactive quality management, efficiency, data integrity, and processes maturity  and scalability across CGT investigations, change controls, risk assessments, CAPA, and management review.
 
 Required Education Level 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, or related technical discipline required.
 
 Required Experience 
 15+ years of experience and 7+ years in a management/supervisory role, or the equivalent combination of education and experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment
 
 Required Knowledge/Skills 
 Broad experience in quality and compliance oversight for allogeneic/autologous cell manufacturing processes, or other personalized medicine modalities from development through commercial lifecycle.
 In-depth knowledge of global health authority expectations and GxP requirements across the lifecycle for cell and gene therapy, biologics, and advanced therapy products.
 Enterprise Impact & Influence with the ability to shape decisions across the organization through strong partnerships, communication, and executive presence.
 Balance long-term vision with operational excellence, driving quality transformation while ensuring compliance and patient-focused outcomes.
 Ability to apply risk management principles, critical Thinking and Problem Solving skills
 Other Requirements 
 15% travel

role.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Operations (3rd Shift)
role.description:
Job Description 
 General Summary: 
 The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Operations manages a supervisory team and provides oversight to the day-to-day operations.
 This position provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure safe, compliant, and efficient execution of cGMP manufacturing operations in alignment with production schedules, site objectives, and business priorities. The Senior Manager is accountable for maintaining an audit-ready facility, driving continuous improvement, building organizational capability, and supporting the successful production of pharmaceutical drug products.

 Key Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Manage and develop a supervisory team, ensuring strong execution, accountability, and team effectiveness.
 Direct the activities of the group through management of staff, prioritization, and assignment of tasks.
 Responsible for aligning with site leadership to provide departmental and technical leadership.
 Assume a project leader role for departmental and interdisciplinary projects.
 Ensure work is prioritized, staffed, and executed in alignment with detailed production schedules and business needs.
 Oversee cGMP manufacturing activities, including equipment setup, assembly, operation, disassembly, cleaning, and associated support activities.
 Ensure compliant execution, review, and approval of batch documentation and other GMP records.
 Provide oversight for real-time on-the-floor batch record review and escalation of operational or compliance issues as needed.
 Participate in event investigations, CAPAs, and change controls in support of production and departmental objectives.
 Identify and continuously improve practices, procedures, and activities related to the department and site.
 Partner cross-functionally to support validation activities, facility readiness, investigations, and manufacturing objectives.
 Ensure the facility remains in an audit-ready state through adherence to procedures, documentation standards, and inspection readiness practices.
 Monitor and enforce GMP compliance for personnel, processes, and activities.
 Drive operational performance through tiered management systems, including leadership of Tier 1 and/or Tier 2 meetings and follow-up on escalated issues.
 Monitor manufacturing performance metrics and trends; identify risks and drive actions to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
 Enable the timely achievement of departmental, site, and corporate goals.
 Mentor, motivate, coach, and evaluate the performance of group members.
 Foster interdisciplinary communication, collaboration, and shared understanding within the group and across departments.
 Ensure personal and team compliance with all training requirements.
 Demonstrate the Vertex Phenotype behaviors: Lead by Example; Learn, Teach & Develop; Foster Exceptional Collaboration; Drive Breakthrough Results; and Promote Enterprise Thinking.
 Perform other duties and projects as assigned to meet departmental and business requirements.
 
 Knowledge and Skills: 
 Advanced interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
 Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to lead through others and build high-performing teams.
 Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop supervisors and emerging leaders.
 Strong organizational, planning, and operational management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple activities.
 Deep knowledge of cGMP principles and associated regulatory expectations in a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.
 Strong understanding of cell therapy manufacturing operations, including process execution, equipment operation, and facility support requirements.
 Demonstrated competency in process, equipment, and facility validation experience.
 Experience with event investigations, deviation management, CAPA, change control, and inspection readiness.
 Proficiency with Quality by Design (QbD) concepts, Design of Experiments (DoE), statistical process control (SPC), and complex data analysis.
 Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to assess operational risk, escalate appropriately, and drive resolution.
 Ability to improve systems, processes, and team performance through continuous improvement principles.
 Ability to clearly communicate technical and operational rationale for procedures, practices, and manufacturing approaches.
 Proficiency with manufacturing systems and documentation platforms, including QDoCCS and other GMP systems.
 
 Education and Experience: 
 Bachelor’s degree required in a scientific, technical, or engineering discipline.
 Typically requires 10+ years of experience or the equivalent combination of education and experience.
 Strong experience in direct people supervision in a cGMP manufacturing environment required.
 Significant leadership experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing operations within a cGMP-regulated environment required.
 Prior experience managing supervisors and/or manufacturing teams.
 Prior cell therapy and aseptic manufacturing experience.
 Prior POMS MES experience preferred.
 Experience supporting commercial and/or late-stage development manufacturing preferred.
 

 Work Schedule 
 This position supports our overnight operations. Availability to work other shifts may be necessary to support onboarding, training, and critical manufacturing activities.
 


 3rd Shift Training Period: 
 New hires will complete an approximately 90-day training program on either first shift or second shift before transitioning to the assigned overnight schedule. Training will take place between our Cambridge Facility: 100 Tech Drive, and Leiden Center 1 (LC1) in Seaport.

 The training period will run through January / February 2027, with 5x8hr shifts: Sun - Thurs OR Tues- Saturday 7am - 3:30pm. OR Tuesday - Saturday 2:30pm -11pm
 
 The ongoing work shift thereafter will be 4x10hr shifts: Sunday - Wed 9pm -7:30am OR Wed - Saturday 9pm - 7:30am 
 

 3rd shift employees are entitled to 20% pay differential 

 Please note that work schedules are based on business needs and may be adjusted or modified as operational requirements evolve. Candidates must be flexible and able to accommodate schedule changes, including shifts, assigned days or hours, as determined by Vertex.

role.title: Director, Quality
role.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

1. Documents and maintains the company's Quality Management System and verifies its compliance to ISO/TL standards.

2. Documents and maintains the company’s Environmental Management System and verifies its compliance to ISO 14001 standards.

3. Updates documentation as changes are made (procedures, quality and environmental manuals, work instructions, and forms).

4. Maintains quality and environmental records (including, but not limited to Corrective Actions, Audit Results, Employee Training Records, and Document Control Logs).

5. Plans and conducts Management Review Meetings.

6. Performs annual internal audits to determine continuing compliance to ISO standards, as necessary.

7. Works with outside parties (suppliers, customers, and ISO Registrar) on all Quality and Environmental System-related issues.

8. Manage, train, and develop the Quality Department team

9. Responsible for providing employees with ISO training.

**Skills Needed**

* + Strong Reasoning and Critical Thinking Skills (Sound Judgement)
* + High Impact Decision Making (Face Paced Environment)
* + Diplomacy in Difficult Situations
* + Attentive to Detail
* + Strong Presentation Skills & Communication (verbal and non-verbal)
* + Customer/Employee Relations Skills
* + Strong Data Analysis Skills
* + Team Management Skills (Ability to drive staff to action and get results through others)
* + Flexible to Change
* + Strong Organization Skills

 

**Minimum Educational Requirements**

Minimum High School Diploma or GED Required.

A college degree in Business Management or related field is preferred, but not required.

**Experience Required**

The successful candidate will have one to two years experience in Quality Management, ISO 9000 implementation, or a related field.

**NOTE:**

The purpose of this outline job description is to focus attention on the most important aspects of the job. It is not intended to be a complete list of every duty and it is therefore to be expected that the day-to-day performance of the job will frequently include tasks not listed above.

The list of duties for which the job holder is responsible may be varied or added to at the discretion of your manager. Any such alterations intended to be permanent will be added to this job description.

#### **Experience**

Required

* TL 9000
* ISO 9001

role.title: Director of Quality & Compliance
role.description:
Exciting leadership opportunity with a growing skin care manufacturing company. At Episciences, the Director of Quality and Compliance is responsible for ensuring the marketing compliance of topical skin care products domestically and internationally and has oversight of manufacturing quality assurance and control processes in-house and at third party testing facilities. The ideal candidate will have working knowledge/experience of FDA cosmetic and OTC drug regulations; EU, UK, and Canada cosmetic regulations; and cGMP. The Director of Quality and Compliance routinely monitors current and new regulations to ensure products are compliant within all intended markets.

As the head of the Quality Control and Assurance team, the Director of Quality and Compliance is responsible for the review/approval and maintenance of master product formulae, master labeling copies and maintenance of standard operating procedures. The Director of Quality and Compliance also reviews and trends: customer complaints, raw materials, quality processes and finished product testing for release to Manufacturing,

Ideal Qualifications for this Position:

* Bachelor’s degree in chemistry is preferred

* 5+ years of management experience is preferred

* 5+ years of experience in food, drug and/or cosmetic manufacturing GMPs and Regulatory

* Ability to read and comprehend FDA CFRs as well as other domestic and international Regulatory documentation

* Excellent communication and presentation skills

* Excellent organization, filing and document writing skills

* FDA audit experience is a plus

What to expect as the Director of Quality and Compliance at Episciences Inc.:

* Discounted award-winning Episciences Inc. products

* A Business Casual Company and Culture

* Company paid medical, dental, vision and life insurance coverages

* Company matching retirement plan

* Paid holidays (11 per calendar year)

* Vacation and PTO accrual

role.title: Director of Quality Assurance
role.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Quality, Defense is responsible for overseeing all quality activities, personnel, systems, and performance associated with Defense programs across multiple Karman Space & Defense operating sites. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure all Defense hardware, assemblies, and services meet or exceed contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements. 
 
This position will manage the Defense Quality Engineering organization, supports execution of Defense programs, and ensures consistent application of quality standards and tools across the sector. This leader works in close partnership with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align each site's AS9100 compliant QMS with the emerging enterprise quality architecture and to transition multiple Defense sites toward a unified enterprise certification. 
 
This role is critical in driving disciplined execution, continuous improvement, product integrity, and customer satisfaction within the Defense market segment.

Reports to Vice President, Defense. Functional Partnership with Enterprise Director of Quality (Karman Space & Defense). 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Engineering team supporting all Defense programs and projects.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement across Defense Quality functions.
* Serve as the primary Defense quality leader to the VP of Defense and the Defense leadership team.
* Ensure the quality of all Defense hardware, assemblies, engineered systems, and services produced across multiple sites.
* Oversee program quality planning, including inspection strategies, qualification/verification plans, critical characteristics control, product safety considerations, and risk mitigation.
* Review and approve quality requirements for Defense proposals, contracts, and manufacturing plans.
* Drive effective root cause analysis, corrective action, and failure review processes for Defense programs.
* Ensure each Defense site maintains compliance to AS9100, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide direct guidance to site Quality Managers/Quality Engineers on QMS implementation, audit readiness, and procedural improvement.
* Support site internal audits, customer audits, DCMA oversight, and third‑party certification audits.
* Partner with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align Defense site QMS structures, documentation, and practices with the enterprise quality framework.
* Support the long-term strategy to transition multiple Defense AS9100 certificates into a unified enterprise certificate.
* Collaborate closely on enterprise initiatives such as configuration management improvements, risk management systems, document control harmonization, supplier quality strategies, and enterprise metrics.

 
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical field preferred
* 10 years of experience in aerospace/defense quality roles preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, and Defense customer quality standards.
* Quality Engineering experience with complex programs including design.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS**

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, certain positions may require applicants to be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel 0-10% of the time.

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

role.title: Group Quality Director - Lab Service Line
role.description:
This position is incentive eligible. 
 
 

Do you have the career opportunities as a Group Quality Director you want with your current employer? We have an exciting opportunity for you to join HCA Laboratory Services which is part of the nation's leading provider of healthcare services, HCA Healthcare.

Travel is Required. You will Support 5- Divisions. Must Reside in Utah, Idaho, Nevada, North Carolina, Virginia, Alaska or in the Nashville, TN area.

Job Summary and Qualifications

The Group Quality Director is responsible for implementation of the Laboratory Service Line quality and performance improvement programs for our National Group. This position applies quality and performance improvement approaches to identify and quantify improvement opportunities, facilitate and organization process improvement efforts, drive improvement, and measure outcomes. This role supervises Quality Coordinators in assigned divisions. You will be responsible for laboratory regulatory agency accreditation preparedness, tracking and reporting of specific information; auditing and analysis of processes and systems; statistical analysis of data; formulation of recommendations; and creation of written and verbal reports. The position also requires skills for developing and presenting related training programs for laboratory colleagues and for preparing presentations to and for management.

In This Role You Will:

* Deploy the laboratory clinical quality infrastructure across the National Group divisions.
* Partner with leaders to identify and coordinate implementation of continual improvement projects to improve quality performance.
* Facilitate the growth of vision of laboratory quality and performance, including the dissemination of "best practices" across the country.
* Lead regional process improvement initiatives, provide feedback on standardization opportunities and evaluate success through pre-established criteria.
* Assist with appropriate and timely response to Serious Patient Adverse Events (SPAE)s that involve laboratory operations.
* Lead proactive laboratory quality and safety activities to create hospital laboratories that are highly reliable as reflected in reduced errors, elimination of unsafe processes and increase involvement of staff and pathology medical directors toward a culture of safety.
* Contribute to the achievement of laboratory business and financial goals through optimal division and group performance in quality and patient safety.
* Interface with appropriate personnel at HCA to leverage corporate resources, programs, tools and methodologies for benefit of hospital laboratories.
* Collaborate with and support hospital quality, risk, safety and infection prevention leaders to achieve top ranking in national and state publicly reported data initiatives.
* Participate in regular analysis of laboratory quality and risk performance data, and plan steps for ongoing improvement.
* Work with Corporate and Division medical leaders to support data analysis, reporting, process and outcomes improvement.
* Contribute to ongoing enhancement of enterprise quality reporting methods and dashboards.
* Continuously monitor and evaluate quality outcomes across the group and division, while noting trends and identifying and prioritizing opportunities to improve.
* Assist divisions in building a proactive quality department by implementing processes to support accreditation and regulatory inspections.
* Facilitate and/or lead process improvement teams as needed to achieve quality improvement goals.
* Serve as a regulatory resource regarding state and federal regulations and standards, including but not limited to CMS, CLIA, CAP, and TJC.
* Demonstrate personal responsibility for professional development, and promoting and supporting laboratory quality leaders and division data analysts.
* Promote a culture that is positive, values individual strengths, takes risks and is committed to optimal patient care and compliance with standards.
* Attend HCA-mandated training and meeting all ethics and compliance standards and requirements.
* Develop and implement projects as directed by AVP, Quality and CLO.

What Qualifications You Will Need:

* Bachelor's degree in a clinical laboratory, chemical, biological science or related field is required.
* Master's degree in a related field is preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in quality improvement is required.
* 1+ years of experience in clinical laboratory is preferred.
* Management experience is preferred.
* Previous experience within a multi-facility environment is preferred.
* Clinical licensure, Laboratory Medical Technology or RN is preferred.
* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) is preferred.

##### **Benefits**

Work from Home, offers a total rewards package that supports the health, life, career and retirement of our colleagues. The available plans and programs include:

* **Comprehensive benefits** for medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, behavioral health and telemedicine services
* **Wellbeing support,** including free counseling and referral services
* **Time away from work** programs for paid time off, paid family leave, long- and short-term disability coverage and leaves of absence
* **Savings and retirement resources**, including a 401(k) Plan with a 100% match on 3% to 9% of pay (based on years of service), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, flexible spending accounts, preferred banking partnerships, retirement readiness tools, rollover support and financial wellbeing counseling
* **Education support** through tuition assistance, student loan assistance, certification support, dependent scholarships and a partnership with Galen College of Nursing
* **Additional benefits** for fertility and family building, adoption assistance, life insurance, supplemental health protection plans, auto and home insurance, legal counseling, identity theft protection and consumer discounts

Learn more about Employee Benefits

***Note: Eligibility for benefits may vary by location.***

**Integrated Regional Labs** is a full service providerfor clinical laboratory and anatomic pathology services, providing hospitals, physicians, and clients with**timely diagnostic information** for patient care. Our infrastructure includes a fullyautomated esoteric core laboratory in Fort Lauderdale, a histology and microbiology operation in Largo,Florida, and a network of hospital based **rapid-response** laboratories present in fourHCA Healthcare divisions within the state of Florida. Our core laboratories support **more than250** acute and rehab hospitals, physician practices, surgery centers and commercialaccounts.

HCA Healthcare has been recognized as one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies® by the Ethisphere Institute more than ten times. In recent years, HCA Healthcare spent an estimated $3.7 billion in cost for thedelivery of charitable care, uninsured discounts, and other uncompensated expenses.

HCA Healthcare Co-Founder

role.title: Director of Quality and Risk
role.description:
About Us:

### ***Specialized Care for the Patients Who Need It Most.***

NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals (NPH) is dedicated to providing unparalleled service to our patients, team members, physicians, and families. We dare to do things differently, bringing together compassionate care, specialized expertise, and an interdisciplinary approach to meet the unique needs of those we serve. It is this commitment that distinguishes NPH as the healthcare provider of choice.

As a national leader in behavioral healthcare, NPH specializes in caring for patients with acute psychiatric and complex medical needs. Our hospitals provide patient-centered care through an interdisciplinary, multi-specialty approach, ensuring our patients receive the specialized support they need when they need it most.

With locations in Indiana, Michigan, Texas, Ohio, and Arizona, we are expanding access to our unique model of care across the United States. Join NPH and become part of a team that is daring to do things differently and making a lasting difference in the lives of our patients, families, and communities every day.

Overview:

NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals is looking for a Director of Quality and Risk at our **Huber Heights, OH** location. NPH is the national leader in providing medical and neurobehavioral care to patients in acute psychiatric distress. You will be joining a team of rock star staff who provide exceptional, patient-centered care and understand our patients are always our number one priority! The Director of Quality supports the implementation and monitoring of the quality assurance measurements and audits, and assists in improving patient safety processes throughout the hospital through coordinating and engaging in activities to proactively promote implementation of evidence based best practices and resolve deficiencies; plans, develops, and directs system activities and protocols across NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals; helps to prepare NPH facilities for surveys by accrediting and licensing agencies; serves as a resource to all departments and personnel.

**Benefits of joining NPH as a Director of Quality and Risk**

* Competitive pay rates
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* NPH 401(k) plan with up to 4% Company match
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Programs
* Generous PTO and Time Off Policy
* Special tuition offers through Capella University
* Work/life balance with great professional growth opportunities
* Employee Discounts through LifeMart

Responsibilities:

* Implements and monitors quality goals and objectives to measure the organization’s processes and outcomes while administering programs that focus on improved outcomes of patient care or patient safety.
* Interacts with physicians, nurses, department managers, supervisors, and any/all other staff members to provide resource information and identify new opportunities to improve service and reduce costs.
* Generates effectual quality related policies and procedures for the department and hospital that ensures compliance with JC, OSHA, CDC, CMS and other county, state, and federal regulatory agencies.
* Prepares reports, presentations and statistical data that go to the Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement Committee Meetings, facility's administration and other committees as needed. Analyzes data to identify trends and resource utilization for use in optimizing compliance.
* Assists with the annual assessment of the quality control programs from the prior year activities.
* Investigates incidents within the facility and coordinates with the Corporate Quality team to complete the root cause analysis and develop action plans to prevent incidents in the future.
* Establish a structure to ensure that patient care activities are addressed in a coordinated manner involving quality improvement.
* Prepares the agenda for the Quality Council Committee meetings and holds regularly scheduled meetings.
* Provides educational offerings for orientation and on-going in-services.
* Performs mortality reviews in conjunction with the mortality committee and holds regularly scheduled mortality committee meetings.
* Ensures all staff receive proper education on new or revised state and/ or federal regulations or Joint Commission standards.
* Participates in Multi-disciplinary patient centered case conferences, as appropriate.
* Assess and evaluate patients with infections and monitor patient outcomes on an ongoing basis.
* Initiates follow-up on employee/patient exposures to communicable diseases.
* Participates in root-cause analysis, sentinel events, adverse events and identifies trends as directed by regulation. Recommends ways to redesign systems for improvements if needed.
* Oversee Patient Advocacy program.
* Establishes/maintains good relationships with COO, CEO and DON’s and department leaders to promote a cooperative and constructive environment for improvement.
* Promote “Quality is everyone’s business” to gain support, understanding and ownership among staff.
* Other duties as may be assigned.
* Complies with hospital expectations regarding ethical behavior and standards of conduct.
* Complies with federal and hospital requirements in the areas of protected health information & patient privacy.
* Understands and adheres to NPH’s compliance standards as they appear in NPH’s Corporate Compliance Policy, Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest Policy.
* Keeps abreast of all pertinent federal, state and hospital regulations, laws and policies as they presently exist and as they change or are modified.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in healthcare field or pertinent program required. Master's Degree preferred.
* 3+ years of relevant healthcare quality and risk management experience. Prior leadership experience preferred.
* Excellent verbal communication skills necessary in order present quality reports.
* Maintain effective contacts with a variety of Hospital Personnel.
* Professional knowledge of clinical practice, leadership, performance improvement and research statistics in order to conduct surveillance and prepare related reports at a level normally acquired through the completion of a Bachelor’s degree in related field.

role.title: Director, Quality Improvement
role.description:
Shirley Ryan AbilityLab is the global leader in physical medicine and rehabilitation for adults and children with the most severe, complex conditions. By joining our team, you’ll be part of our life-changing mission and vision. You’ll contribute to an innovative, multifaceted culture that is second to none — one that embraces collaboration, excellence, discovery and compassion. You’ll play a role in something that’s never been done before as we integrate science and clinical care to help patients achieve better, faster outcomes — as we Advance Human Ability, together.

**Job Description Summary**

The Director, Quality Improvement provides strategic leadership, oversight, and operational direction for quality improvement, regulatory readiness, accreditation compliance, and performance improvement initiatives across the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab system of care, inclusive of the Alliances. This role partners closely with clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to foster a culture of continuous improvement, patient safety, accountability, and high reliability in alignment with organizational goals and Envision 2030 priorities. 
 
The Director leads enterprise quality improvement initiatives, coordinates accreditation and regulatory readiness activities, advances data-informed decision-making, and supports ongoing compliance with applicable standards and requirements, including CARF, The Joint Commission, CMS, and other regulatory bodies. The Director serves as a key advisor and partner to clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to advance quality outcomes, patient safety, operational effectiveness, and organizational excellence.

**Job Description**

**The Director, Quality Improvement will:**

 

* Provide leadership and direction for quality improvement, performance improvement, accreditation, and regulatory readiness programs across the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab system of care, with initial focus at the flagship hospital
* Develop and lead quality and performance improvement initiatives utilizing evidence-based methodologies and frameworks to advance regulatory compliance, patient outcomes, and operational excellence across the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab system of care, with initial focus at the flagship hospital.
* Partner with leaders to align quality initiatives with strategic organizational priorities and Envision 2030 goals.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, transparency, accountability, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
* Oversee the identification, development, tracking, analysis, and reporting of key quality, patient safety, operational, and regulatory performance measures. Identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with leaders and teams to identify opportunities for improvement and implement sustainable corrective action plans.
* Lead the annual development, evaluation, and update of the organization's Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) Plan and support ongoing monitoring of organizational performance against established priorities.
* Support departments in developing measurable goals, dashboards, and improvement plans to drive organizational performance.
* Direct organizational accreditation and regulatory readiness efforts, including preparation for CARF, The Joint Commission, CMS, and other applicable surveys and reviews.
* Maintain knowledge of evolving regulatory and accreditation standards and assess and communicate organizational impacts, risks, and recommended actions to leadership.
* Partner with operational and clinical leaders to ensure policies, procedures, workflows, and practices align with regulatory requirements and best practices.
* Oversee regulatory and accreditation survey response activities, corrective action plans, and ongoing monitoring to ensure timely and sustained compliance.
* Oversee the development and presentation of quality and performance reports, dashboards, and executive-level analyses to support organizational decision-making.
* Oversee the development and presentation of quality and performance reports, dashboards, and executive-level analyses that provide meaningful insights, support organizational accountability, and inform leadership decision-making.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and resource for quality improvement, accreditation, regulatory readiness, and performance improvement methodologies.
* Partner with leaders, physicians, clinicians, and operational teams to build organizational capability and accountability for quality, patient safety, and performance improvement.
* Develop and facilitate training, education, and communication strategies related to accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and quality initiatives.
* Represent Quality and Safety on organizational committees, councils, and interdisciplinary teams as assigned.
* Perform all other duties that may be assigned in the best interest of the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab.

**Reporting Relationships**

* Reports directly to the Executive Director, Quality and Safety.
* Provides leadership and oversight to assigned quality, accreditation, regulatory, and performance improvement staff.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required**

* Master's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, nursing, allied health or a related healthcare field required.
* Minimum of seven years of progressively responsible experience in healthcare quality improvement, accreditation, regulatory compliance, patient safety, or performance improvement, within a hospital, rehabilitation, or complex healthcare environment. .
* Relevant quality, patient safety, accreditation, or healthcare certification (e.g., CPHQ, CPPS) is required or obtained within two years of hire.
* Comprehensive knowledge of healthcare quality and performance improvement methodologies, accreditation standards, and regulatory requirements, with demonstrated experience leading accreditation and regulatory readiness activities. Knowledge of CARF, The Joint Commission, CMS, and other applicable healthcare regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to interpret complex quality, patient safety, operational and regulatory data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence physicians, clinical leaders, operational leaders, and other stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated project and change management capabilities, including the ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from planning thru implementation and sustained adoption.

**Working Conditions**

* Normal office environment with little or no exposure to dust or extreme temperature undefined

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

**Pay and Benefits\*:**

**Pay Range:**

$116,700.00 - $193,800.00

**Benefits:**

role.title: Director Of Quality Management
role.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

Leads and directs process and overall quality improvement activities that produce better patient care and more efficient operations. Develops programs to review and evaluate patient care and outcomes. Implements a strategy and plans for a quality improvement function within the facility in collaboration with the administrative and clinical leaders of the hospitals that Cohesive manages. Tracks and presents results of improvement efforts and ongoing measures of clinical processes to management. Provides input to strategic decisions that affect the functional area of responsibility. May give input into developing the budget. Capable of resolving escalated issues arising from operations and requiring coordination with other.

 

**POSITION QUALIFICATIONS**

Minimum Qualifications:

* Ability to project a professional Image.

* Knowledge of regulatory standards and compliance requirements.

* Knowledge of techniques and methods of patient care services and instructions for patients and their families.

* Working knowledge and ability to apply professional standards of practice in job situations.

* Strong organizational and analytical skills.

* Persons who have been found guilty by a court of law of abusing, neglecting, or mistreating individuals in a health care related setting are ineligible for employment in this position.

* Freedom from illegal use of drugs.

* Ability to perform each position responsibility satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties of the position.

* Ability to understand that safety is a condition of employment. Unsafe acts or conditions will be reported to the supervisor

* Must be computer literate with ability to enter information in the EHR system and compile reports or data as requested.

* Must be able to read, write and speak English.

**POSITION DETAILS:**

* Provide leadership in ongoing development and implementation of a data-based monitoring, tracking and process improvement system that will ensure compliance with the state of OK/TN/KS requirements for quality management.

* Ensures review of clinical records regarding diagnosis, treatment and summary of member's progress. Ensures individual and systemic quality of care. Confers with other practitioners and technical experts in own field of specialization, to broaden knowledge, acquire specific information, or obtain advice or consultation.

* Implements process improvement and integrates quality throughout the organization.

* Assures regulatory compliance within assigned areas of responsibilities and in collaboration with peers. Establishes external networks to facilitate benchmarking and practice excellence. Demonstrates leadership within and outside the facility to promote a model of excellence in practice, education, and administration.

* Ensures that review of medical records for quality of care issues, compliance with best practices, and potential litigation concerns occurs as needed.

* Performs other duties as assigned.

 

**Education and/or Experience:**

* Must possess current state RN license and BLS certification.

* Bachelor’s degree (B.A./B.S.) in related health field preferred.

* One-year process improvement experience preferred.

* Demonstrated competence in reacting to and handling emergencies.

* Able to work collaboratively with multiple health professionals in a busy and complex environment using tact, diplomacy, and discipline.

* Ability to understand and adhere to established policies, procedures, and protocols.

* Strong charting/documentation skills.

* Ability to effectively communicate with people at all levels and from various backgrounds.

* Commitment to excellence and high standards

* Excellent written and oral communication skills

* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills

* Ability to manage priorities and workflow

* Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm

* Good judgement with the ability to make timely and sound decisions

* Bilingual skills a plus.

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Required:**

* Current licensure as a RN to practice in the State of Oklahoma by the State Board

* Current BLS certification

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

English is the primary language of the facility. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and policy procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of executives, managers, clients, customers, and the public.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, percent as well as draw and interpret various graphs.

**REASONING ABILITY**

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instruction furnished in written, oral and/or diagram form. Ability to define and solve problems, interpret data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in statistical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each key function satisfactorily based on five overall skills categories; assessment, planning, intervention, evaluation and teaching/coaching. Each category will be assessed on performance measurements of appropriateness, efficiency, effectiveness and timeliness. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the key functions.

**Patient Rights** Promotes and protects patients’ rights; treats patients with dignity and respect; reports suspected abuse or neglect.

**Leadership** Demonstrates willingness to try new tasks; generates new ideas for change; evaluates and recognizes priorities; communicates and models organizational values; fosters high performance; recognizes need for and provides adequate resources.

**Process Improvement** Applies process improvement methods and techniques; assists in data collection; identifies processes for improvement in daily work; and assists in education of new employees in the team process.

**Environment of Care** Demonstrates understanding of fire and emergency procedures; participates in fire and disaster drills; demonstrates understanding of safety and security procedures; applies safety and security precautions; demonstrates understanding of hazardous materials plan; demonstrates proper use of equipment.

**Infection Control** Applies hand-washing principles during daily work; demonstrates understanding of isolation precautions; recognizes signs and symptoms of infection and complies with the employee health program; demonstrates understanding of the process for identifying and handling infectious waste; maintains personal hygiene; complies with OSHA standards in the work place; and demonstrates understanding of cross-contamination.

**Information Management** Enters or records data timely and accurately; protects confidentiality of patient information; protects data against loss or destruction; reports suspected violation of security/confidentiality issues.

**INTERPERSONAL SKILLS**

Demonstrates active listening techniques; gains support through effective relationships; treats others with dignity and respect; seeks feedback; establishes systems to measure effectiveness, efficiency, and service; creates and maintains reporting mechanisms.

**CONTINUING EDUCATION**

Attends in-service and education programs; attends continuing education required for maintenance of professional certification or licensure.

 

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to work inside a clean, well-lit, and well-ventilated laboratory. While performing the duties of this position, the incumbent is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk; sit; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. The employee may be exposed to some hazards such as radiation, bodily fluids that may contain disease, and fumes from laboratory chemicals.

role.title: Quality Director
role.description:
**Build Your Career. Lead With Precision.**

Nammo Perry is a center of excellence for the design, development and production of munitions and pyrotechnic products for the U.S. Department of Defense. Nammo employees working at the Florida site manufacture all types of 40mm low and high velocity ammunition; pyrotechnic marking; signaling and tactical illumination devices; battlefield effects training simulators; demolition charges; hand grenade fuzes; and other ammunition components. Additionally, they provide load, assemble, and pack (LAP) services for large caliber direct-fire ammunition.

The **Director of Quality** provides strategic leadership and oversight of quality assurance, quality systems, supplier quality, and configuration management across Nammo Perry supporting the Large Caliber Systems and Aerospace Propulsion business units. Reporting to the President/General Manager, this position leads a multidisciplinary quality organization through four direct-report management functions: Configuration Management, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality Systems, and Quality Assurance. These functions collectively support supplier compliance, product conformity, manufacturing qualities, inspection and testing, calibration, customer quality, and configuration controls.

The Director is accountable for establishing and maintaining a robust quality management system (QMS), ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry requirements, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization. A key strategic priority is leading the site's transformation from ISO9001 certification to AS9100 certification encompassing both business units under one unified quality management system, as well as a robust supplier quality program.

**Unique Benefits Designed with Care**

* Monday - Thursday work week working 10-hour days
* Relocation assistance provided
* 401(K) with a 6% company match
* 100% Employer-Paid Employee Only Medical Plan Option
* Employer Health Saving Account Contributions
* Two week’s vacation, one-week sick pay, and nine paid holidays

**What You’ll Do: Precision in Action**

**Strategic Quality Leadership**

* Develop and execute quality strategies aligned with organizational objectives, customer requirements, regulatory expectations, and long-term business growth.
* Provide leadership and accountability across configuration management, supplier quality systems, and quality assurance ensuring consistent quality standards across both business units.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to product conformity, supplier performance, customer satisfaction, cost of poor quality, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with site leadership to evaluate quality risks, organizational capabilities, resource allocation, and strategic improvement opportunities.

**Quality Management Systems**

* Maintain compliance with existing ISO9001 and AS9100requirements while continuing to foster an environment of continuous improvement.
* Provides strategic oversight of the Quality Systems Organization including internal audits, corrective and preventative actions, document control, calibration, and customer quality activities.
* Ensure effective management review processes, regulatory and customer audit readiness, and continuous improvement of quality systems and organizational performance.

**Supplier Quality and Configuration Management**

* Provide strategic oversight of Supplier Quality including supplier qualification, performance monitoring and auditing, incoming inspection, and supplier corrective action processes.
* Ensure supplier quality engineering and receiving inspection activities support material conformity traceability and manufacturing readiness
* Lead Configuration Management functions to ensure appropriate control of product configuration, engineering changes, technical documentation, and applicable customer requirements through the established configuration management and business systems.
* Partner with supply chain engineering and operations to manage supplier risk, resolve quality concerns, and maintain effective configuration and product controls.

**Manufacturing Quality Assurance and Testing**

* Provide leadership and oversight of the Quality Assurance organization supporting manufacturing quality, engineering inspection, and testing activities across both business units.
* Support integrated product teams by offer subject expertise, ensuring programmatic needs are met
* Ensure effective execution of product inspection verification testing and acceptance processes in accordance with applicable specifications and customer requirements.
* Oversee quality assurance capabilities including quality technicians, testing personnel, and specialized inspection activities.
* Drive continuous improvement throughout the organization using established lean six sigma tools.
* Partner with operations and engineering to address manufacturing nonconformances, implement corrective action, and improve process capability and product reliability.

**Compliance, Financial Performance, and People Leadership**

* Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace and defense quality standards, contractual requirements, customer specifications, and regulatory obligations.
* Develop and maintain quality budgets, departmental resources, and improvement initiatives while promoting cost effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* Lead, coach, and develop direct-report managers while establishing clear expectations for performance accountability and organizational effectiveness
* Partner with people and culture on workforce planning succession planning leadership development and employee engagement.

**What Dedicated Teammates Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or related technical field. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, quality systems, or quality leadership within a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience including demonstrated success leading managers or multidisciplinary quality teams.
* Experience in aerospace defense, energetic materials, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience implementing, maintaining, or leading quality management systems aligned with ISO9001 and AS9100 requirements.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing, quality supplier, quality configuration management, inspection, testing, and regulatory compliance.
* Proven ability to develop quality strategies, manage budgets, lead organizational change, and drive measurable performance improvements.
* Strong leadership communication, analytical, problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Direct experience in defense manufacturing, energetic material processing, ammunition production, or aerospace propulsion.
* Demonstrated experience leading an organization through initial AS9100 certification or significant QMS expansion.
* Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
* Experience with specialized inspection and testing methods, non-destructive testing, and manufacturing process qualifications.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

*Leadership Competencies:*

* Aligns operational capabilities and resources with business objectives and long-term growth.
* Drives performance improvements in safety, quality, delivery cost, and reliability.
* Build strong management teams and promotes accountability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Demonstrate sound judgment, hazard awareness, and commitment to disciplined operations,
* Build effective partnerships across departments and business units
* Leads teams through expansion, organizational growth, and evolving operational requirements.

**Our Woking Conditions and Requirements**

* This position operates in both office and industrial manufacturing environments and requires regular interaction with production areas, maintenance, operations, and facility infrastructure.
* The role may involve prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and walking, including navigating manufacturing facilities and operational work areas.
* Employees must comply with applicable safety, security, and environmental requirements including the use of required personal protective equipment (PPE) when entering designated areas.
* The position may require occasional domestic or international travel and flexibility to support operational needs outside standard business hours.
* Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

*Our values are the fundamental principles guiding the way we do business and interact with stakeholders.*

***DEDICATION:*** *We are enthusiastic and creative, always searching for the best solutions.* 
***PRECISION:*** *We are reliable and accurate in our technology, processes and business.* 
***CARE:*** *We are inclusive and open-minded, always encouraging team spirit and cooperation.*

*Nammo and its subsidiaries provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

**\*\*Note\*\*: Due to US Export Control laws and regulations; applicants selected for employment must show proof of a U.S. Person status before employment may begin.**

role.title: Director of Compliance, Quality & Risk
role.description:
POSITION SUMMARY
 
 
Will provide strategic leadership, direction, and oversight of the Laguna Healthcare Corporation (LHC) Compliance, Quality Risk Programs, encompassing all clinical, administrative, financial, and medical practice plan functions. This position is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving enterprise-wide programs that ensure adherence to all federal, state, tribal, and accreditation standards. Serve as the primary authority on compliance matters, leads risk mitigation efforts, manages investigations, and champions a culture of ethics, accountability, and transparency. The Director collaborates with leadership, providers, and staff to promote a culture of continuous improvement, patient safety, and accountability. They oversee performance improvement initiatives, incident reporting systems, compliance activities, and risk mitigation strategies to enhance patient outcomes and organizational effectiveness. This position also plays a critical role in integrating culturally responsive care into quality frameworks, supporting health equity, and ensuring services reflect the values, traditions, and needs of the Tribal population served.
 
 
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
 
 

* Develop, implement, and oversee LHC’s Compliance, Quality Risk programs, policies, and procedures related to standards of conduct; healthcare laws; billing and reimbursement; fraud, waste, and abuse prevention; privacy and security; quality improvement and other compliance risk areas.
* Lead and facilitate internal committees to drive strategic planning for these programs, setting long- and short-term goals, operational plans, and performance measures.
* Conduct organization-wide quality and risk assessments to identify, prioritize, and mitigate compliance risks and improve overall patient outcomes.
* Monitor compliance with healthcare laws, CMS/OIG regulations, HIPAA/HITECH, and Tribal requirements.
* Oversee sanction screening of employees, contractors, and vendors; ensure organization-wide training on sanction monitoring processes. Ensure credentialing, privileging and provider enrollment program is effective.
* Lead internal audits and compliance reviews to ensure adherence to payer rules, regulatory standards, and organizational policies.
* Develop, in collaboration with the CMO, clinical care guidelines, as well as process and system guidelines.
* Manage confidential reporting channels, including the LHC Compliance Hotline, ensuring proper documentation, investigation, and resolution.
* Conduct or supervise compliance investigations; ensure/coordinate corrective actions with HR, legal counsel, leadership, and managers.
* Serve as the organizational liaison with regulatory agencies during audits, investigations, and compliance inquiries.
* Lead and mentor others in root cause analysis (RCA), healthcare failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) and hazard vulnerability analysis (HVA) teams. Summarize risk management and patient safety data for appropriate evaluation and risk trend analysis.
* Maintain detailed records of compliance efforts, investigative outcomes, and corrective action plans.
* Provide written and verbal compliance reports to executive management, internal Quality Committee, the Board Compliance Committee and the LHC Board of Directors.
* Develop and administer a robust, organization-wide compliance training and education program in conjunction managers and the HR department.
* Lead communication initiatives to promote compliance awareness, ethical conduct, quality management and transparent reporting.
* Provide ongoing consultation to staff and leadership on regulatory requirements and performance improvement measures.
* Develop and coordinate processes to monitor quality of care. Identify opportunities to improve patient care, treatment and services by assisting to implement standard work.
* Oversee accreditation preparation for review by regulatory agencies including AAAHC and/or Joint Commission, educate, and assist department supervisors to maintain appropriate policies and procedures to fulfill requirements and regulations.
* Develop, monitor, and manage department budget.
* Supervise and direct staff and consultants and ensure adequate systems, training and tools to support program goals achievement, performance management and corrective action.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
 
 
Five (5) years of progressive experience in healthcare compliance, quality or related healthcare roles. Bachelor Degree in Finance/Accounting, Business, Public or Healthcare Administration or related field of study from an accredited college or university. Master's Degree preferred.
 
 
Certified Professional Compliance Officer (CPCO) preferred, Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC), or Certified Compliance Ethics Professional (CCEP) or equivalent compliance certification, or eligible for and certification obtained within 12 months as condition of hire. Quality Management certification preferred.
 
 
MANDATORY KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES and COMPETENCIES with proficiency levels
 
 
Ethical Integrity Professionalism — Advanced
 
 
1. Demonstrates unwavering commitment to confidentiality, transparency, and ethical conduct.
 
 
2. Consistently models organizational values and establishes an ethical compliance culture.
 
 
3. Guides organizational decision-making through an ethics-centered approach.
 
 
Regulatory Compliance Expertise — Advanced
 
 
1. Interprets and applies federal, state, and Tribal healthcare regulations with precision.
 
 
2. Advises leadership on complex regulatory issues and emerging compliance risks.
 
 
3. Ensures organizational alignment with OIG, CMS, HIPAA/HITECH, and other regulatory standards.
 
 
Analytical Critical Thinking — Advanced
 
 
1. Uses advanced analytical methods to identify trends, risks, and system vulnerabilities.
 
 
2. Evaluates complex scenarios, synthesizes large volumes of information, and provides clear recommendations.
 
 
3. Leads continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven insights.
 
 
Investigation Problem-Solving — Advanced
 
 

* Conducts or oversees thorough investigations into compliance concerns.
* Demonstrates strong evidence analysis skills and draws objective, well-supported conclusions.
* Designs and monitors corrective action plans to ensure sustainable resolution

Leadership Influence — Advanced
 
 
1. Leads cross-functional teams and committees with confidence and clarity.
 
 
2. Influences organizational behavior through effective communication, coaching, and ethical leadership.
 
 
3. Builds trust and credibility with executives, clinical leaders, and staff.
 
 
Communication Interpersonal Effectiveness — Advanced
 
 
1. Clearly communicates complex regulatory concepts to varied audiences.
 
 
2. Prepares high-quality written reports and delivers professional presentations.
 
 
3. Maintains strong interpersonal relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.
 
 
Training Education Development — Intermediate to Advanced
 
 
1. Designs tailored compliance training programs for all workforce levels.
 
 
2. Assesses training effectiveness and adjusts content to address knowledge gaps.
 
 
3. Promotes consistent awareness of compliance responsibilities.
 
 
Project Program Management — Intermediate to Advanced
 
 
1. Manages multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
 
 
2. Develops strategic and operational plans for the Compliance Program.
 
 
3. Implements structured processes for tracking progress and outcomes.
 
 
Risk Management Continuous Improvement — Advanced
 
 
1. Conducts comprehensive risk assessments and ongoing monitoring activities.
 
 
2. Identifies compliance vulnerabilities and implements preventative strategies.
 
 
3. Leads continuous improvement efforts across systems, policies, and internal controls.
 
 
Technical Systems Proficiency — Intermediate
 
 
1. Utilizes compliance software, databases, and Microsoft Office applications effectively.
 
 
2. Works collaboratively with IT and privacy teams to support data security practices.
 
 
3. Applies technology solutions to enhance documentation, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
 
 
PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS
 
 
In performance of their respective tasks and duties, an employee of Laguna Healthcare Corporation is expected to conform to the following:
 
 
1. Fully uphold all principles of confidentiality and patient care.
 
 
2. Adhere to all professional and ethical behavior standards of the healthcare industry.
 
 
3. Maintain all licensures and certifications required of position.
 
 
4. Interact in an honest, trustworthy and respectful manner with patients, employees, visitors and vendors.
 
 
5. Participate in leadership and/or board meetings, departmental staff meetings, quality management activities and educational programs as required.
 
 
6. Comply with Laguna Healthcare Corporation policies and procedures.
 
 
**7. Demonstrate and comply with LHC values:** COMPASSION, HONESTY, ACCOUNTABILITY, RESPECT AND TRUST.
 
 
8. Maintain a valid, insurable driver’s license.
 
 
TRIBAL PREFERENCE
 
 
LHC will apply “Indian Preference” as an employment criterion and not a “racial classification.” The Laguna Healthcare Corporation has implemented a Tribal Preference in Employment Policy. Pursuant to this Policy, applicants who possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities required by this position, and who are enrolled members of the Pueblo of Laguna will be given primary preference in hiring and employment for this position. Members of other Federally recognized Indian Tribes will be given secondary preference for hiring and employment after providing proof of Tribal membership.
 
 
CONFIDENTIALITY
 
 
All employees must fully uphold all principles of confidentiality. This position will have access to sensitive information and a breach of these principles will be grounds for immediate termination
 
 
BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION
 
 
This position may be subject to a criminal history background check, a suitability background check and/or a credit report check. In addition, some positions are subject to a more extensive background check to ensure compliance with Public Law 101-630 Indian Child Protection and Family Violence Prevention Act. Candidates must be able to successfully pass all required background checks to qualify for this position.
 
 
DRUG SCREENING
 
 
All applicants must successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening prior to beginning employment and will be subject to random drug testing
 
 
**Disclaimer:** The information on this position description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performance by employees in this position. It is not designed to contain, or be interpreted as, a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this position. Employees will be asked to perform other duties as needed.
