role.title: Food Safety & Quality Director
role.description:
**Universal Ingredients**

*Innovative Plant-Based Solutions for Global Industries*

Universal Ingredients is a global supplier of high-quality, plant-based specialty ingredients for human and pet consumption. With thousands of products and global sourcing capabilities, we provide customized, value-added solutions – including fruit and vegetable juices and concentrates, dehydrated ingredients, botanical extracts, flavors, and beverage systems – for food and beverage manufacturers worldwide.

Our advanced production capabilities, including aseptic beverage processing and flexible packaging solutions, enable safe, shelf-stable products with no preservatives. At the heart of our innovation is our Application Capabilities Lab, where food science experts collaborate with customers to develop market-ready solutions through product development, flavor analysis, sensory testing, and commercialization support.

Driven by innovation, sustainability, and partnership, Universal Ingredients helps customers stay ahead of evolving consumer preferences while delivering consistent quality, functionality, and performance across global markets.

Disclaimer: Shank’s Extracts manufactures various products that identify as major food allergens (milk, eggs, tree nuts, wheat, and soybeans) as well as several other food ingredients. We cannot guarantee you will not be exposed to skin and/or odor contact with these various ingredients. Your health and safety are our number one priority, and we will do our best to accommodate within reason.

**Summary**

Universal Ingredients is seeking a **Food Safety & Quality Director** to lead our Quality, Food Safety, and Regulatory functions. This leader will establish and strengthen quality systems across the organization, ensure regulatory and food safety compliance, and partner closely with Operations, Commercialization, R&D, Procurement, and Commercial teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with practical manufacturing leadership and has a track record of building a **preventive, accountable quality culture** focused on getting things right the first time.

**What You'll Be Doing (Essential Duties)**

* Lead the overall **Quality, Food Safety, and Regulatory strategy** for Universal Ingredients.
* Establish consistent quality standards, systems, policies, and performance expectations across the organization.
* Ensure compliance with applicable **FDA, FSMA, GMP, HACCP, SQF/GFSI, labeling, and customer requirements**.
* Strengthen **root-cause analysis, CAPA, change control, SOP/SSOP, and audit processes**.
* Partner with Operations to improve **first-pass quality** and reduce complaints, deviations, holds, rework, and recurring quality issues.
* Lead customer complaint management, regulatory inspections, certification audits, and customer audits.
* Oversee **supplier quality, regulatory documentation, specifications, labeling, and product compliance**.
* Support new product commercialization by embedding Quality and Regulatory requirements early in the process.
* Maintain strong **traceability, recall preparedness, and crisis-management** processes.
* Develop and lead a high-performing Quality and Regulatory organization while fostering shared accountability for quality and food safety across the business.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Engineering, or related field.
* Progressive Quality, Food Safety, and/or Regulatory leadership experience in **food, beverage, flavors, ingredients, or related manufacturing**.
* Experience in Aseptic process manufacturing
* Strong knowledge of FDA food regulations, FSMA, GMPs, HACCP, supplier quality, sanitation, traceability, and recall management.
* Experience leading audits, inspections, investigations, root-cause analysis, and CAPA.
* Strong manufacturing orientation with demonstrated ability to partner effectively with plant operations.
* Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Requirements**

* PCQI/HACCP certification, GFSI lead auditor certification, and experience in flavors, extracts, food ingredients, or complex food manufacturing

**Available Immediately Upon Hire: Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA, EAP, ID Theft, 401K, and PTO**

***EOE M/F/Disabled/Vet Employer*** 
**All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.**

role.title: Director, Quality Assurance, Burger King, US&C
role.description:
**Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.**

 

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $49 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 33,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

**Director, Quality Assurance**

*BURGER KING | UNITED STATES & CANADA | MIAMI, FLORIDA*

**Position Overview**

Burger King is seeking an experienced, collaborative and results-oriented Director of Quality Assurance to lead product quality and supplier quality performance across the U.S. and Canadian restaurant system. This leader ensures that products consistently meet approved specifications and guest expectations, while driving measurable improvements in product quality, consistency and supplier performance.

The Director serves as the primary product quality assurance leader and communication point of contact for the Burger King system, including franchisees, and works closely with suppliers and cross-functional partners. This position is not responsible for ownership or management of the Food Safety function. Burger King has a dedicated Food Safety department, with which this role partners closely on matters involving both product quality and food safety. The role has three primary areas of accountability.

RBI follows a 5 day, in-office work schedule to support collaboration. Successful candidates will be expected to work onsite 5 days per week.

**1. Improve Product Quality and Supplier Performance**

**Ensure suppliers meet current specifications and continuously improve the quality and consistency of products served to guests.**

* Own product quality standards and maintain clear, actionable specifications across the Burger King food and beverage portfolio.
* Work directly with suppliers to ensure adherence to approved product specifications and drive continuous improvement in product quality, consistency and sensory performance.
* Establish supplier quality performance expectations, scorecards and regular reviews; use data to identify trends, prioritize improvements and hold suppliers accountable.
* Analyze product testing, sensory evaluations, laboratory data, restaurant feedback and guest complaints to identify quality gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Lead product quality investigations and supplier corrective and preventive actions, validating sustained resolution and communicating results.
* Partner on supplier qualification, product validation and manufacturing process changes from a product quality perspective.
* Maintain and improve product quality systems, documentation, reporting and specification management tools, including SPEQ where applicable.
* Coordinate with the dedicated Food Safety department when product quality concerns raise food safety questions; Food Safety retains ownership of food safety programs, regulatory food safety compliance and related incident decisions.

**2. Lead QA Communications and Represent Quality Across the Burger King System**

**Be the trusted, responsive product quality leader for franchisees and the broader Burger King system.**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for product quality assurance matters for franchisees, franchisee leadership groups, Operations and senior business leaders.
* Own proactive, timely and transparent franchisee-facing communication regarding product quality concerns, supplier quality performance, product changes and resolution plans.
* Translate technical findings into clear, practical actions and updates that restaurant operators can understand and use.
* Build feedback loops with franchisees and field teams to identify recurring product quality concerns and incorporate operator input into improvement priorities.
* Lead escalation, investigation, tracking and resolution of significant product quality issues affecting restaurants, with clear accountability and closure.
* Represent product QA in franchisee meetings, advisory forums and leadership discussions; provide concise performance updates and recommendations.
* Partner with Food Safety and the appropriate incident-response leaders on communications where product quality issues intersect with food safety, without assuming ownership of food safety response or decisions.
* Lead, coach and develop the QA team, creating a culture of technical excellence, responsiveness and accountability.

**3. Partner with Culinary, Marketing, Operations and RSI**

**Embed product quality in innovation, sourcing and restaurant execution through strong cross-functional partnership.**

* Act as the primary QA partner to Culinary, Marketing, Operations and Restaurant Services, Inc. (RSI), the Burger King purchasing co-op.
* Collaborate with Culinary and Product Innovation to develop and validate specifications that deliver the intended guest experience consistently at scale.
* Partner with RSI and suppliers to address supplier quality performance, assess sourcing and supplier changes, and support continuous product improvement.
* Support product testing, commercialization and launch readiness by validating product quality, manufacturing consistency and specification compliance.
* Work with Marketing and Culinary to align product quality and sensory performance with brand positioning and guest expectations.
* Evaluate quality implications of ingredient, formulation, packaging, manufacturing and supplier changes, including feasibility for restaurant execution.
* Partner with Operations to translate product standards into restaurant-ready execution and reduce avoidable product variability.
* Coordinate with the Food Safety department for its independent review and approval of food safety considerations in launches, supplier transitions and product changes.
* Balance product quality, operational feasibility and cost considerations while protecting approved brand standards.

**Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Quality Assurance or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in food product quality assurance, food manufacturing, supplier quality management or related disciplines, including demonstrated leadership responsibility.
* Experience managing supplier product specifications, supplier performance, product quality investigations and corrective action programs.
* Strong understanding of food manufacturing, product quality systems, sensory evaluation and analytical testing; ability to work effectively with specialist Food Safety teams.
* Strong analytical and commercial judgment, including the ability to translate technical data into decisions and priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience influencing nontechnical stakeholders and senior leaders.
* Demonstrated cross-functional leadership, relationship-building, issue resolution and people-management capabilities.
* Ability to travel to suppliers, manufacturing facilities, restaurants and business meetings as required.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a large multi-unit restaurant, foodservice or consumer food business, ideally with franchisees.
* Experience partnering with a purchasing co-op, procurement organization, Culinary, Marketing and Product Innovation teams.
* Familiarity with statistical process control, process capability, sensory testing and supplier quality scorecards.
* Professional quality management certification and experience with product commercialization and supplier transitions.

#BurgerKing

Benefits at all of our global offices are focused on physical, mental and financial wellness. We offer unique and progressive benefits, including a comprehensive global paid parental leave program that supports employees as they expand their families, free telemedicine and mental wellness support.

Restaurant Brands International and all of its affiliated companies (collectively, RBI) are equal opportunity and affirmative action employers that do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, provincial or federal laws, rules, or regulations. RBI's policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment. Accommodation is available for applicants with disabilities upon request.

role.description:
**Quality/Risk Director Career Opportunity**

**Highly regarded and valued for your Quality/Risk Director expertise** 
Are you seeking a career that not only utilizes your skills but also aligns with your personal values, providing a profound sense of belonging and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in patients' lives? Look no further than Encompass Health, the nation's leader in in-patient rehabilitation care. As a Quality/Risk Director, you will oversee a hospital-wide quality management program, collaborating with various stakeholders to monitor and enhance the quality of patient care services. Join a team that values collaboration, support, and inclusivity, and embark on a rewarding career close to home and close to your heart, complete with access to cutting-edge equipment and technology and a comprehensive benefits package from day one.

**A Glimpse into Our World** 
At Encompass Health, you'll experience the difference the moment you become a part of our team. Being at Encompass Health means aligning with a rapidly growing national inpatient rehabilitation leader. We take pride in the growth opportunities we offer and how our team unites for the greater good of our patients. Our achievements include being named one of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and receiving the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® Award, among other accolades, which is nothing short of amazing.

**Starting Perks and Benefits** 
At Encompass Health, we are committed to creating a supportive, inclusive, and caring environment where you can thrive. From **day one,** you will have access to:

* Affordable medical, dental, and vision plans for both full-time and part-time employees and their families.
* Generous paid time off that accrues over time.
* Opportunities for tuition reimbursement and continuing education.
* Company-matching 401(k) and employee stock purchase plans.
* Flexible spending and health savings accounts.
* A vibrant community of individuals passionate about the work they do!

**Become the Quality/Risk Director you've always aspired to be**

* Ensure compliance with regulatory agencies, accrediting bodies, corporate and hospital policies, and procedures. Develop, implement, and maintain quality assessment and improvement programs.
* Assess compliance with federal, state, and industry regulatory and accreditation standards, facilitating processes to remediate and/or maintain compliance. Provide organizational education related to regulations and standards and coordinate local, state, federal, and accreditation surveys.
* Use a variety of applications (including, but not limited to, PatCom, UDS, ORYX, and Press Ganey) to identify improvement opportunities, generate reports, research issues, identify resources, and access external databases.
* Ensure the update and maintenance of hospital plans, including the Provision of Care/Scope of Services, Leadership, Information Management, Utilization Review, Infection Control, and Patient Safety plans. Oversee risk management activities, including completion of incident reports, notice of potential claims, corrective action planning, and incident reporting to the Corporate Risk Manager.
* Coordinate the review, development, and implementation of hospital policies.
* .Communicate and collaborate with other departments to coordinate care and promptly resolve patient concerns or complaints.
* Celebrate the accomplishments and successes of our dedicated employees along the way.

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor's degree in healthcare or a related field is preferred.
* License or Certification as required by state regulations.
* Experience in Quality and/or Risk Management, including primary responsibility for performance improvement activities, regulatory compliance, conflict resolution, leadership, and risk management activities.

#LI-BG1

**The Encompass Health Way**

We proudly set the standard in care by leading with empathy, doing what's right, focusing on the positive, and standing stronger together. Encompass Health is a trusted leader in post-acute care with over 150 nationwide locations and a team of 36,000 exceptional individuals and growing!

At Encompass Health, we celebrate and welcome diversity in our inclusive culture. We provide equal employment opportunities regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, color, creed, age, mental or physical disability, or any other protected classification.

role.title: Sr Manager Revenue Ops & Billing Governance
role.description:
Club Car boasts a 60+ year history of industry-leading innovation and design, initially focused on golf cars and then expanding to commercial utility vehicles and personal-use transportation.

**GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION**

This newly created leadership position is responsible for building and scaling Club Car’s centralized Billing Governance and Revenue Operations function. The Senior Manager will establish the governance framework, operating model, controls, reporting, and accountability mechanisms necessary to improve invoice accuracy, reduce credits and rebills, improve cash flow performance, and create end-to-end ownership across the Order-to-Cash process. The role serves as a key partner to Commercial, Customer Care, Operations, Supply Chain, IT, Treasury, and Finance and reports to the VP, Global Corporate Controller.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Establish and lead Club Car’s centralized Billing Governance and Revenue Operations function.
* Design and document future-state Order-to-Cash processes, ownership matrices, escalation paths, and governance routines.
* Develop KPI dashboards monitoring invoice accuracy, dispute trends, credit/rebill activity, deductions, billing cycle times, DSO, and collection effectiveness.
* Create governance forums that drive accountability across Commercial, Operations, Customer Care, Supply Chain, IT, and Finance.
* Define standardized billing policies, procedures, controls, and performance expectations.
* Identify and eliminate root causes of pricing discrepancies, master data issues, shipping variances, tax errors, and order-entry defects.
* Partner with IT to automate billing workflows, reporting, and exception management processes.
* Lead enterprise-wide initiatives focused on improving billing quality, customer experience, and working capital performance.

***Credit, Rebill & Deduction Governance***

* Own reporting and root-cause analysis related to credit memos, rebills, debit memos, and customer deductions.
* Establish accountability by customer, product, process owner, and business unit.
* Lead recurring cross-functional reviews and corrective-action plans.
* Drive measurable reductions in billing-related disputes and customer claims.

***Financial Controls & Compliance***

* Support close activities for receivables, reserves, deductions, rebates, billing adjustments, and revenue-related accounts.
* Oversee reconciliation governance for key revenue-cycle balance sheet accounts.
* Maintain strong internal-control compliance across billing and receivables processes.
* Support internal and external audits and remediation efforts.

***Leadership & Function Build-Out***

* Build and develop a scalable billing governance organization as business needs evolve.
* Establish training, operating procedures, performance metrics, and management routines.
* Lead organizational change management necessary to implement new processes and controls.
* Champion analytics, automation, AI-enabled tools, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

* Centralized billing governance structure implemented enterprise-wide.
* Improved first-pass invoice accuracy and reduced manual corrections.
* Reduction in credits, rebills, deductions, and customer disputes.
* Improved DSO, collection performance, and working-capital visibility.
* Sustainable cross-functional accountability for Order-to-Cash performance.

**OTHER DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintains safe and productive work environment by assuring the work area is clear of tools, brooms, debris, and other items that may present a hazard.
* Will be required to perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE JOB**

*Education:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.

*Experience:*

* 7+ years of finance, billing operations, revenue operations, accounts receivable, or controllership experience.
* 3+ years of leadership experience with demonstrated success driving change.
* Experience building, transforming, or standardizing business processes in complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge of O2C, billing operations, internal controls, ERP systems, and process governance.

*Preferred:*

* CPA, CMA, MBA, Lean Six Sigma, manufacturing experience, Power BI, or shared-services transformation experience.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Ability to react with appropriate levels of urgency to situations and events that require quick response or turnaround.
* Exceptional organizational, project management, time management, and attention to detail capabilities.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to deal with and manage uncertainty and change.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to complete a high volume of tasks and projects with little or no guidance.
* Demonstrates an ability to teach others how to use various systems effectively.
* Shows an ability to keep up with changing technologies and attend meetings or conferences for ongoing education.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen.
* This position may be required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to feel; reach with hand and arms, and stoop, kneel or crouch as needed.

role.title: VP, Manufacturing and Supply Chain
role.description:
In this role you will lead GMP Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing Science and Technology (MS&T). It ensures reliable clinical and commercial supply through scalable manufacturing, resilient supply chains, and science-based process optimization. The VP sits on the Technical Operations leadership team. The VP partners with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Facilities, Engineering, Finance, Research, and external partners.

This is an on-site role in Torrey Pines, CA that requires flexibility and availability for weekend and holiday work as needed. Relocation is not available.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Strategy and Organization**: Set manufacturing strategy, build and scale the organization, and plan capacity and workforce.
* **Compliance and Quality:** Ensure cGMP and regulatory compliance and keep the site inspection-ready with Quality.
* **Process and Technology:** Drive process performance, technology transfer, MS&T lifecycle activities, and automation, digitalization, and manufacturing execution systems (MES).
* **Supply chain and Partners:** Oversee supply planning, sourcing, and Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP). Manage CDMOs and critical suppliers.
* **Regulatory and Facilities:** Support regulatory filings (INDs and BLAs) and partner on facility expansion and qualification.
* **Finance and Reporting:** Manage budgets and capital plans, set KPIs, and report risks and recommendations to executives and the Board.
* **Culture and Representation:** Foster a culture of safety, compliance, and continuous improvement, and represent the company in external forums.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* + A bachelor's degree in engineering or life sciences is required. An advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) is preferred.
* At least 15 years in biopharma or cell and gene therapy manufacturing, including 8 or more years in senior leadership.

***Required:***

* GMP manufacturing leadership
* Process development and scale-up
* MS&T and technology transfer
* Supply chain and CDMO management
* Regulatory inspection experience with the FDA, EMA, and others
* Leading large teams and delivering on budget and schedule

***Preferred:***

* Experience with automation, MES, and digital manufacturing. Prior autologous cell therapy manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.

**JOB SPECIFICATIONS:**

* Executive and People leadership
* Enterprise Judgement and Risk Management
* Financial Acumen
* Executive Communication.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

General office, manufacturing, laboratory, and cleanroom environment. This position requires occasional presence in GMP manufacturing areas and interaction with production operations. The employee may be exposed to standard laboratory materials and manufacturing equipment. Domestic and international travel may be required. Some Cleanroom access is required

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

These work environment characteristics are representative of the environment the job holder will encounter. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable people with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

**EEO and Employment Eligibility:**

Aspen Neuroscience is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and job applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Aspen is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have valid work authorization that does not require employer sponsorship now or in the future.

**Total Rewards and Culture:**

Aspen Neuroscience, Inc., located in scenic Torrey Pines, is noted for its collaborative and learning focused culture where each person is valued for contributing their strengths and energy to building a world-class line of products for patients in need. The company offers a competitive total compensation package, time-off in addition to Company observed holidays, Medical/Dental insurance benefits, onsite gym, and other wellness perks.

The anticipated salary range for candidates who will work in San Diego is $308,700-$377,300 annually. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and length of experience within the industry, education, etc. Aspen Neuroscience is multi-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions that work in other states.

role.title: VP, Global Operations
role.description:
**About Oshkosh AeroTech, an Oshkosh company**

**Oshkosh AeroTech is a leading provider of aviation ground support products, gate equipment and airport services to commercial airlines, airports, air-freight carriers, ground handling and military customers. Oshkosh AeroTech offers products that make a difference in people’s lives by supporting those in our communities who do some of the toughest work. They own many of the most trusted brands in the air transportation industry, including LEKTRO®, JetAire®, JetPower®, AmpTekÔ, Jetway®, and more.**

The Oshkosh AeroTech Vice President, Operations will lead operational strategy, execution, and continuous improvement across the Ground Support Equipment (GSE) and Jetway businesses. With dual reporting to the VP of Global Operations & Supply Chain at the Vocational segment and the President of Oshkosh AeroTech, this role is a key member of the Oshkosh AeroTech leadership team, responsible for driving a safety culture, operational efficiency, increasing capacity, manufacturing excellence, and overall business performance.

**YOUR IMPACT**

Safety & Operations Leadership

* Develop, implement, and sustain a world-class safety program that prioritizes team member well-being
* Drive a proactive safety culture by embedding safety into all operational activities, ensuring every team member understands and takes ownership of safety responsibilities.
* In collaboration with VP, Operations & Supply Chain at Vocational segment, develop and implement a comprehensive operations strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Establish KPIs to measure and drive operational performance, efficiency, and cost optimization.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives in production, workflow optimization, and resource allocation.
* Ensure world-class manufacturing capabilities, leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, and automation best practices.
* Develop and implement strategy to increase capacity across AeroTech manufacturing sites.
* Partner with Supply Chain organization to optimize supplier partnerships and inventory management.
* Drive cost reduction initiatives while maintaining high quality and regulatory compliance.

Quality & Compliance

* Ensure all operational processes comply with industry standards, safety regulations, and quality control frameworks.
* Implement best-in-class operational processes to reduce defects, improve reliability, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Drive adherence to ISO and other relevant regulatory requirements.

Financial Management

* Manage budgets, operational expenditures, and capital investments to drive profitability.
* Conduct financial analyses to improve operational decision-making and efficiency.
* Optimize cost structures through strategic sourcing, automation, and process improvements.

Leadership & Talent Development

* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team.
* Foster a culture of safety, continuous improvement, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning and development initiatives to align with business growth and expansion.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of experience in operational leadership, with at least 3 years in a VP or Director-level role.
* Experienced people leader with cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong experience in multi-site manufacturing, supply chain management, and logistics.
* Proven track record in driving operational excellence, lean manufacturing, and six sigma methodologies.
* Strong financial acumen, data-driven decision-making, and process optimization skills.
* Lives the Oshkosh Core Values of We put people first, We do the right thing, We persevere, We are better together
* Demonstrates the Oshkosh Leadership Traits of Inspires Vision and Purpose, Drives Results, Customer Focus, Cultivates Innovation, Fosters Engagement, and Instills Trust

**STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master’s degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience working with government, military, or defense contracts.
* International or global business experience.

$189,800.00 - $370,200.00

Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, education and skills, as well as the equity of pay among team members in similar positions. Beyond offering a competitive total rewards package, we prioritize a people-first culture and offer various opportunities to support team member growth and success.

role.title: Plant Director
role.description:
About SunOpta
 
SunOpta delivers customized supply chain solutions and innovation for top brands, retailers, and foodservice providers across a broad portfolio of beverages, broths, and better-for-you snacks. With over 50 years of expertise, SunOpta fuels customers’ growth with high-quality, sustainability-forward solutions distributed through retail, club, foodservice, and e-commerce channels across North America.
 
 
**Job Summary:** 
The Plant Director leads all aspects of plant operations, ensuring the delivery of the highest-quality products at the lowest sustainable cost while maintaining the safest, most environmentally responsible operating environment. Sets the strategic direction for manufacturing, drives operational excellence, and fosters a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all plant functions. Champions talent development and organizational effectiveness by building a strong leadership pipeline, attracting, developing, and retaining top talent, and empowering employees at all levels to reach their full potential. Cultivates an inclusive, high-performance culture that values engagement, teamwork, ownership, and shared success. Provides leadership and guidance to ensure alignment with company goals, long-term growth objectives, and regulatory compliance.
 
 
**Essential Functions of the Job:** 

* Develops and executes the plant’s strategic and operational plans to achieve production, cost, quality, safety, and environmental targets, influencing both direct reports and dotted-line stakeholders to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and long-term growth.
* Oversees multi-line, 24/7 manufacturing operations, ensuring optimal production scheduling, resource allocation, and workforce management while balancing short-term needs with long-term operational priorities.
* Leads capital planning and plant improvement initiatives, engaging both direct teams and matrixed partners to implement equipment upgrades, process optimizations, and technology projects that maximize efficiency and ROI.
* Establishes and monitors key performance metrics, including OEE, throughput, waste reduction, and labor efficiency, leveraging operational data to drive continuous improvement and cost containment across the plant.
* Provides oversight and influence across Maintenance, Production, Quality, Engineering, EHS, and Supply Chain functions in a matrixed organization, leveraging both direct and dotted-line relationships to ensure alignment, coordinated planning, preventive programs, and successful cross-functional initiatives.
* Influences and partners with cross-functional leaders to ensure robust food safety programs, adherence to GMPs, and compliance with all regulatory and customer standards.
* Oversees all plant financial responsibilities, including budgets, capital expenditures, cost control, staffing, and productivity reporting. Provides strategic insight to Finance and executive leadership to support operational and investment decisions.
* Drives employee engagement and organizational development by partnering with HR and plant leadership to attract, develop, and retain top talent; build leadership capabilities and succession strength; establish clear performance expectations and accountability; and foster a high-performing culture rooted in collaboration, continuous learning, and shared ownership of results.
* Acts as the primary liaison between plant operations and corporate leadership, providing operational updates, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations for continuous growth and efficiency improvement.
* Serves as the key decision-maker in operational issues, including crisis management, production disruptions, and long-term operational planning.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** 

* Direct Reports: Responsible for directly managing various functions including Operations/Production Manager(s), Maintenance, EHS, etc.)

**Minimum Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Food Science, related field; or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of leadership experience in Food & Beverage, Pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated manufacturing environment
* Proven experience leading multi-shift, multi-line operations with P&L responsibility

**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* Master’s Degree
* Bilingual in Spanish

**Knowledge and Skills:** 

* Exceptional strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with a track record of delivering operational excellence in complex manufacturing environments
* Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, or other continuous improvement methodologies with demonstrated results in efficiency, waste reduction, and cost management
* Strong financial acumen, including budget management, cost forecasting, and productivity analytics
* In-depth knowledge of regulatory compliance, food safety, environmental standards, and employee safety programs
* Polished leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire cross-functional teams and senior executives

**Additional Considerations:** 

* Travel Expectation: Some travel required.
* Location: This role will be located at our plant in Omak, WA.
* Work Environment: This work will be split between a manufacturing environment and office environment.

Featured Benefits
 

* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Paid Family leave
* Paid maternity leave
* 401(k) with Match
* Voluntary Life, Accident, Critical Illness and Hospital indemnity
* Paid Holidays
* Tuition assistance
* Short-term and Long-term Disability insurance

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.
 
 
AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
Kentucky Trailer

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

Job Title: Director of Operations
 
Division: Kentucky Trailer 
Location: Louisville, KY- 3 site locations 
Reports to: President, Kentucky Trailer 
FLSA: Exempt 
 
This position has multiple direct reports across 3 sites. Current direct reports include Operations Manager, 7 Team Leaders, and a Manufacturing Engineer/Facilities Manager. This position requires local travel between the 3 sites in Louisville. 
 
Kentucky Trailer has been building in Louisville since 1879, when it was founded as the Kentucky Wagon Manufacturing Company. Today it designs and builds custom trailers and truck bodies for moving and storage, snack food distribution, package delivery, and specialty markets such as mobile medical, government, and motorsports. Most of what we build is engineered to order rather than off the shelf, which makes our operations both challenging and rewarding to lead. 
 
The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day manufacturing operations and is accountable for Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People, and Productivity results. The role owns the manufacturing operating budget, develops frontline leaders, and builds a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Works closely with Materials, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and Commercial Sales to make sure production plans are executable and customer commitments are met. The workforce is non-union.

**Position Key Accountabilities:**

### **Safety**

* Create and sustain a Safety First and Always culture, with every employee understanding their personal responsibility for a safe workplace.
* Enforce safety policies, procedures and safe work practices at every level of the organization.
* Make sure hazards, near misses and incidents are addressed promptly, with root causes corrected.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA and environmental requirements and lead continuous improvement toward an incident-free workplace.

### **Manufacturing performance and planning**

* Lead daily manufacturing activities to meet production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Set clear daily, weekly and monthly expectations for each production area, and align labor and resources to requirements.
* Identify production constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Materials so schedules are executable and escalate shortages before they affect production.
* Support point-of-use inventory, Kanban, vendor-managed inventory and other Lean material strategies where appropriate.

### **Quality**

* Build a culture where quality is owned at the point of manufacture and the next operation is treated as the customer.
* Ensure compliance with manufacturing standards, specifications, work instructions and quality procedures.
* Partner with Engineering to drive root-cause corrective action and reduce defects, rework, warranty exposure and cost of poor quality.

### **Lean and operational excellence**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing using 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kaizen and structured problem solving.
* Establish a disciplined management cadence of daily production meetings, visual boards, KPI reviews and structured follow-up.
* Ensure standard work is documented, followed and continuously improved.
* Drive measurable improvement in labor productivity, cycle time, throughput, material flow, space utilization and manufacturing cost.
* Lead automation and capital initiatives that improve safety, quality, productivity and cost.

### **Financial performance and cost**

* Own the manufacturing operating budget and take part in the annual budget and monthly forecasts.
* Manage to labor, overhead and operating cost targets, including direct labor productivity, overtime and indirect labor.
* Ensure accuracy in both labor reporting and BOM usages
* WIP accuracy, and operational support for cycle counts and physical inventories.
* Partner with Finance to analyze manufacturing variances and carry out corrective actions.
* Prepare ROI justifications for capital requests and track whether completed projects deliver the promised return.

### **Maintenance and facilities**

* Ensure preventive maintenance programs maximize equipment uptime and extend asset life.
* Improve utilization of equipment, facilities and manufacturing capacity.

### **Leadership and people development**

* Lead, coach and develop managers, team leaders and employees across the operation.
* Set annual performance goals and development plans and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Build frontline leaders' capability in problem solving, waste elimination and employee accountability.
* Build organizational depth through hiring, succession planning and cross-training.
* Communicate regularly with employees about performance, company expectations, policies and priorities.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Manufacturing or another technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 10 years in manufacturing with a proven record of success and increasing responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years leading multi-site operations through managers and leaders.
* Demonstrated record of improving safety performance
* Lean Manufacturing experience or certification, with measurable results in efficiency improvement and cost reduction.
* Demonstrated P&L or operating budget accountability.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once.
* Willingness to live and work in the greater Louisville, KY area.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Trailer, truck body or similar fabrication, welding and assembly experience.
* Experience in high-mix, custom build-to-order manufacturing.
* MBA or other financial education.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

This role works in both office and manufacturing plant settings, with exposure to noise, welding, painting and moving equipment. Required PPE must be worn on the production floor. The role regularly requires walking and standing for extended periods.

Employment is contingent on successful completion of a background check and drug screen.

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

role.title: Head of Operations
role.description:
**Head of Operations**
======================

**BCA Automation & Robotics (An Mpac Group Company)**

**Reports to:** Managing Director

**Location**: Newburyport, MA

**Lead Operations. Deliver Innovation. Drive Growth.**
------------------------------------------------------

BCA Automation & Robotics is a specialist provider of automation, robotics, conveyor, material handling and engineered solutions. As part of the Mpac Group, we help customers improve productivity, efficiency and performance through innovative automation technologies.

 

We are looking for an experienced **Head of Operations** to lead our operational functions and play a critical role in delivering complex automation projects from concept through to commissioning and long-term customer support.

 

This is a senior leadership position with responsibility for manufacturing, procurement, assembly, installation, commissioning, service, and operational performance across the business.

 

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

As Head of Operations, you will oversee the successful execution of customer projects while ensuring operational excellence, workforce development, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction. Working closely with Engineering, Project Management, Sales and Applications teams, you will ensure projects are properly planned, resourced, and delivered safely, on time, to budget and to the highest quality standards.

You will also play an important role in supporting business growth, engaging directly with customers, contributing to solution development, and representing the operational capabilities of the business.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Operational Leadership**

* Lead Manufacturing, Procurement, Assembly, Installation, Commissioning and Service functions.
* Drive operational performance, efficiency, quality, and safety across the business.
* Develop and implement operational strategies aligned with company objectives.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

### **Project Delivery & Engineering Collaboration**

* Ensure projects are effectively planned, resourced, and executed.
* Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical and Controls Engineering teams to achieve customer delivery commitments.
* Manage operational risks and resolve issues impacting project performance.
* Support successful project execution from design through customer acceptance.

### **Manufacturing & Supply Chain**

* Oversee production planning, manufacturing performance, and capacity management.
* Lead procurement activities and supplier relationships.
* Improve supply chain performance, inventory management, and purchasing effectiveness.
* Implement operational improvements that enhance profitability and delivery performance.

### **Customer & Site Engagement**

* Build strong customer relationships through regular engagement and project reviews.
* Support installations, commissioning activities, and customer acceptance testing.
* Act as a senior operational representative during key customer interactions.
* Identify opportunities for future projects, upgrades, and service growth.

### **Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary teams.
* Drive recruitment, succession planning, and employee development.
* Build a high-performance culture focused on safety, accountability, and results.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 10 years' leadership experience within industrial automation, systems integration, manufacturing, or engineered-to-order environments.
* Proven track record managing manufacturing, procurement, assembly, installation, commissioning, and service operations.
* Strong leadership, commercial, organisational and problem-solving skills.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing performance through KPIs and operational metrics.
Strong understanding of workplace safety standards. 

 

### **Desirable**

* Experience within automation, material handling, packaging, food processing, or manufacturing sectors.
* Knowledge of Allen-Bradley, Rockwell Automation, and industrial controls environments.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement qualifications.
* PMP certification or strong project delivery experience.

**Success Will Be Measured By**
-------------------------------

 

* On-time project delivery
* Manufacturing productivity and efficiency
* Procurement and supply chain performance
* Installation and commissioning performance
* Customer satisfaction and service responsiveness
* Gross margin achievement
* Safety performance
* Employee engagement, retention and development
Continuous improvement results 

 

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

At BCA Automation & Robotics, you'll join a growing business backed by the global strength of the Mpac Group while retaining the agility and innovation of a specialist automation company. You'll have the opportunity to influence strategy, shape operations, develop teams, and make a significant impact on business performance and customer success.

 

### **Our Core Values**

* Integrity
* Drive
* Collaboration
* Expertise
Innovation 

 

### **Benefits**

* Health Insurance
* Dental & Vision Insurance
* Life Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Holidays and Sick Leave) 

 

**Apply Today**
---------------

If you are a proven operational leader with experience delivering complex automation or engineered solutions projects and are ready to take ownership of a key leadership role within a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

role.title: Operations Director
role.description:
TOGETHER, WE SAVE LIVES
 
 
Summary
 
The Operations Director is responsible for developing and executing the operations strategy for the Jacksonville body armor manufacturing facility. This role provides site leadership across manufacturing operations, manufacturing engineering, maintenance, continuous improvement, and operational excellence to ensure safe, efficient, and scalable execution aligned with company objectives.
 
The Operations Director serves as a champion of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and the Cadre Operating Model, driving a culture of continuous improvement while building organizational structures, leadership capability, and operational systems that support growth and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 

* Develop and execute the operations strategy to support facility performance, growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.
* Lead manufacturing operations and manufacturing engineering functions to achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and productivity objectives.
* Partner cross functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Engineering, Product Development, Customer Service, Quality, and HR to align operational capabilities with business priorities.
* Establish performance goals, KPIs, and accountability systems that drive results across the organization.
* Lead capacity planning, labor planning, capital investment, and operational readiness for growth, new products, and facility expansion.
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and structured problem solving methodologies to improve operational performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on throughput, quality, lead time reduction, waste elimination, labor efficiency, and cost optimization.
* Provide strategic oversight of automation, process improvement, manufacturing technology, and capital projects to enhance operational capability and scalability.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, regulatory, customer, and environmental requirements while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
* Build organizational capability through leadership development, succession planning, workforce planning, and organizational design.
* Manage operational budgets and business performance through data-driven decision making, operational reviews, and corrective action planning.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Education
 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field required.
* Master's degree preferred.

Experience
 

* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 5+ years leading managers and multi-functional operational organizations.
* Proven experience leading manufacturing operations in a complex, high-mix manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated success implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and Operational Excellence systems.
* Strong experience leading organizational transformation, culture change, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing manufacturing engineering, automation, capital projects, and process improvement programs.
* Background in ballistic armor, protective equipment, defense, aerospace, composites, or similarly regulated manufacturing environments preferred.
* Experience working within environments requiring strict quality, traceability, regulatory, and customer compliance standards.

Preferred Certifications
 

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt.

Key Competencies
 

* Strategic thinker with a strong operational mindset.
* Proven ability to lead through influence and drive cross functional alignment.
* Skilled coach and developer of leaders and teams.
* Builds accountability while fostering a respectful and engaged culture.
* Deep understanding of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of value stream management, operational metrics, and performance systems.
* Strong financial and operational decision making skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, operational capability, and business priorities.
* Experience driving growth while maintaining operational discipline.

Physical & Work Environment
 

* Regular presence on the manufacturing floor.
* Ability to work around industrial equipment, materials, and PPE requirements.
* Occasional travel to other company locations, suppliers, and customers.
* Occasional extended hours or off-shift support based on business needs.

Why work at Safariland?
 
 
At Safariland our colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry and we are seeking new team members who exhibit the diverse competencies that will drive The Safariland Group to even greater success while maintaining our culture of being a great place to work. We believe innovation drives winning performance and we constantly challenge ourselves to be the very best in every aspect of our business. We cultivate a work culture driven by our 4 core values; integrity, curiosity, excellence and empowerment and we want associates to be involved in their work and communities so they can achieve their highest level of wellbeing. That is why Safariland offers a comprehensive suite of benefits to promote health and financial security for eligible employees and their families.
 
 
**Eligible employees are offered:** 

* Medical, dental & vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Employer paid life insurance and AD&D
* Employer paid disability
* Wellness program
* Adoption assistance
* Tuition assistance
* Employee assistance program
* Work life balance
* Paid time off (PTO), sick leave and paid holidays throughout the calendar year (consistent with relevant state law and company policies)

The Safariland Group believes in the benefits of a diverse workforce and is committed to equal opportunity and affirmative actions. We pride ourselves on hiring and developing the best people, without regard to age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic characteristics, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, national origin, alienage, citizenship, disability, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other legally recognized protected basis prohibited by applicable law.
 
 
For those applicants with disabilities, if you require reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening or submitting an application, please contact us by calling 888-469-6455.
 
 
All employment decisions are solely based on the applicant's qualifications as they relate to the requirements of the position.

role.description:
At Taconic Biosciences, operational excellence fuels scientific discovery. We're seeking an experienced Operations Planning leader to strengthen the connection between commercial demand and operational execution, ensuring our teams deliver exceptional results for customers worldwide. If you're passionate about strategic planning, continuous improvement, and leading high-performing teams, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

**The Location:** This role is a primarily at home/remote but will have ad hoc needs to come onsite. Average monthly time on-site is 5% - 10%. A candidate residing within 2 hours of Albany, NY or Germantown, NY is preferred but not required.

**The Pay Range**: $120,000 - $170,000 annually. *Exact annual base salary may vary based on several factors. These factors include, but are not limited to: geographic location, experience, training, education, and local market conditions.*

**The Schedule:** Monday - Friday, core business hours.

**What we offer:**

* Insurance within 30 days or less which includes options for medical, dental, vision, pet insurance and more!
* 20 days paid time off plus 6 additional holidays and 1 floating holiday
* Work life balance
* 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Career advancement opportunities
* Commitment to training and providing you with the skills you need for success
* All employees receive access to 24/7 telemedicine (including mental health), short- and long-term disability and life insurance

**The Role:** 
The role's objective is to strengthen alignment between Operations and the Commercial areas, making sure internal and external customers' expectations are met, as well as constantly improving efficiency & cost to achieve business financial commitments. 
 
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Manage and develop the SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) process across the business
* Ensure optimal communication among Commercial & Operations regarding demand and production commitments
* Develop and maintain updated Operational Capacity numbers, and timely detect capacity expansion needs
* Coordinator efforts to develop Operation's yearly budgets (AOP) and forecast updates
* Work closely with global Commercial Demand stakeholders (sales, marketing, R&D), Procurement, Animal Production and Logistics to align Operation's resources to demand

role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Operations & Production Management**

* Develop and maintain manufacturing operations business plans encompassing program requirements, labor hours, cycle times, production costs, and facility image.
* Coordinate production, distribution, warehousing, and sales activities in alignment with policies and procedures established by organizational leadership.
* Maintain operational visibility across all production functions, proactively identifying systemic quality or production issues and directing supervisory teams to resolve them before they escalate.
* Review production costs, product quality, and operational reports; direct the resolution of manufacturing and maintenance problems to minimize costs and prevent delays.
* Develop plans for efficient utilization of materials, machines, and personnel.
* Coordinate manufacturing activities with all organizational functions and suppliers to optimize production and human resource utilization.

**Strategy & Planning**

* Develop capacity strategies, implementation plans, and programs to support the company's sales plan and growth objectives.
* Participate in annual planning, budget development, and strategic planning processes, including vision, mission, values, and desired culture.
* Provide input into product strategy, research, and development of new and emerging products.
* Review competitor operations and direct sales programs to identify and develop new markets.
* Continually develop and improve operational metrics that support company objectives without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Establish and maintain production and quality control standards; develop budget and cost controls.
* Ensure all established cost, quality, and delivery commitments are consistently met.
* Monitor all safety issues with the goal of identifying root causes and eliminating risk.
* Abide by and enforce all safety and quality system requirements; participate in contract review processes.
* Ensure all employees receive required training; develop new training processes as operational needs evolve.

**People & Organization**

* Determine responsibilities of assigned organizational units and staff positions to accomplish business objectives.
* Train and ensure all assigned employees are aware of and compliant with company, government, and customer policies, procedures, and regulations.
* Support and assist in the development of job planning processes and facility capacity strategies to meet growth demands.
* Provide clear feedback, promote effective communication across all levels, and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Facilities & Equipment**

* Provide guidance on manufacturing process planning, including personnel requirements, material needs, subcontract requirements, facility needs, and tooling and equipment.
* Support and assist strategies and programs for facility capacity, equipment maintenance, and long-term infrastructure planning.
* Perform administrative activities associated with effective shop operations management, including compiling, storing, and retrieving production data for reporting.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university required.
* Minimum of five years of progressive manufacturing or operations leadership experience; previous plant or operations management experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in a regulated or precision manufacturing environment is a significant advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

**Leadership & Business Acumen**

* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Strong understanding of business implications of operational decisions; demonstrated orientation toward profitability and strategic alignment.
* Ability to respond promptly to customer needs, solicit feedback, and consistently meet commitments.

**Analytical & Technical**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts including probability, statistical inference, plane and solid geometry, and trigonometry, and to apply them to practical production scenarios.
* Ability to solve complex practical problems involving multiple variables in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel; familiarity with ERP or MES systems preferred.

**Communication**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret business periodicals, technical procedures, and governmental regulations.
* Ability to write operational reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

This position operates in both an office and active manufacturing shop environment. The employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, and move throughout the facility. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

**Equal Opportunity Employment**

ARCH Cutting Tools is an Equal Opportunity Employer and wholeheartedly supports diversity in the workplace as a foundational premise for business success. All employees are employed on an at-will basis. This job description is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of duties. Employees may be required to perform additional job-related tasks as assigned by authorized personnel. All duties and responsibilities described herein are considered essential job functions and are subject to reasonable modification to accommodate individuals with disabilities

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

role.title: Operations Director
role.description:
**Build Your Career. Lead With Precision.**

Nammo Perry is a center of excellence for the design, development and production of munitions and pyrotechnic products for the U.S. Department of Defense. Nammo employees working at the Florida site manufacture all types of 40mm low and high velocity ammunition; pyrotechnic marking; signaling and tactical illumination devices; battlefield effects training simulators; demolition charges; hand grenade fuzes; and other ammunition components. Additionally, they provide load, assemble, and pack (LAP) services for large caliber direct-fire ammunition.

The **Director of Operations** provides strategic and operational leadership for manufacturing, energetic material processing, maintenance, and facilities functions across the Nammo Perry facility. Reporting directly to the Site President/General Manager this position is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and reliable operations while supporting organizational growth production readiness and long-term business objectives.

The Director of Operations leads a multidisciplinary organization through direct-report managers responsible for Energetic Operations, Production Operations, Maintenance, and Facilities. These functions collectively support the site's manufacturing capabilities, critical infrastructure, equipment reliability, and operational continuity. The Director of Operations is expected to establish clear operational priorities, develop strong management teams, drive accountability, and foster a culture of continuous improvement grounded in Nammo’s core values of Dedication, Care, and Precision.

**Unique Benefits Designed with Care:**

* Monday - Thursday work week working 10-hour days
* Relocation assistance provided
* 401(K) with a 6% company match
* 100% Employer-Paid Employee Only Medical Plan Option
* Employer Health Saving Account Contributions
* Two week’s vacation, one-week sick pay, and nine paid holidays

**What You’ll Do: Precision in Action**

**Strategic Operations Leadership**

* Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with organizational objectives, production requirements, and long-term business growth.
* Provide leadership and accountability across manufacturing, energetic operations, maintenance, and facilities ensuring effective coordination and operational performance.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery costs, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with site leadership to evaluate operational priorities, resource allocation, capital investments, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Manufacturing and Energetic Operations**

* Oversee production operations across Large Caliber Systems and Aerospace Propulsion business units ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant manufacturing activities.
* Provide strategic oversight of energetic material blending and processing operations, ensuring alignment with production requirements and established safety standards.
* Drive manufacturing performance through effective capacity planning workforce utilization production scheduling and operational discipline.
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, supply chain, and program management to support customer commitments, resolve operational challenges, and improve manufacturing capabilities.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels and resource planning to meet programmatic needs while maintaining cost initiatives.
* Establish leader standard work directives to guide day-to-day operations.

**Maintenance and Facilities Management**

* Provide strategic oversight of maintenance operations including electrical and control systems, machining, mechanical maintenance, and equipment reliability.
* Lead facilities management functions supporting site infrastructure, facilities engineering, building systems, preventative maintenance, and essential site services.
* Establish and deconflict priorities for preventative maintenance, equipment availability, infrastructure improvements, and operational continuity.
* Support capital improvements, equipment upgrades, and facility investments necessary to sustain and expand manufacturing operations.

**Safety, Quality and Regulatory Compliance**

* Champion a safety-first culture ensuring operational adherence to applicable environmental health, explosive safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Quality to maintain process discipline, product conformity, risk management, and compliance with established management systems.
* Drive accountability for identifying and addressing operational risks, safety concerns, non-conformances, and continuous improvement opportunities.

**Financial Performance and People Leadership**

* Develop and manage operational budgets, labor resources, capital expenditures, and cost improvement initiatives.
* Lead, coach, and develop direct-report managers while establishing clear expectations for performance, accountability, and organizational effectiveness.Partner with People and Culture on workforce planning, succession planning, leadership development, and employee engagement.

**What Dedicated Teammates Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration or related field. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing operations or industrial leadership.
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience including demonstrated success leading managers or multidisciplinary operational teams.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, energetic materials, chemical processing, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex manufacturing operations, develop operational strategies, manage budgets, and drive performance improvements.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, industrial safety, equipment reliability, and operational excellence principles.
* Proven leadership, communication, problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

*Preferred Qualification:*

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management or related discipline.
* Direct experience in defense manufacturing, energetic material processing, ammunition production, or aerospace propulsion.
* Experience overseeing multiple operational functions including production, maintenance, facilities, and engineering support.
* Familiarity with explosive safety requirements and defense industry regulations.
* Experience with ISO 9001 and AS9100, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or comparable operational excellence methodologies.

*Leadership Competencies*

* Aligns operational capabilities and resources with business objectives and long-term growth.
* Drives performance improvements in safety, quality, delivery cost, and reliability.
* Build strong management teams and promotes accountability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Demonstrate sound judgment, hazard awareness, and commitment to disciplined operations,
* Build effective partnerships across departments and business units
* Leads teams through expansion, organizational growth, and evolving operational requirements.

**Our Woking Conditions and Requirements**

* This position operates in both office and industrial manufacturing environments and requires regular interaction with production areas, maintenance, operations, and facility infrastructure.
* The role may involve prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and walking, including navigating manufacturing facilities and operational work areas.
* Employees must comply with applicable safety, security, and environmental requirements including the use of required personal protective equipment (PPE) when entering designated areas.
* The position may require occasional domestic or international travel and flexibility to support operational needs outside standard business hours.
* Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

*Our values are the fundamental principles guiding the way we do business and interact with stakeholders.*

***DEDICATION:*** *We are enthusiastic and creative, always searching for the best solutions.* 
***PRECISION:*** *We are reliable and accurate in our technology, processes and business.* 
***CARE:*** *We are inclusive and open-minded, always encouraging team spirit and cooperation.*

*Nammo and its subsidiaries provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

**\*\*Note\*\*: Due to US Export Control laws and regulations; applicants selected for employment must show proof of a U.S. Person status before employment may begin.**
