role.title: Supply Chain & Production Director
role.description:
**Supply Chain & Production Director**

**Bil-Jax, Inc.**

**Location:** Archbold, Ohio (On-Site)

Note: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

 

**Bil-Jax, Inc., a member of the Haulotte Group, is seeking an experienced Supply Chain & Production Director to lead manufacturing and supply chain operations at our Archbold, Ohio facility.** Reporting directly to the Vice President & General Manager, this key leadership role is responsible for manufacturing, procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP). The successful candidate will lead a multi-year factory modernization initiative focused on automation, operational excellence, and scalable growth while partnering with production, engineering, sourcing, and commercial teams to improve productivity, delivery performance, and profitability across the business.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

**Factory Modernization & Automation**

* Lead the development and execution of a long-term automation strategy that improves manufacturing efficiency, increases throughput, and reduces overall production costs.
* Manage capital investment projects from concept through implementation, including equipment selection, vendor management, installation, commissioning, and performance validation.
* Partner with Engineering and IT teams to integrate new manufacturing technologies and digital solutions that improve visibility, reporting, and operational decision-making.

 

**Production Planning & Operational Excellence**

* Optimize production scheduling and resource allocation across a complex manufacturing environment with approximately 2,000 active SKUs while maintaining high levels of quality, efficiency, and on-time delivery.
* Develop and implement processes that improve the flow of work-in-process material and eliminate bottlenecks between fabrication, welding, painting, and assembly operations.
* Lead the monthly Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process in collaboration with cross-functional leaders to align customer demand, production capacity, inventory levels, and business objectives.

 

**Supply Chain & Procurement Leadership**

* Develop sourcing strategies for steel, purchased components, and other critical materials while building strong supplier partnerships and mitigating supply chain risk.
* Establish inventory management practices that improve inventory accuracy, increase inventory turns, and maintain service levels required to support customers and production operations.
* Oversee warehousing, inbound logistics, and outbound freight activities to ensure efficient material flow and cost-effective distribution.

 

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Drive organizational change by leading the transition toward a more automated and technically advanced manufacturing environment while developing and upskilling existing team members.
* Provide leadership and direction to Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Production Supervisors, and other operational teams while working collaboratively with Maintenance, Safety, Shipping, and Site Leadership.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement by ensuring compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

 

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience within a manufacturing environment, including at least 5 years in a senior operations leadership role such as Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or Director of Operations.
* Demonstrated success within structural steel fabrication, sheet metal fabrication, machining, heavy equipment manufacturing, or a related industrial environment.
* Proven experience implementing manufacturing automation, robotics, or automated production cells.
* Experience leading operations within a manufacturing organization ranging from approximately $30M to $100M in annual revenue.
* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related field.

 

**Preferred Skills**

* Deep understanding of metal fabrication, welding, machining, and assembly processes.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong financial and business acumen with experience managing operational budgets and capital expenditures.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems in a manufacturing environment, preferably Epicor.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and change management skills.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Grow boldly with Pretium and Lead a High-Performing Manufacturing Operation and Drive Operational Excellence!**

Are you a proven manufacturing leader with a passion for developing teams, improving performance, and delivering exceptional results? **Pretium Packaging** is seeking an experienced **Plant Manager** in **Salt Lake City, Utah** to lead our manufacturing facility and take ownership of safety, quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

This is a highly visible leadership role with full responsibility for plant operations, financial performance, and continuous improvement initiatives. If you thrive in a **fast-paced manufacturing environment** and enjoy building high-performing teams while driving operational excellence, we'd like to hear from you.

**Who We Are:**

Pretium Packaging, founded in 1992, is a leading supplier of injection-blow molded plastic containers, known for delivering superior quality, value, and customer service. With 21 manufacturing locations across North America, we provide innovative, high-performance packaging solutions to a diverse portfolio of brand owners in the U.S. and Canada.

**What You'll Do**

As Plant Manager, you will oversee all aspects of plant operations, including production, quality, maintenance, materials management, warehousing, and shipping. You will provide strategic leadership to the site while ensuring the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of the facility.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop a cross-functional leadership team including Production, Quality, Process Engineering, Maintenance, and Shipping.
* Drive a culture of safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Manage all plant operations to ensure customer orders are produced and shipped on time while meeting quality standards.
* Own plant financial performance with full P&L responsibility, including budgeting, cost control, and profitability improvement initiatives.
* Develop staffing, production, scheduling, and material plans to support business objectives.
* Monitor production performance and proactively resolve operational challenges related to equipment, materials, tooling, and processes.
* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, efficiency, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Establish and implement operating procedures, performance metrics, and reporting systems to drive accountability and results.
* Evaluate and recommend capital investments, equipment upgrades, and process improvements.
* Collaborate with commercial, engineering, and product development teams to support new products and customer growth opportunities.
* Maintain compliance with OSHA, EPA, ISO, GMP, and all applicable regulatory requirements.
* Build strong relationships with customers and ensure a customer-focused approach throughout the organization.
* Partner closely with Human Resources on talent development, employee engagement, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead plant meetings and communication efforts related to safety, quality, maintenance, production, and continuous improvement.

**What We're Looking For:**

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7–10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Experience leading large teams in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong understanding of production operations, quality systems, maintenance, materials management, and supply chain processes.
* Proven experience managing budgets, controlling costs, and driving operational profitability.
* Strong project management, planning, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Ability to travel as needed.
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience within the plastics, packaging, or related manufacturing industries.
* Experience with Oracle or other ERP systems.
* Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Six Sigma, or similar operational excellence experience.
* Experience in ISO and GMP-regulated environments.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

You are a hands-on leader who can balance strategic thinking with daily operational execution. You know how to develop people, solve complex manufacturing challenges, and create a culture where safety, quality, and performance thrive.

**What You'll Bring:**

* Exceptional leadership and team-building skills
* Strong financial and business acumen
* Excellent communication and influencing abilities
* Data-driven decision-making capabilities
* A passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence
* A customer-first mindset
* The ability to lead through change and deliver results

**Why Join Pretium?**

At Pretium Packaging, we manufacture rigid plastic containers for some of the most recognized brands in the marketplace. Our plants operate with a strong emphasis on safety, performance, and continuous improvement.

This is an opportunity to step into a leadership role where your impact will be visible, measurable, and valued***. If you’re energized by continuous improvement, team development, and running a plant like it’s your own business — we want to talk with you.***

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

**Duties**

role.title: PLANT MANAGER
role.description:
Position Summary: Oversees the efficient storage, transportation, and distribution of goods. The ideal candidate will manage logistics processes, ensure timely delivery of products, and optimize operations to meet customer demands and organizational goals. This role requires strong leadership skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate across teams.

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Plan, organize, and manage the distribution of goods, ensuring products are delivered on time and in excellent condition.
* Develop and implement efficient logistics strategies to optimize transportation and minimize costs.
* Manage warehouse operations, including inventory control, storage, and distribution processes.
* Monitor and analyze distribution metrics and KPIs to improve overall performance and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with suppliers, vendors, and customers to resolve any issues related to shipping, delivery, or inventory.
* Oversee and ensure compliance with health, safety, and regulatory requirements in all distribution processes.
* Negotiate contracts with transportation providers and other third-party logistics services.
* Train, supervise, and evaluate the performance of distribution and warehouse staff.
* Develop contingency plans to address disruptions in the supply chain or unexpected challenges.
* Maintain accurate records of shipments, inventory, and logistics operations for reporting purposes.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration, or a related field is preferred.

* Proven experience as a Distribution Manager, Logistics Manager, or in a similar role.
* Certification in logistics or supply chain management.
* Experience in managing international logistics and customs compliance.

**Job Skills:**

* Strong understanding of supply chain, warehouse, and distribution processes.
* Proficiency in logistics software and inventory management systems.
* Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.
* Strong leadership and communication abilities.
* Knowledge of applicable regulations, safety standards, and best practices in logistics and transportation.

* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Education:**

* High School diploma or GED is required
* Bachelor's degree is preferred

**Physical Requirements:**

* Occasional travel to meet with suppliers, vendors, and clients
* Operates in both office and warehouse settings

**Special Requirements:**

* OSHA 30 certification
* Valid Driver's License

role.title: Multi-Site Plant Manager
role.description:
### **Description**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled **Plant Manager** to oversee and manage all aspects of multi-site plant operations, ensuring efficient production, high-quality standards, and a safe working environment. 
 
The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, proven experience in managing manufacturing plants, and a thorough understanding of operational strategies, including safety, budgeting, and human resource management. The Plant Manager will also be responsible for ensuring production goals are met, maintaining plant facilities, and continuously improving processes to maximize efficiency

### **How You Will Help**

 

* Lead and manage daily operations of the manufacturing plant to meet production schedules, ensure product quality, and achieve on-time delivery.
* Partner with EHS to ensure safety, health, and environmental regulations, including local, state, and federal safety standards.
* Develop and implement strategic plans for operational efficiency, resource allocation, and process improvements.
* Manage plant budgets and financial statements, ensuring cost-effective operations while meeting financial goals.
* Maintain and upgrade plant facilities and equipment, ensuring they are in optimal working condition; oversee necessary repairs, replacements, and adjustments.
* Monitor production activities, ensuring adherence to quality standards and safety protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, and supply chain teams to optimize production processes and implement lean manufacturing principles.
* Create and foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement, leading by example and building strong relationships with team members.
* Implement and monitor inventory management strategies, ensuring proper material flow and minimizing waste.
* Develop, mentor, and manage staff, providing training and development opportunities to enhance skills and performance.
* Ensure timely communication and coordination between departments to meet production targets and business objectives.
* Identify and resolve operational issues, making data-driven decisions to improve plant efficiency and productivity.
* Perform other duties as assigned by senior management
* Travel up to 10% domestically, including quarterly visits to company facilities in Pennsylvania and Texas to support project execution and cross-functional collaboration.

 

### **What You Will Bring**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience working in a custom manufacturing environment, including knowledge of assembly, fabrication, welding, and machining processes
* A minimum of 10 years of experience in plant operations, with at least 5 years in a management role.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, strategic planning, and financial statements.
* Strong leadership abilities with proven experience in team building, decision-making, and people management.
* In-depth knowledge of manufacturing processes, equipment, and safety standards.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing, supply chain management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA or advanced degree in a related field.
* Certification or experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or supply chain management.
* Working knowledge of industry codes and standards, including TOSHA and other health and safety regulations.

 

### **About Reliable Safety and Flow Corporation**

Bringing together more than 175 years of innovation, quality, and customer commitment under one name and one promise.

The company was forged in 1850, as American industry was being connected by pipe, valves, fittings, and the skilled people who knew how to put them in the right place. More than 175 years later, that heritage lives in ASC Engineered Solutions, a comprehensive pipe preparation, joining, hanging and flow-management portfolio supporting the people who build and maintain commercial buildings, industrial facilities, infrastructure, and critical systems. A house of brands, Anvil, Gruvlok, Sharpe, SCI, and ABZ, unified as ASC in 2019, and the portfolio has grown in the years since.

In 1920, Reliable Automatic Sprinkler started doing one thing exceptionally well: building the fire safety systems that protect people and property. Sprinklers, valves, and accessories, made in the United States. More than a century later, the discipline has not changed. A century of American-made fire protection products, with multi-generational customer relationships and multi-decade specifications. A century of protecting what matters the most.

**Two legacies. One Future.**

\*Reliable Safety and Flow Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.\*

role.description:
**Description:** 
**Job Title:** Plant Operations Director
 
 
**Job Type:** Full-time
 
 
Plant Operations Director will be responsible for ensuring that the facility maintenance runs smoothly and efficiently, while maintaining a safe and productive work environment.
 
 
**Responsibilities:** 
Develop and implement operational policies and procedures to ensure the facility runs efficiently and effectively.
 
 
Oversee the day-to-day operations of the facility, including production, maintenance, quality control, and safety.
 
 
Manage and lead a team of staff to ensure that production targets are met.
 
 
Ensure that the facility meets all regulatory requirements and standards for safety, quality, and environmental compliance.
 
 
Develop and implement strategies to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and increase productivity.
 
 
Develop and maintain relationships with suppliers and vendors to ensure that the facility has the necessary resources to operate effectively.
 
 
**Requirements:** 
**Requirements:** 
High school diploma or GED required or equivalent related work experience.
 
 
Minimum of three (3) years related experience.
 
 
One (1) to two (2) years management/supervisory experience required.
 
 
Practical knowledge of day-to-day maintenance and facility physical plant upkeep.
 
 
**Ability to operate various pieces of equipment to include:** lawn mower, weed eater, blower, edger, pressure washer, chainsaw, etc.
 
 
Effective verbal and written English communication skills.
 
 
Highest level of professionalism with the ability to maintain confidentiality.
 
 
Ability to communicate at all levels of organization and work well within a team environment in support of company objectives.
 
 
Customer service oriented with the ability to work well under pressure.
 
 
**Physical and Sensory Requirements:** 
**Moderate physical activity:** 
Push, pull, move, and/or lift a minimum of seventy five (75) pounds to a minimum height of three (3) feet and be able to push, pull, move, and/or carry such weight a minimum distance of fifty (50) feet.
 
 
Standing and/or walking for more than four (4) hours per day.
 
 
Bending and/or stooping for more than one (1) hour at a time.
 
 
Exposure to sound of mowers and electrical equipment.

role.description:
**Career Area:**

Manufacturing

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Role Definition**

The **Senior Manager Production** position manages the day-to-day operations of all shifts of a large facility with multiple Value Streams within the Integrated Drivetrain Energy Solutions (IDES) division. This role will lead from 5-8 Production Managers with up to 180+ production employees. Additionally, the role will lead 1-2 managers focused on the Modern Manufacturing and Lean Capability's within the Assembly & Test Operations of Building KK and H.

**What you will do**

* Managing staffing, development, and performance management programs for operations staff; managing, motivating, and developing management team.
* Overseeing operations activities, ensuring that safety, and schedules and performance requirements are met and system resources are used effectively.
* Driving improvements for overall operations performance and implementing production safety, cost, and quality control mechanisms.
* Ensures the compliance of all regulatory guidelines and forges a safe and sound manufacturing environment.
* Focused on Operational Excellence leveraging the Modern Manufacturing Capabilities and focus on Lean.
* Develop and Champion an AI strategy for Front Line Leaders tools and complex business challenges.

**Degree Requirement**

* Bachelor’s degree OR minimum of 8 years highly relevant manufacturing experience (Manufacturing, Supply Chain/Purchasing, Engineering, Quality) in lieu of degree is desired.

**What you must have**

* **Production Training**: Knowledge of approaches, tools and techniques for delivering formal and informal training on the safe and efficient operation of production machinery; ability to conduct effective formal and situation-specific training.
* **Problem Solving**: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
* **Influencing**: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.
* **Flexibility and Adaptability**: Knowledge of successful approaches and techniques for dealing with change; ability to adapt to a changing environment and be comfortable with change.
* **Performance Management**: Knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational performance.
* **Analytical Thinking**: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
* **Planning and Organizing**: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.
* **Effective Communications**: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

**Top candidates will also have**

* Lean Deployment/Lean Leadership experience
* Experience leading other Supervisors
* Cross-functional experience and multi-facility/product experience
* 6 Sigma, Program Management, and Caterpillar Production System (CPS) experience

**Additional Information**

* This position will close at 11:59 p.m. on 11/23/2026.
* This position will be located onsite 5 days a week in East Peoria, IL (Building KK).
* Relocation assistance (domestic) is available for this position
* Sponsorship is **NOT** available
* This position may require less than 10% travel

**Final details**

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

$147,760.00 - $221,640.00

**Benefits:**

Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits.

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits\*
* Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)\*

* Disability benefits

* These benefits also apply to part-time employees

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Relocation is available for this position.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

November 12, 2026 - November 23, 2026

role.title: Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations
role.description:
**Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations leads the development, execution, and growth of SANY America’s component remanufacturing and full-machine refurbishment operations. This position oversees shop performance, safety, quality, cost, inventory, suppliers, and dealer support while building a scalable, profitable operation that improves machine uptime and lifecycle value.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase their market share.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Business Strategy & Operations**

* Develop and execute the U.S. remanufacturing and refurbishment roadmap, including future certified refurbished equipment programs.

* Direct production planning, technician utilization, shop capacity, workflows, turnaround times, and performance standards.

* Build and coach technical and operations teams, establishing clear ownership, training, and accountability.

**Remanufacturing & Refurbishment**

* Standardize machine inspection, teardown, repair, component replacement, testing, cosmetic restoration, and final acceptance.

* Expand viable remanufacturing offerings for engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electronics, and other high-value assemblies.

* Establish documented repair procedures, quality gates, testing standards, failure analysis, and corrective actions.

**Financial & Inventory Management**

* Own operating budgets, rebuild costs, labor standards, margin performance, scrap reduction, and repair-versus-replace decisions.

* Develop core return, valuation, salvage, used-component, and reman inventory controls to improve recovery and reduce working capital.

* Track operational and financial KPIs, including cycle time, capacity, first-pass quality, revenue, and profitability.

**Suppliers, Dealers & Cross-Functional Support**

* Manage outside rebuild suppliers and technical partners against quality, cost, warranty, and lead-time expectations.

* Partner with Service, Parts, Warranty, Product, Sales, Finance, and dealers to support customer uptime and refurbishment opportunities.

* Support certified refurbished equipment programs through condition grading, inspection documentation, and warranty coordination.

**Safety & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain a safe, organized, compliant shop with appropriate PPE, equipment controls, and safe work practices.

* Implement Lean, 5S, standard work, visual management, root cause analysis, and ongoing process improvements.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

* 12+ years of progressive experience in remanufacturing, refurbishment, heavy equipment, automotive, industrial manufacturing, service operations, or a related field.

* 6+ years of direct people-management or operations-leadership experience.

* Strong understanding of engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electrical systems, and heavy equipment troubleshooting.

* Proven ability to manage production, quality, inventory, capacity, costs, KPIs, and financial performance.

* Strong communication, problem-solving, cross-functional leadership, and analytical skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience launching or expanding remanufacturing, machine rebuild, refurbishment, or certified pre-owned operations.

* Construction or off-highway equipment experience, including supplier and third-party rebuild partner management.

* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, ERP, inventory, service, and warranty system experience.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

**OFFICE + OPERATIONS WORK ENVIRONMENT**

This role is primarily office-based with regular work in remanufacturing, refurbishment, and equipment service areas. Duties may involve extended computer use, standing, walking, and observing or inspecting heavy machinery, tools, and shop operations. Exposure to noise, moving equipment, and varying temperatures may occur. Required personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel to SANY facilities, suppliers, dealers, and customer sites as business needs require.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience.

* Medical, dental, and vision

* Paid Time Off

* 401(k) savings plans

* Health Savings Account (HSA)

* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

* Company paid STD and LTD benefits

* Life Insurance

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

SANY America is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local law.

**DRUG AND ALCOHOL-FREE WORKPLACE NOTICE**

SANY America is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a drug and alcohol-free workplace consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Applicants may be required to complete pre-employment screenings, including drug and/or alcohol testing, as a condition of employment where permitted by applicable law. Testing requirements, employment practices, and workplace policies may vary based on work location, position responsibilities, business necessity, workplace safety considerations, customer requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.

 

SANY America complies with applicable federal, state, and local laws relating to marijuana/cannabis use, including applicable medical and recreational marijuana laws where permitted. However, applicants and employees are prohibited from being impaired or under the influence of alcohol, illegal drugs, or other prohibited substances while working, operating Company vehicles or equipment, performing safety sensitive duties, conducting Company business, or while on Company property, consistent with applicable law.

 

Certain positions may be designated as safety sensitive or subject to additional regulatory, customer, contractual, operational, or workplace safety requirements and may require participation in pre-employment, random, reasonable suspicion, post-accident, return to duty, follow up, or other drug and/or alcohol testing programs in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

role.title: Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance
role.description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team:**

**The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people.**

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction. We encourage anyone that wants to join us in our mission to apply.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance is responsible for new hire training, ongoing learning, knowledge management, and quality assurance across DJCS globally. You will report to the Vice President of Customer Support Operations and be based in our New Jersey office.

**You Will**

* Own and modernize curricula across DJCS, defining content, sequence, timing, delivery methods, and readiness standards to shorten time to proficiency and support development beyond initial onboarding. Coordinate Training-led modules and specialist instruction from hiring teams within the agreed plan.
* Lead the expansion of web-based, self-paced learning for onboarding and ongoing uptraining, combining it with live instruction, systems practice, and shadowing where appropriate.
* Improve knowledge accuracy, usability, adoption, and maintenance, and prepare the team, content, and working practices for AI-enabled tools.
* Lead the adoption and validation of automated quality management (AQM) across teams and contact types, establish standards for coaching and performance scoring, and redeploy human QA toward targeted investigation and improvement.
* Develop staff capabilities and close Consumer/B2B knowledge gaps through cross-training and shared responsibilities, identifying where tools or specialist support are needed.
* Manage training capacity and delivery, oversee curriculum standards and trainer quality across outsourcing partners, and extend product training and onboarding capability beyond DJCS.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, agree priorities and delivery commitments, and communicate progress and tradeoffs. Measure both program results and stakeholder feedback to ensure the team delivers effective support and a reliable partnership.

**Who you Are**

* You set a clear direction, challenge established approaches, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
* You are resourceful and persistent, working through obstacles and balancing change with daily operational demands.
* You develop people and deliver through others, setting clear expectations, building skills, and getting into the details when needed.
* You build stakeholder trust through responsiveness, honest communication, and follow-through.
* You use data, employee and stakeholder feedback, and testing to set priorities, make decisions, and measure results.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience managing a training or related performance improvement team in a contact center environment, including developing staff capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading changes to onboarding or ongoing learning, with measurable improvements in proficiency, productivity, and learning effectiveness.
* Experience leading blended learning development and delivery, including self-paced digital content, through internal teams or external specialists.
* Experience using quality evaluation or interaction analytics to identify performance gaps and measure the results of improvement initiatives.
* Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives against agreed commitments, supported by examples of effective stakeholder partnerships.
* Ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.
* Experience implementing or expanding AQM (preferred).
* Experience managing knowledge resources or implementing AI-enabled learning, knowledge, or employee-support tools (preferred).
* Experience selecting or managing learning technology, external specialists, or outsourced training and QA programs (preferred).

**Our Benefits**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Plans
* Paid Time Off
* Retirement Plans
* Comprehensive Insurance Plans
* Education Benefits
* Family Care Benefits
* Commuter Transit Program
* Subscription Discounts
* Employee Referral Program

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Role Summary**

Parklane is opening a brand-new manufacturing facility in Michigan, and we are looking for a Plant Manager to work with us to build it from the ground up. As the senior leader on site, you will have accountability for the plant: safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and culture. You will lead a team of up to 150 employees and be supported by Parklane’s shared services groups, including Engineering, Supply Chain, Human Resources, and Finance, so you can focus on running a safe, high-performing operation and setting the standard for how Parklane operates in Michigan.

**Key Responsibilities**

Site Leadership & Start-Up

* Own the overall performance of the Michigan facility, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and cost
* Lead the ramp-up of the new site, establishing operating rhythms, processes, and standards aligned with Parklane’s practices
* Develop and execute site plans and budgets in partnership with Finance and senior leadership
* Serve as the face of Parklane in the local community, with customers, vendors, and regulators

Operations & Production

* Direct day-to-day manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, and shipping activities to meet customer commitments
* Work with production scheduling and Supply Chain to balance capacity, labor, and material availability
* Drive continuous improvement and lean practices to improve throughput, reduce waste, and control cost
* Track and report on site KPIs, and act quickly on gaps to plan

Safety, Quality & Compliance

* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements
* Partner with QHSE to implement and sustain Parklane’s quality management system and drive corrective actions to closure
* Maintain a clean, organized, audit-ready facility and well-maintained equipment

People Leadership

* Recruit, develop, and lead plant leaders, supervisors, and front-line teams, building a strong bench for a growing site
* Partner with Human Resources on hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and engagement
* Set clear expectations, coach for accountability, and recognize results in line with Parklane’s core values
* Build a positive, inclusive culture where employees feel safe, respected, and invested in the site’s success

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Engineering on product design, manufacturability, and technical issues
* Partner with Supply Chain on procurement, inventory, logistics, and supplier performance
* Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, cost control, and financial reporting
* Leverage shared services across the organization to support the site efficiently, and provide feedback to continuously improve that support

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 8+ years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including 3+ years in a plant management or senior site leadership role
* Proven experience leading a workforce of 100+ in a manufacturing or fabrication environment
* Experience launching, expanding, or transforming a facility is a strong asset
* Strong working knowledge of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and quality systems (ISO 9001 exposure preferred)
* Solid understanding of OSHA and workplace safety, environmental, and employment regulations in the U.S.
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L awareness, and cost management
* Experience with ERP systems and data-driven performance management (D365 an asset)
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to influence across a matrixed organization
* Hands-on, accountable, and comfortable building structure in a fast-paced, evolving environment

**About Parklane**

As one of North America’s leading providers of turnkey mechanical noise control and VIRS solutions, Parklane is on a constant search for top industry talent. Every day we help clients with their sound attenuation and vibration challenges. We do it by leveraging an agile approach to engineering, product manufacturing and implementation.

As an organization, we live and breathe our core values:

1. Challenge Accepted

2. Work Hard & Play Hard

3. Share the Wins & Own the Losses, and

4. Build Together, Grow Together

By sharing ideas and supporting each other at every turn, we’ve built a reputation both for service excellence and the strength of our workplace culture. Put simply, our team is committed to doing whatever it takes to help our customers succeed—and that’s why we need professionals with the experience and expertise to solve complex problems.

Pay: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Job Overview**

As an **Operations Director**, you’ll guide business operations, align teams around strategic priorities, and turn performance insights into practical action. You’ll oversee operational and financial management, support sales and business development, and build strong partnerships across executive and frontline teams. This role calls for clear communication, sound judgment, and a hands-on approach to improving how work gets done.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead operations management, strategic planning, and project management to advance business goals.
* Oversee profit and loss (P&L) performance, financial management, and profit and loss analysis; use Excel data analysis to inform decisions.
* Direct team management and executive-level team management, including supervision, team leadership, and team development.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and apply lean management principles to strengthen operational performance.
* Support sales, business development, and customer service through coordinated, data-driven decision making.

**Your impact:** By improving processes and aligning teams around clear priorities, you help employees work effectively and customers receive consistent service.

**Skills**

* Essential: Leadership, management, business management, operations management, operational management, strategic management, and strategic planning.
* Essential: Team management, team leadership, supervising experience, team development, and managerial communication.
* Essential: Financial management, P&L oversight, profit and loss analysis, and Excel data analysis.
* Essential: Project management, process improvement, and data-driven decision making.
* Preferred: Experience supporting sales, business development, customer service, and lean management.

Pay: $155,600.00 - $207,100.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Life insurance

role.title: Director of Regional Operations
role.description:
**About Us**

Born in 1993, Excelsia Injury Care’s mission is to restore quality of life through patient-centric care and support for those injured in motor vehicle or work-related accidents. With over 100 patient care centers across the Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, and Mountain West regions, our vision is to be the leading provider of injury care, setting the standard for excellence in every community we serve and expanding access to high-quality care nationwide.

At Excelsia, we deliver the full continuum of outpatient care within one seamless, connected system. Our diverse team of medical specialists offers a wide range of treatment services, covering medical, orthopedics, neurology, rehabilitation, diagnostic, and surgical. We are committed to supporting patients through personalized support, detailed documentation, and outcome-oriented care coordination to make the recovery process easier. With Excelsia, patients are never far from the care they need—with the compassion they deserve.

Founded on the values of respect and trustworthiness, we are committed to delivering services that adhere to the highest legal, regulatory, and ethical standards. As responsible corporate citizens, we integrate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations into our business practices, ensuring that we positively impact the healthcare companies we serve, our employees, and the communities we reach.

**\*\*\*Please know this position requires 100% travel throughout our Greater Baltimore Market\*\*\***

**Job Duties**

* Leads their respective regions to ensure smooth operation of medical offices.
* Participate in the coordination of logistics (with the support of the Executive Assistant) for all provider and manager meetings.
* Act as a liaison between Compliance, BSO staff, and providers to ensure that audits and retraining are completed (e.g., dictation).
* Investigate patient complaints that are reported to Compliance related to operational issues.
* Assists in ensuring that operations tasks related to integrations are completed prior to the required milestone dates.
* Manages a variety of projects to be assigned by the market president.
* Hire, train, and provide development opportunities for nonclinical staff of medical offices.
* Act as an escalation point for clinical office managers and providers.
* Provide their teams with the data needed to have line of sight into the overall operational health of their assigned offices.
* Weekly onsite presence at all locations.
* Ensures financial and operational objectives of offices are realized.
* Ensure that each member within their region is performing all duties in his or her job description.
* Implement protocols identified by Compliant related to HIPAA, regulations, and company processes.
* Improve office processes and manage the implementations.
* Ensure financial and operational objectives of offices are realized.
* Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) daily and react to needs.
* Provide regular reporting in accordance with Excelsia standards.
* Conducts regularly scheduled one-on-one meetings with direct reports to provide support, address challenges, and foster professional growth.

* Leads recurring team meetings and ensures timely completion of annual performance reviews, delivering constructive feedback to support individual and team development.
* Lead with integrity by upholding our core values and ensuring that all operations align with legal, regulatory, and ethical standards. Foster a culture of corporate responsibility by incorporating Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles into business practices, positively impacting the patients we serve, our employees, and the communities we reach.
* Perform other duties and assignments as directed and/or as necessary.

##### **Minimum Requirements**

* High school Graduate or GED equivalent
* Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred
* Knowledge of advanced work-related subjects
* Successful completion of corporate orientation program
* Ongoing related continuing education participation
* Five or more years in a related supervisory capacity
* 1-2 years of medical experience in an administrative/legal/ physician office setting
* Previous computer skills to include (data entry, word perfect, etc.)

##### **Additional Skills/Competencies**

* Ability to maintain a strong confidentiality profile
* Ability to project a strong corporate image
* Ability to recognize emergency medical and non-medical situations
* Ability to identify and resolve customer relation problems
* Ability to identify and resolve clinical problems.
* Ability to remain calm in emergency situations
* Ability to form interpersonal relationships (i.e., establish rapport with others)
* Ability to manage time effectively by setting priorities
* Ability to anticipate problems before they arise.
* Ability to anticipate patient/physician/corporate needs
* Mathematical ability to perform required calculations.

##### **Physical/Mental Requirements**

* Ability to work flexible hours as required by job demands.
* May include some exposure to infection and injury
* Manual dexterity hand/eye coordination
* Able to lift a minimum of 10 pounds independently
* Able to perform frequent work with hand/wrist movement
* Prolonged sitting for up to 60% of time.

##### **Motor Vehicle Report Monitoring**

In the event Employee does not maintain the insurance coverage required under this Policy & Procedure, and/or does not maintain a valid license to operate a motor vehicle, that Employee shall not be eligible for mileage reimbursement and is barred from operating any motor vehicle in furtherance of Company business. Operating a motor vehicle in furtherance of Company business without a valid state-issued driver’s license to do so and/or maintain insurance of the type and amounts set forth herein shall subject the Employee to immediate disciplinary action up to and including termination.

**Why work for Excelsia Injury Care? We offer a competitive salary, a great and stable work environment as well as amazing benefit package! Offered Benefits include:**

* Medical, Dental and Vision plans through CareFirst with PPO And HSA options available the first of the month after your hire date.
* Rich leave benefits including PTO that is accrued starting on your first day of work, 8 company-recognized paid holidays plus a floating holiday, and 5 days of sick leave each calendar year.
* Employee Assistance Program, Earned Wage Access, and Employee Assistance Fund.
* Discounts on shopping and travel perks through WorkingAdvantage.
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match.
* Paid training opportunities and Education Assistance Program.
* Employee Referral Bonus Program

**Diversity Statement**

Excelsia Injury Care is an equal opportunity employer. We commit to a policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, pregnancy or related medical conditions, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic predisposition, marital, civil union or partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

role.title: Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor – McDonald's
role.description:
Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor – McDonald's

**Company:** Sidor Ventures LLC dba McDonald's 
**Location:** Seminole County, Florida (Sanford, Oviedo, Winter Springs) 
**Position:** Full-Time | Multi-Unit Restaurant Leadership 
**Compensation:** Competitive base salary, performance-based bonus opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, including health insurance and a 401(k) with employer match.

**About Sidor Ventures**

Sidor Ventures is a growing McDonald's franchise organization operating four restaurants throughout Seminole County, Florida, and employing more than 200 team members.

We are building a high-performance organization centered on operational excellence, accountability, leadership development, and an exceptional customer experience.

As we continue expanding, we are seeking an exceptional, results-driven Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor to lead restaurant performance, develop our General Managers, and help drive the next phase of our organization's growth.

**This is an opportunity to play a significant leadership role in a growing franchise organization, work directly with ownership, and help shape the future of the business.**

**Position Overview**

The Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the operational, financial, and people performance of multiple McDonald's restaurants.

We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on leader who can develop high-performing General Managers, establish consistent operating standards, improve restaurant profitability, and build a strong leadership pipeline.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional operational knowledge with strong financial acumen, sound judgment, and a proven ability to lead through others.

This position works directly with ownership and will play a critical role in strengthening our existing restaurants while supporting future expansion.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership and operational oversight across multiple McDonald's restaurants.
* Ensure consistent execution of McDonald's brand standards, Quality, Service, and Cleanliness (QSC).
* Drive measurable improvements in service times, order accuracy, customer satisfaction, and overall restaurant performance.
* Conduct regular restaurant visits, operational assessments, and performance reviews.
* Identify operational challenges, develop corrective action plans, and ensure sustained improvement.
* Maintain strong food safety, workplace safety, and regulatory compliance standards.
* Establish consistent operating procedures and accountability across the organization.

**Financial Performance & Profitability**

* Take ownership of restaurant-level financial performance, profitability, and controllable expenses.
* Analyze restaurant P&Ls, sales trends, guest counts, labor performance, food costs, and operational metrics.
* Partner with General Managers to develop accurate sales forecasts, labor schedules, and operating budgets.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales growth, operational efficiency, and restaurant profitability.
* Establish clear performance objectives and hold restaurant leadership accountable for results.
* Monitor inventory controls, waste, cash management, and other key financial processes.
* Develop and execute action plans to address underperforming restaurants.

**Leadership Development & Talent Management**

* Directly coach, mentor, and develop restaurant General Managers.
* Establish high expectations for leadership, accountability, communication, and operational execution.
* Identify and develop high-potential managers for future General Manager and multi-unit leadership positions.
* Partner with ownership on recruiting, succession planning, and organizational development.
* Build a strong leadership bench capable of supporting future restaurant acquisitions and new restaurant openings.
* Foster a positive, professional, results-oriented culture across the organization.
* Conduct regular GM performance evaluations and leadership development discussions.

**Strategic Execution & Accountability**

* Work directly with ownership to establish and execute organizational priorities.
* Lead regular business reviews with General Managers, using operational and financial data to drive decisions.
* Ensure timely follow-through on operational initiatives, performance improvement plans, and company standards.
* Proactively identify business risks and opportunities and recommend solutions.
* Support restaurant acquisitions, new restaurant openings, and organizational expansion.
* Maintain consistent, transparent communication with ownership regarding restaurant performance, personnel, and operational priorities.
* Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.

**Qualifications - Required**

* Minimum 5 years of progressive restaurant leadership experience, including significant responsibility for high-volume restaurant operations.
* Demonstrated success leading General Managers or multiple restaurant management teams.
* Proven ability to improve operational performance, profitability, and leadership effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of restaurant P&Ls, labor management, food costs, forecasting, and financial controls.
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to interpret performance data, identify root causes, and implement effective action plans.
* Willingness to maintain a consistent, hands-on presence across restaurant locations.
* Ability to travel regularly between restaurants throughout Seminole County, Florida.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Current or previous McDonald's Area Supervisor, Operations Supervisor, or Director of Operations experience.
* Extensive McDonald's restaurant operations background, including General Manager experience.
* Hamburger University training and relevant McDonald's leadership development.
* Experience overseeing multiple high-volume restaurants generating $3 million–$5 million or more in annual sales per location.
* Strong familiarity with McDonald's operating systems, operational metrics, and performance standards.
* Demonstrated success developing General Managers and building management succession pipelines.
* Experience supporting new restaurant openings, acquisitions, or multi-unit organizational growth.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Sidor Ventures offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to attract, reward, and retain exceptional operational leaders.

Our benefits include:

* Competitive base salary
* Performance-based bonus opportunities
* Employer-sponsored health insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match
* Paid time off
* Professional development and leadership training
* Significant opportunities for professional growth as the organization expands

Specific compensation and benefit details will be discussed during the recruiting process.

**Career Growth**

Sidor Ventures is focused on building a strong, scalable restaurant organization with a long-term commitment to growth.

We are seeking a leader who wants more than a traditional supervisory position. This individual will have the opportunity to help shape our operating culture, develop future leaders, and contribute directly to the organization's expansion.

As we grow, the scope of this position will have the potential to expand alongside the business.

**If you are an accomplished multi-unit restaurant leader who takes pride in developing exceptional teams, driving measurable results, and building a successful organization, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.**

*Sidor Ventures is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: $100,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

role.title: Director of Facilities and Operations
role.description:
**Position Summary**

The Director of Facilities & Operations serves as a key member of the leadership team and is responsible for the stewardship, maintenance, safety, and operational excellence of the retreat center’s older buildings, grounds, infrastructure, and support services. Guided by Franciscan values of simplicity, compassion, peace, and reverence for creation, this role ensures that the physical environment reflects a spirit of hospitality, beauty, and care for all who visit.

The Director oversees facilities maintenance, grounds management, capital improvement projects, compliance, vendor relationships, safety compliance, and operational support services. This position is ideal for a hands-on leader with experience in facilities management, construction, property management, or building operations who can balance strategic planning with day-to-day operational oversight.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Facilities & Property Management**

· Provide leadership and oversight for the maintenance, repair, and improvement of all buildings, grounds, utilities, and infrastructure across the retreat center campus.

· Develop and implement preventative maintenance programs to ensure the longevity and reliability of facilities and equipment.

· Develop and maintain a multi-year facilities and building assessment plan with replacement forecast (roofs, HVAC, water/septic, electrical, roadways).

· Manage rural site systems including well, septic/on-site wastewater, water treatment, propane, backup power/generators, private roads, and irrigation, ensuring resilience to wildfire, storm, and extended-outage conditions.

· Coordinate and supervise facility improvement projects, renovations, and construction activities from planning through completion.

· Conduct regular inspections of buildings and grounds and establish priorities for repairs and upgrades.

· Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, health, environmental, and building regulations.

**Construction & Capital Projects**

· Manage capital improvement projects, including budgeting, contractor selection, scheduling, and quality control.

· Serve as the primary liaison with architects, engineers, contractors, inspectors, and vendors.

· Develop project scopes, obtain bids, review contracts, and monitor project progress.

· Maintain long-range facility and infrastructure improvement plans aligned with organizational priorities.

· Evaluate facility systems and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, sustainability, and guest experience.

**Operations Leadership**

· Oversee operational support functions including maintenance, housekeeping, kitchen and facility readiness for retreats and events.

· Develop and implement operational procedures to ensure efficient, consistent, and safe facility operations.

· Coordinate logistics to support retreat programs, guest groups, and special events.

· Ensure facilities are prepared and functioning properly to support all scheduled activities.

**Team Leadership**

· Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate maintenance, housekeeping, kitchen and support staff.

· Foster a collaborative culture of accountability, stewardship, and service.

· Establish work schedules, assign priorities, and ensure effective staff coverage.

· Promote safe work practices and ongoing professional development.

**Financial & Vendor Management**

· Assist in the development and management of facility, operations, and capital budgets.

· Monitor expenditures and identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiencies.

· Solicit and evaluate vendor proposals and negotiate service agreements.

· Manage relationships with contractors, suppliers, and service providers to ensure quality work and cost-effective solutions.

**Guest & Retreat Experience**

· Ensure retreat guests experience a safe, clean, comfortable, and welcoming environment.

· Collaborate with retreat and program staff to align facility operations with guest and event needs.

· Address facility-related concerns promptly and professionally.

**Administrative Responsibilities**

· Maintain accurate records related to maintenance activities, inspections, projects, vendor contracts, and regulatory compliance.

· Prepare reports and recommendations regarding facility conditions, capital needs, and operational improvements.

· Support organizational initiatives and special events as requested.

**Qualifications Required**

· Minimum of 2 years of experience in facilities management, construction management, property management, building operations, or a related field.

· Demonstrated experience supervising maintenance personnel, contractors, or operational teams.

· Strong knowledge of building systems, preventative maintenance practices, safety procedures, and facility operations.

· Proven project management skills, including budgeting, scheduling, and contractor oversight.

· Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

· Ability to prioritize multiple projects and respond effectively to operational needs.

**Preferred**

· Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Construction Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

· Experience in hospitality, retreat centers, camp and conference centers, educational campuses, nonprofit organizations, or mission-driven environments.

· Background in commercial construction, renovation projects, or capital improvement management with knowledge of older infrastructure.

· Knowledge of and/or desire to learn water system operation.

· CPR/First Aid certification.

**Work Environment**

· Requires regular physical presence throughout the retreat center campus.

· Frequent walking across buildings and grounds, including uneven outdoor terrain.

· Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform occasional physical inspections of facilities and equipment.

· Availability for occasional evenings, weekends, and emergency response situations as operational needs require.

Pay: $90,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

role.title: General Manager, Data Operations
role.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As General Manager of Data Operations, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5–10 years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry’s classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K

role.description:
Royal Faith Homecare Agency is seeking an organized, compassionate, and motivated professional to coordinate caregiver, schedules, maintain reliable client coverage, support agency growth through marketing, community outreach, and referral development.The Director of Operations, Homecare, leads the systems and teams that support safe, reliable care in patients’ homes. You’ll guide operational and strategic management, align resources with organizational priorities, and partner across clinical and administrative functions. Your impact: By strengthening care operations and performance improvement, you help patients and families receive coordinated, dependable homecare.

The ideal candidate will have strong adminstrative and communication skills, understand the importance of dependable home care services, and feel comfortable building relationships with healthcare professionals, social workers, case managers, and community organizations.

As a Home Director Of Operations, you’ll help clients access organized, responsive care by coordinating communication, records, and administrative support. You’ll manage client information with care, assist with scheduling and inquiries, and help ensure documentation follows applicable health regulations and privacy requirements. Your impact: By keeping care details accurate and communication clear, you help clients and care teams stay informed and better prepared for each step of service.

Responsibilities

* Coordinate client inquiries, appointments, and care-related administrative tasks.

* Care Coordination and Scheduling

* create and maintain weekly caregiver schedules

* Match Caregivers with clients based on qualifications, availability, and client needs.

* Handle call-outs, missed shifts, late arrivals, and replacement coverage.

* Communicate schedule changes to clients, caregivers and authorized representative

* monitor scheduled, completed, missed, and cancelled visits.

* Track authorized service hours and notify management of discrepancies.

* Monitor authorization expiration dates and alert the appropriate staff.

* Communicate with clients and care teams by phone and other appropriate channels; route questions to the right person.

Marketing and Community Outreach

* Promote Royal Faith Homecare Agency's approved services to appropriate referral sources.

* Visit hospitals, rehabilitation facilities, medical offices, senior centers, veteran-serving organizations, and community organization.

* Build professional relationships with social workers, discharge planners, case managers, and other referral partners.

* Explain the agency Veteran, Private Pay homecare services and referral process accurately.

* Distribute approved brochures, business cards, and marketing materials.

* Assist with community events, networking meetings, and outreach campaigns.

Skills

* Medical office or general office experience; medical administrative support experience is helpful.

* Familiarity with electronic medical records (EMR) and EHR management, patient management software, and Microsoft Office.

* Knowledge of medical terminology, health insurance, and health regulation policies is preferred.

* Strong customer service, phone communication, and client communication skills.

* Accurate typing, attention to detail, and a commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality.

**Duties**

* Lead daily homecare operations, setting priorities and monitoring service quality, compliance, and operational performance.
* Direct managers and teams, building accountability through clear managerial communication, team leadership, and executive leadership.
* Partner with medical and nursing leaders on care delivery, staffing, and medical management.
* Lead Performance Improvement (PI) initiatives and collaborate cross-functionally to address operational challenges and support strategic goals.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated experience in healthcare management, operations management, and operational management, including leadership of teams and managers.
* Nursing leadership experience and a background in medical leadership or medical management are important for guiding homecare services.
* Knowledge of health regulation policy and Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations (JCAHO) standards, with the ability to apply requirements to operations.
* Strong strategic management, executive leadership, team leadership, and managerial communication skills.
* Ability to manage healthcare finances and work effectively across clinical, administrative, and operational functions.

Pay: From $19.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oxford, AL 36203
